23.hindi_meaning: प्रक्रिया; कार्य करने का तरीका या तंत्र।
23.example: Pollination is the mechanism used to bring male and female gametes together.

24.english_meaning: The transfer of pollen from the anther to the stigma of the same flower or another flower on the same plant.
24.hindi_meaning: स्व-परागण (एक ही पुष्प के परागकणों का उसी पुष्प या उसी पौधे के दूसरे पुष्प के वर्तिकाग्र पर पहुँचना)
24.example: Self-pollination ensures seed production even when pollinators are absent.

24.english_meaning: Refers to flowers that open to expose their reproductive organs for pollination.
24.hindi_meaning: उन्मील-परागी (वे पुष्प जो खिलते हैं और जिनके जननांग बाहर दिखाई देते हैं)
24.example: Chasmogamous flowers are similar to those of other species with exposed anthers and stigma.

24.english_meaning: Refers to flowers that do not open, ensuring self-pollination within the closed bud.
24.hindi_meaning: अनुन्मील-परागी (वे पुष्प जो कभी नहीं खिलते और बंद अवस्था में ही परागण करते हैं)
24.example: Cleistogamous flowers produce assured seed-set even in the absence of pollinators.

24.english_meaning: To burst open or split along a natural line to release contents, such as pollen.
24.hindi_meaning: स्फुटित होना (परागकोष का फटना जिससे परागकण बाहर निकलते हैं)
24.example: When anthers dehisce in the flower buds, pollen grains are released.

24.english_meaning: Relating to autogamy, where pollination occurs within the same flower.
Pollination between two flowers on the same plant.
24.hindi_meaning: सजात-पुष्पी परागण (एक ही पौधे के दो अलग-अलग पुष्पों के बीच परागण)
24.example: Geitonogamy is functionally cross-pollination but genetically similar to autogamy.

24.english_meaning: Cross-pollination between flowers of different plants of the same species.
24.hindi_meaning: पर-परागण (दो अलग-अलग पौधों के पुष्पों के बीच परागण)
24.example: Xenogamy is the only type of pollination that brings genetically different pollen to the stigma.

24.english_meaning: Non-living physical or chemical factors in the environment.
24.hindi_meaning: अजैविक (निर्जीव कारक जैसे हवा और पानी)
24.example: Wind and water are common abiotic agents of pollination.

24.english_meaning: Relating to or resulting from living organisms.
24.hindi_meaning: जैविक (सजीव कारक जैसे कीट, पक्षी आदि)
24.example: The majority of plants rely on biotic agents for successful pollination.

24.english_meaning: To make up for something unwelcome or unpleasant by exerting an opposite force or effect.
24.example: Plants produce enormous amounts of pollen to compensate for the loss during wind pollination.

24.english_meaning: Situations that are not known or definite; lack of predictability.
24.example: Pollination by wind involves many uncertainties regarding whether the pollen will reach the stigma.

24.english_meaning: Very large in size, quantity, or extent.
24.example: The plant produces an enormous amount of pollen to ensure fertilization.

24.english_meaning: The part of the ovary of seed plants that contains the female germ cell and becomes the seed after fertilization.
24.hindi_meaning: बीजांड (पौधे का वह भाग जो निषेचन के बाद बीज में विकसित होता है)
24.example: The number of pollen grains is much higher than the number of ovules available.

24.english_meaning: Involving or creating favorable circumstances that increase the chances of success.
24.example: Is cleistogamy advantageous or disadvantageous to the plant's survival?

24.english_meaning: In every case or on every occasion; always.
24.example: Cleistogamous flowers are invariably autogamous because they never open.

25.english_meaning: The transfer of pollen grains from the anther to the stigma of a flower.
25.hindi_meaning: परागण (परागकणों का परागकोश से वर्तिकाग्र तक स्थानांतरण)
25.example: Wind and water are common agents of pollination in many plants.

25.english_meaning: Relating to non-living physical and chemical elements in the environment.
25.example: Wind and water are examples of abiotic components involved in pollination.

25.english_meaning: The pollen-producing reproductive organ of a flower, consisting of an anther and a filament.
25.example: Wind-pollinated flowers often possess well-exposed stamens to disperse pollen easily.

25.english_meaning: The part of a pistil where pollen grains germinate.
25.hindi_meaning: वर्तिकाग्र (स्त्री केसर का वह भाग जो परागकणों को ग्रहण करता है)
25.example: The feathery stigma helps to easily trap air-borne pollen grains.

25.english_meaning: The part of the plant that develops into a seed after fertilization.
25.hindi_meaning: बीजांड (जो निषेचन के बाद बीज में विकसित होता है)
25.example: Wind-pollinated flowers usually have a single ovule in each ovary.

25.english_meaning: A complete cluster of flowers arranged on a stem.
25.hindi_meaning: पुष्पक्रम (फूलों के लगने का क्रम या गुच्छा)
25.example: Numerous flowers are packed into an inflorescence in corn cobs.

25.english_meaning: Flowering plants having a single cotyledon in the seed.
25.example: Water pollination is mostly limited to monocotyledons among flowering plants.

25.english_meaning: A mature male or female germ cell able to unite with another in sexual reproduction.
25.example: Water is a regular mode of transport for male gametes in lower plants.

25.english_meaning: A small flowerless green plant of the division Bryophyta, comprising mosses and liverworts.
25.example: Bryophytes require water for the transport of their male gametes.

25.english_meaning: A seedless vascular plant, such as a fern, that reproduces via spores.
25.hindi_meaning: टेरिडोफाइट्स (जैसे फ़र्न, जो बीजाणुओं द्वारा प्रजनन करते हैं)
25.example: Pteridophytes and bryophytes depend on water for fertilization.

25.english_meaning: The action or process of fertilizing an egg or a plant, involving the fusion of male and female gametes.
25.hindi_meaning: निषेचन (नर और मादा युग्मकों का संलयन)
25.example: Water is essential for the fertilization of certain lower plant groups.

25.english_meaning: Beneath the surface of the water.
25.example: Female flowers of seagrasses remain submerged in water during pollination.

25.english_meaning: Having a sticky, gelatinous consistency similar to mucus or gum.
25.example: Pollen grains are protected from wetting by a mucilaginous covering.

25.english_meaning: Distributed or spread over a wide area.
25.example: Pollens are easily dispersed into wind currents from well-exposed stamens.

25.english_meaning: Growing or living in or near water.
25.hindi_meaning: जलीय (पानी में रहने या उगने वाला)
25.example: Not all aquatic plants use water for their pollination process.

27.english_meaning: A small cavity or compartment within an organ or part of an animal or plant, such as an ovary.
27.hindi_meaning: अंडाशय के भीतर का छोटा कक्ष या कोष्ठ
27.example: The moth deposits its eggs safely inside the locule of the ovary.

27.english_meaning: An animal or insect that carries pollen from one flower to another.
27.hindi_meaning: परागणकर्ता (वह जीव जो पराग को एक फूल से दूसरे फूल तक ले जाता है)
27.example: Bees and butterflies are the most common pollinators in a garden.

27.english_meaning: A mutual relationship or connection between two or more things.
27.hindi_meaning: सहसंबंध (दो चीजों के बीच का आपसी संबंध)
27.example: There is a strong correlation between the flower's color and the type of insect that visits it.

27.english_meaning: The part of a stamen that contains the pollen.
27.hindi_meaning: परागकोष (पुंकेसर का वह भाग जिसमें परागकण होते हैं)
27.example: The insect brushed against the anther, picking up yellow pollen grains.

27.english_meaning: The receptive tip of the pistil of a flower, which receives pollen.
27.hindi_meaning: वर्तिकाग्र (फूल का वह भाग जो परागकणों को ग्रहण करता है)
27.example: Pollen must land on the stigma to initiate the fertilization process.

27.english_meaning: Having both male and female reproductive organs.
27.hindi_meaning: उभयलिंगी (जिसमें नर और मादा दोनों जनन अंग मौजूद हों)
27.example: Most flowering plants produce hermaphrodite flowers to ensure reproduction.

27.english_meaning: The production of offspring from the mating or breeding of individuals that are closely related.
27.hindi_meaning: अंतःप्रजनन (निकट संबंधी जीवों के बीच प्रजनन)
27.example: Continued self-pollination in plants can lead to inbreeding depression.

27.english_meaning: Happening at the same time or rate.
27.hindi_meaning: समकालिक (एक ही समय पर होने वाला)
27.example: The release of pollen and stigma receptivity are not always synchronised in these plants.

27.english_meaning: The state of being willing or able to receive something.
27.example: Stigma receptivity is crucial for successful pollination.

27.hindi_meaning: स्व-परागण (एक ही फूल के भीतर परागण)
27.example: Plants have developed various devices to prevent autogamy.

27.english_meaning: The condition of being unable to exist or work together.
27.example: Self-incompatibility prevents a plant from fertilizing itself.

27.english_meaning: The process by which a plant grows from a seed or spore.
27.example: The pistil inhibits pollen germination to prevent self-fertilization.

27.english_meaning: Having both male and female flowers on the same plant.
27.hindi_meaning: एकलिंगाश्रयी (एक ही पौधे पर नर और मादा दोनों फूलों का होना)
27.example: Maize is a monoecious plant, meaning it has separate male and female flowers on the same individual.

27.english_meaning: A condition where male and female flowers are on different plants.
27.hindi_meaning: द्विलिंगाश्रयता (नर और मादा फूलों का अलग-अलग पौधों पर होना)
27.example: Dioecy is an effective strategy to ensure cross-pollination in papaya.

27.english_meaning: Able to exist or occur together without conflict.
27.hindi_meaning: अनुकूल या संगत (जो आपस में मेल खा सके)
27.example: The pistil only accepts compatible pollen from the same species.

28.english_meaning: The process of combining male and female gametes to form a zygote.
28.hindi_meaning: निषेचन (नर और मादा युग्मकों का मिलन)
28.example: Fertilisation is a crucial step in the sexual reproduction of flowering plants.

28.english_meaning: The female reproductive part of a flower, consisting of the stigma, style, and ovary.
28.example: The pollen grain must land on the pistil to initiate the reproductive process.

28.english_meaning: The process by which a pollen grain begins to grow into a pollen tube.
28.example: Pollen germination occurs only when the pollen is compatible with the stigma.

28.english_meaning: The receptive tip of the pistil that receives pollen grains.
28.example: The sticky surface of the stigma helps in trapping the pollen grains.

28.english_meaning: Able to exist or occur together without conflict; in this context, capable of cross-fertilization.
28.hindi_meaning: अनुकूल (जो आपस में मेल खा सके)
28.example: Only compatible pollen grains can successfully fertilize the ovule.

28.english_meaning: Brought about or influenced by a specific process or agent.
28.hindi_meaning: मध्यस्थता करना (किसी प्रक्रिया द्वारा संचालित होना)
28.example: The interaction between the pollen and the pistil is mediated by chemical signals.
Botanists have identified the specific proteins involved in pollen recognition.

28.english_meaning: Small apertures in the pollen grain wall through which the pollen tube emerges.
28.hindi_meaning: जनन छिद्र (परागकण की बाहरी परत पर स्थित छिद्र)
28.example: The pollen tube emerges through one of the germ pores on the pollen grain.

28.english_meaning: Specialized cells in the embryo sac that help guide the pollen tube to the egg.
28.example: The pollen tube enters the embryo sac through one of the synergid cells.

28.english_meaning: Mature reproductive cells (sperm or egg) that unite during sexual reproduction.
28.example: Male gametes are discharged into the synergid to facilitate fertilization.

28.english_meaning: The action or influence of things on one another.
28.example: The interaction between the pollen and pistil determines if fertilization will occur.

28.english_meaning: Parts or elements that make up a whole system.
28.example: Chemical components on the surface of the pollen trigger the recognition process.

28.english_meaning: A complex structure or group of cells working together for a specific function.
28.example: The egg apparatus consists of the egg cell and the synergids.

28.english_meaning: To release or send out contents.
28.example: The pollen tube will discharge the male gametes into the embryo sac.

28.english_meaning: The narrow, elongated part of the pistil between the stigma and the ovary.
28.example: The pollen tube grows down through the style to reach the ovary.

29.english_meaning: The receptive tip of the carpel in a flower, which receives pollen.
29.hindi_meaning: स्त्रीकेसर का ऊपरी भाग जो परागकणों को ग्रहण करता है (वर्तिकाग्र)
29.example: The pollen grains land on the stigma to initiate fertilization.

29.english_meaning: A mature haploid male or female germ cell which is able to unite with another of the opposite sex in sexual reproduction.
29.example: The pollen tube carries two male gametes to the ovule.

29.english_meaning: A small opening in the surface of an ovule through which the pollen tube penetrates.
29.hindi_meaning: बीजांड का वह सूक्ष्म छिद्र जिससे पराग नलिका प्रवेश करती है (बीजांडद्वार)
29.example: The pollen tube enters the ovule through the micropyle.

29.english_meaning: Two specialized cells that lie adjacent to the egg cell in the female gametophyte of angiosperms.
29.example: The filiform apparatus in the synergids guides the pollen tube.

29.english_meaning: Having the shape of a thread or filament.
29.example: The filiform apparatus helps in directing the pollen tube.

29.english_meaning: Reciprocal action or influence between two or more things.
29.example: Pollen-pistil interaction is a dynamic process of recognition.

29.english_meaning: The action of restraining, hindering, or preventing a process.
29.example: The pistil may cause the inhibition of incompatible pollen.

29.english_meaning: The process of crossing two genetically different individuals to produce offspring with desired traits.
29.example: Artificial hybridisation is a major approach in crop improvement.

29.english_meaning: The removal of anthers from a flower bud to prevent self-pollination.
29.example: Emasculation is necessary when using bisexual flowers for breeding.

29.english_meaning: To burst open or split along a natural line to release contents (like pollen).
29.hindi_meaning: फटना या स्फुटन होना (जैसे परागकोष का फटना)
29.example: The anther dehisces to release mature pollen grains.

29.english_meaning: The state of being able or willing to receive something, specifically the stigma's ability to accept pollen.
29.example: Pollination occurs only when the stigma attains receptivity.

29.english_meaning: Having both male and female reproductive organs in the same flower.
29.hindi_meaning: उभयलिंगी (जिसमें नर और मादा दोनों अंग हों)
29.example: Bisexual flowers require emasculation to prevent self-pollination.

29.english_meaning: Having only one type of reproductive organ, either male or female.
29.example: Unisexual flowers do not require the process of emasculation.

29.english_meaning: The state of being made impure by the introduction of unwanted substances.
29.example: Bagging protects the stigma from contamination by unwanted pollen.

29.english_meaning: The process by which a pollen grain begins to grow a pollen tube.
29.example: You can observe pollen germination on a slide with sugar solution.

30.english_meaning: Events and developmental processes that occur in a flower after the process of fertilisation has taken place.
30.hindi_meaning: निषेचन-पश्चात् (निषेचन के बाद होने वाली घटनाएँ और विकास)
30.example: Following double fertilisation, endosperm and embryo development are collectively termed post-fertilisation events.

30.english_meaning: The nutritive tissue formed within the seed of flowering plants following fertilisation, which provides nourishment to the developing embryo.
30.hindi_meaning: भ्रूणपोष (वह ऊतक जो विकासशील भ्रूण को पोषण प्रदान करता है)
30.example: The primary endosperm cell divides repeatedly to form the nutritive endosperm tissue.

30.english_meaning: The young multicellular organism in the early stages of development, originating from the zygote.
30.hindi_meaning: भ्रूण (युग्मज से विकसित होने वाला प्रारंभिक जीव)
30.example: The zygote develops into a mature embryo inside the seed.

30.english_meaning: The process of becoming fully developed or mature.
30.hindi_meaning: परिपक्वता (पूर्ण रूप से विकसित होने की प्रक्रिया)
30.example: The maturation of ovules into seeds is a crucial part of plant reproduction.

30.english_meaning: The part of the plant that develops into a seed after fertilisation.
30.hindi_meaning: बीजांड (पादप का वह भाग जो निषेचन के बाद बीज बनता है)
30.example: Each ovule matures into a seed within the ovary.

30.english_meaning: The female reproductive organ in plants that holds the ovules and develops into a fruit.
30.hindi_meaning: अंडाशय (फूल का वह भाग जो फल में विकसित होता है)
30.example: After fertilisation, the ovary transforms into a fruit.

30.english_meaning: To come before something else in time or order.
30.example: Endosperm development generally precedes embryo development in flowering plants.

30.english_meaning: Having three sets of chromosomes in each cell (3n).
30.hindi_meaning: त्रिगुणित (जिसमें गुणसूत्रों के तीन सेट हों)
30.example: The primary endosperm nucleus is a triploid structure.

30.english_meaning: Two specialized cells located next to the egg cell in the female gametophyte of flowering plants.
30.hindi_meaning: सहाय कोशिकाएँ (भ्रूणकोष में अंड कोशिका के पास स्थित कोशिकाएँ)
30.example: The pollen tube releases two male gametes into the cytoplasm of the synergid.

30.english_meaning: The jelly-like material that makes up much of a cell inside the cell membrane.
30.hindi_meaning: कोशिकाद्रव्य (कोशिका के भीतर मौजूद जेली जैसा पदार्थ)
30.example: The male gametes are released directly into the cytoplasm of the synergid.

30.english_meaning: The fusion of male and female gametes to form a zygote.
30.hindi_meaning: युग्मकों का संलयन (नर और मादा युग्मकों का मेल)
30.example: The fusion of a male gamete with the egg cell is known as syngamy.

30.english_meaning: Containing two complete sets of chromosomes, one from each parent (2n).
30.hindi_meaning: द्विगुणित (जिसमें गुणसूत्रों के दो सेट होते हैं)
30.example: Syngamy results in the formation of a diploid zygote.

30.english_meaning: Two nuclei in the central cell of an embryo sac that fuse with a male gamete during triple fusion.
30.hindi_meaning: ध्रुवीय केंद्रक (भ्रूणकोष की केंद्रीय कोशिका के दो केंद्रक)
30.example: The second male gamete fuses with the two polar nuclei in the central cell.

30.english_meaning: The fusion of three haploid nuclei (one male gamete and two polar nuclei) to form a triploid primary endosperm nucleus.
30.hindi_meaning: त्रिक संलयन (तीन अगुणित केंद्रकों का संलयन)
30.example: Triple fusion involves the joining of three haploid nuclei to produce a triploid PEN.

30.english_meaning: A fact or situation that is observed to happen, especially one whose cause or explanation is in question.
30.example: Double fertilisation is a unique biological phenomenon found in flowering plants.

31.english_meaning: The part of a seed which acts as a food store for the developing plant embryo.
31.hindi_meaning: भ्रूणपोष (बीज के भीतर का पोषक ऊतक)
31.example: The endosperm provides essential nutrients for the growth of the embryo.

31.english_meaning: An unborn or unhatched offspring in the process of development.
31.example: The embryo develops into a mature plant after germination.

31.english_meaning: The process of forming cells or becoming cellular.
31.example: Cellularisation occurs in the endosperm after the free-nuclear stage.

31.english_meaning: The process of becoming mature or fully developed.
31.example: Seed maturation is a critical stage in the plant life cycle.

31.english_meaning: The process by which a plant grows from a seed.
31.example: Adequate moisture is required for successful seed germination.

31.english_meaning: Relating to the micropyle, a small opening in the surface of an ovule.
31.hindi_meaning: बीजांडद्वारी (बीजांड का वह सिरा जहाँ से पराग नलिका प्रवेश करती है)
31.example: The zygote is situated at the micropylar end of the embryo sac.

31.english_meaning: The formation and development of an embryo.
31.example: The early stages of embryogeny are similar in both monocots and dicots.

31.english_meaning: Flowering plants whose seeds typically contain only one embryonic leaf.
31.example: Maize and rice are examples of monocotyledons.

31.english_meaning: Flowering plants whose seeds have two embryonic leaves or cotyledons.
31.example: Peas and beans are classified as dicotyledons.

31.english_meaning: An embryonic leaf in seed-bearing plants.
31.example: The embryo consists of an embryonal axis and two cotyledons in dicots.

31.english_meaning: The region of an embryo or seedling stem above the cotyledon.
31.example: The epicotyl terminates with the plumule or stem tip.

31.english_meaning: The part of the stem of an embryo plant beneath the stalks of the seed leaves.
31.example: The hypocotyl terminates at its lower end in the radicle.

31.english_meaning: The rudimentary shoot or stem of an embryo plant.
31.hindi_meaning: प्रांकुर (भ्रूण का वह भाग जो तना बनाता है)
31.example: The plumule develops into the shoot system of the plant.

31.english_meaning: The part of a plant embryo that develops into the primary root.
31.hindi_meaning: मूलांकुर (भ्रूण का वह भाग जो जड़ बनाता है)
31.example: The radicle is the first part of the seedling to emerge from the seed.

31.english_meaning: A specialized cotyledon found in the embryos of grass family plants.
31.hindi_meaning: स्क्यूटेलम (घास कुल के पौधों में एकबीजपत्र)
31.example: In the grass family, the single cotyledon is known as the scutellum.

32.english_meaning: A protective sheath enclosing the radical and root cap in certain plant embryos.
32.hindi_meaning: कोलियोराइज़ा (एक सुरक्षात्मक आवरण जो मूलांकुर और मूल गोप को ढकता है)
32.example: The radical and root cap are enclosed in an undifferentiated sheath called coleorrhiza.

32.english_meaning: A pointed sheath protecting the emerging shoot in grass seedlings.
32.hindi_meaning: कोलियोप्टाइल (अंकुरित पौधे के प्ररोह को ढकने वाला सुरक्षात्मक आवरण)
32.example: Epicotyl has a shoot apex and a few leaf primordia enclosed in a hollow foliar structure, the coleoptile.

32.english_meaning: The region of an embryo stem above the attachment point of the cotyledons.
32.hindi_meaning: बीजपत्रोपरूक (बीजपत्रों के जुड़ाव के बिंदु से ऊपर का भ्रूणीय अक्ष का भाग)
32.example: The portion of the embryonal axis above the level of attachment of scutellum is the epicotyl.

32.english_meaning: Plants that have flowers and produce seeds enclosed within a carpel.
32.hindi_meaning: आवृतबीजी (फूल वाले पौधे जिनके बीज फल के अंदर होते हैं)
32.example: In angiosperms, the seed is the final product of sexual reproduction.

32.english_meaning: An embryonic leaf in seed-bearing plants, one or more of which are the first to appear from a germinating seed.
32.hindi_meaning: बीजपत्र (बीज के अंदर का वह भाग जो अंकुरण के समय पहली पत्ती का काम करता है)
32.example: A seed typically consists of seed coat(s), cotyledon(s) and an embryo axis.

32.english_meaning: Seeds that do not retain endosperm as it is completely consumed during embryo development; ex-albuminous.
32.hindi_meaning: अभू्रणपोषी (वे बीज जिनमें भ्रूण के विकास के दौरान भ्रूणपोष पूरी तरह समाप्त हो जाता है)
32.example: Non-albuminous seeds have no residual endosperm as it is completely consumed during embryo development.

32.english_meaning: Seeds that retain a part of the endosperm because it is not completely used up during development.
32.hindi_meaning: भ्रूणपोषी (वे बीज जिनमें भ्रूण के विकास के बाद भी भ्रूणपोष का कुछ भाग शेष रहता है)
32.example: Albuminous seeds retain a part of endosperm as it is not completely used up during embryo development.

32.english_meaning: Nutritive tissue derived from the nucellus that is stored in the seed of some plants.
32.hindi_meaning: बीजांडकाय अवशेष / पेरिस्पर्म (बीज में बचा हुआ बीजांडकाय ऊतक)
32.example: This residual, persistent nucellus is the perisperm.

32.english_meaning: A small opening in the ovule/seed coat through which water and oxygen enter.
32.hindi_meaning: बीजद्वार (बीज आवरण में मौजूद वह छोटा छिद्र जिससे पानी और हवा अंदर प्रवेश करते हैं)
32.example: The micropyle remains as a small pore in the seed coat.

32.english_meaning: A period of suspended activity or temporary inactivity in a seed or organism.
32.hindi_meaning: सुप्तता (बीजों या जीवों में निष्क्रियता की अवस्था)
32.example: The embryo may enter a state of inactivity called dormancy, or if favourable conditions are available, they germinate.

32.english_meaning: The part of a fruit formed from the wall of the ovary after fertilisation.
32.hindi_meaning: फलभित्ति (अंडाशय की दीवार से विकसित होने वाली फल की परत)
32.example: The wall of the ovary develops into the wall of fruit called pericarp.

32.english_meaning: The action or process of distributing things or people over a wide area; seed scattering.
32.hindi_meaning: प्रकीर्णन / फैलाव (बीजों का दूर-दूर तक फैलना)
32.example: Many fruits have evolved mechanisms for dispersal of seeds.

32.english_meaning: The base of a flower, sometimes contributing to the formation of false fruits.
32.hindi_meaning: पुष्पासन (फूल का आधार, जो कुछ फलों के निर्माण में भाग लेता है)
32.example: However, in a few species such as apple, strawberry, cashew, etc., the thalamus also contributes to fruit formation.

32.english_meaning: A fruit formed from parts of the flower other than the ovary, such as the thalamus.
32.hindi_meaning: असत्य फल (वह फल जो अंडाशय के अलावा अन्य पुष्प भागों जैसे पुष्पासन से विकसित होता है)
32.example: Such fruits are called false fruits.

32.english_meaning: A fruit which develops exclusively from the ovary of the flower after fertilisation.
32.hindi_meaning: सत्य फल (वह फल जो केवल अंडाशय से विकसित होता है)
32.example: Most fruits however develop only from the ovary and are called true fruits.

33.english_meaning: The action or process of fertilizing an egg, female animal, or plant, involving the fusion of male and female gametes.
33.hindi_meaning: निषेचन (नर और मादा युग्मकों का संलयन)
33.example: Pollination and fertilisation are critical steps in the sexual reproduction of flowering plants.

33.english_meaning: Relating to or denoting the production of fruit without fertilization.
33.hindi_meaning: अनिषेकफली (बिना निषेचन के फल उत्पन्न करने वाला)
33.example: Banana is a common example of a parthenocarpic fruit that develops without fertilization.

33.english_meaning: The natural or artificial development of fruit without fertilization of ovules, resulting in seedless fruits.
33.hindi_meaning: अनिषेकजनित फल विकास (बिना निषेचन के फल बनना)
33.example: Parthenocarpy can be artificially induced through the application of specific growth hormones.

33.english_meaning: Natural or synthetic substances that regulate plant growth and developmental processes.
33.hindi_meaning: वृद्धि हार्मोन (पादप हार्मोन्स जो विकास को नियंत्रित करते हैं)
33.example: Farmers and scientists use growth hormones to induce seedless fruit production in crops.
Fruits produced through parthenocarpy are generally seedless and popular among consumers.

33.english_meaning: A plant that has flowers and produces seeds enclosed within a carpel; flowering plants.
33.hindi_meaning: आवृतबीजी (फूल वाले पौधे जिनके बीज फल के अंदर होते हैं)

33.english_meaning: Relating to the production of new offspring by sexual or asexual process.

33.english_meaning: The transfer of pollen grains from an anther to the stigma of a flower.

33.english_meaning: Free from outside control; not depending on another for livelihood or subsistence.
33.hindi_meaning: स्वतंत्र (जो किसी पर निर्भर न हो)

33.english_meaning: Trustworthy and reliable; able to be counted on.
33.example: Because it does not require water, seed formation is a much more dependable process.

33.english_meaning: Showing or having an ability to adapt to new conditions or situations.

33.english_meaning: A plan of action designed to achieve a long-term or overall aim.
33.example: Plants have evolved various survival strategies to ensure the continuation of their species.

33.english_meaning: The action or process of distributing things or people over a wide area.
33.hindi_meaning: प्रकीर्णन (बीजों या जीवों का दूर-दूर फैलना)
33.example: Seed dispersal by wind or animals helps plant species colonize new habitats.

33.english_meaning: The natural home or environment of an animal, plant, or other organism.

33.english_meaning: Fruits in which other floral parts besides the ovary contribute to the fruit formation (e.g., apple, strawberry).
33.hindi_meaning: असत्य फल / कूटफल (जिसमें अंडाशय के अलावा अन्य पुष्प भाग भी फल बनाते हैं)
33.example: In apples and strawberries, the thalamus contributes to the formation of false fruits.

34.english_meaning: The process by which green plants use sunlight to synthesize nutrients from carbon dioxide and water.
34.hindi_meaning: प्रकाश संश्लेषण (वह प्रक्रिया जिससे पौधे सूर्य के प्रकाश का उपयोग करके भोजन बनाते हैं)
34.example: Young seedlings are nourished until they are capable of photosynthesis on their own.

34.english_meaning: An unborn or unhatched offspring in the process of development, inside a seed or egg.
34.hindi_meaning: भ्रूण (बीज या अंडे के भीतर विकास के शुरुआती चरण में जीव)
34.example: The hard seed coat provides protection to the young embryo.

34.english_meaning: The removal of water from something, such as a food or seed.
34.hindi_meaning: निर्जलीकरण (जल की कमी या नमी हटाना)
34.example: Dehydration and dormancy of mature seeds are crucial for storage.

34.english_meaning: A period in an organism's life cycle when growth, development, and physical activity are temporarily stopped.
34.hindi_meaning: सुप्त अवस्था (बीज या पौधे की वह स्थिति जिसमें विकास अस्थायी रूप से रुक जाता है)
34.example: The seed germinated and flowered after an estimated record of 10,000 years of dormancy.

34.english_meaning: The ability to work successfully or survive; for a seed, the capacity to germinate.
34.hindi_meaning: जीवनक्षमता / अंकुरण क्षमता (जीवित रहने या उगने की क्षमता)
34.example: In a few species the seeds lose viability within a few months.

34.english_meaning: Dug out from the ground, typically in an archaeological site.
34.hindi_meaning: उत्खनित / खुदा हुआ (पुरातत्व स्थल से निकाला गया)

It would be worth attempting to comprehend the enormous reproductive capacity of some flowering plants.

34.english_meaning: The part of a plant that develops into a seed after fertilisation.
34.hindi_meaning: बीजांड (फूल का वह भाग जो निषेचन के बाद बीज बनता है)

34.english_meaning: Asexual reproduction in plants, specifically the production of seeds without fertilisation.
34.hindi_meaning: असंगजनन (बिना निषेचन के बीज उत्पन्न करने की प्रक्रिया)

35.english_meaning: Flowering plants that produce seeds enclosed within a carpel or fruit.
35.hindi_meaning: आवृतबीजी (फूल देने वाले पौधे जिनके बीज फल के अंदर बंद होते हैं)

35.hindi_meaning: लघुबीजाणुजनन (अर्धसूत्री विभाजन द्वारा लघुबीजाणुओं के बनने की प्रक्रिया)

35.hindi_meaning: बीजांडवृंत (वह डंठल जो बीजांड को अंडाशय से जोड़ता है)

35.hindi_meaning: बीजांडद्वार (बीजांड का वह सूक्ष्म छिद्र जहाँ अध्यावरण अनुपस्थित होता है)
35.example: The ovules have a stalk called funicle, protective integument(s), and an opening called micropyle.

35.hindi_meaning: बहुभ्रूणता (एक ही बीज में एक से अधिक भ्रूणों का पाया जाना)

35.hindi_meaning: असंगजनन (बिना निषेचन के बीज बनने की प्रक्रिया से संबंधित)

35.hindi_meaning: असंगजनन (बिना निषेचन के बीज या भ्रूण का निर्माण)
35.example: Because of the importance of apomixis in hybrid seed industry, active research is going on in many laboratories.

36.english_meaning: A plant that produces flowers and develops seeds enclosed within a carpel.

36.example: The female gametophyte develops within the ovule of the flower.

36.hindi_meaning: सहायक कोशिकाएं (भ्रूणकोष में अंड कोशिका के पास स्थित कोशिकाएं)
36.example: The pollen tube discharges male gametes into one of the synergids.

36.english_meaning: Relating to the base of the ovule opposite the micropyle.

36.hindi_meaning: असंगजनन (बिना निषेचन के बीज का निर्माण)
36.example: Apomixis is a phenomenon found in some grasses.

36.example: Apomicts have several advantages in modern horticulture.

36.english_meaning: The occurrence of more than one embryo in a single seed.
36.hindi_meaning: बहुभ्रूणता (एक बीज में एक से अधिक भ्रूण का होना)

37.hindi_meaning: पौधों में एक आनुवंशिक तंत्र जो स्व-निषेचन को रोकता है।

37.english_meaning: Temporarily inactive or in a state of suspended growth.

45.english_meaning: A mammal of an order that includes the lemurs, monkeys, apes, and humans.
45.hindi_meaning: प्राइमेट (स्तधारी जीवों का एक समूह जिसमें बंदर, लंगूर और मनुष्य आते हैं)
45.example: The reproductive cycle in female primates is called menstrual cycle.

45.hindi_meaning: रजोदर्शन (जीवन में पहली बार होने वाला मासिक धर्म)
45.example: The first menstruation begins at puberty and is called menarche.

45.english_meaning: The period during which adolescents reach sexual maturity and become capable of reproduction.
45.hindi_meaning: यौवनारंभ (वह आयु जब प्रजनन अंग परिपक्व होते हैं)
45.example: The first menstruation begins at puberty and is called menarche.

47.english_meaning: Hormones that stimulate the gonads (testes and ovaries), such as LH and FSH.
47.hindi_meaning: गोनाडोट्रोपिन (हार्मोन जो वृषण और अंडाशय को उत्तेजित करते हैं)
47.example: Gonadotropins like LH and FSH increase gradually during the follicular phase.

47.english_meaning: The phase of the menstrual cycle in which follicles in the ovary mature.
47.hindi_meaning: पुटकीय प्रावस्था (मासिक धर्म चक्र का वह चरण जिसमें अंडाशय में पुटक विकसित होते हैं)
47.example: During the follicular phase, estrogen secretion is stimulated by growing follicles.

47.english_meaning: A rapid and sharp increase in luteinizing hormone levels that triggers ovulation.
47.hindi_meaning: एलएच सर्ज (ल्यूटिनाइजिंग हार्मोन की तीव्र वृद्धि जो अंडोत्सर्ग को प्रेरित करती है)
47.example: The rapid secretion of LH leading to its maximum level is called the LH surge.

47.english_meaning: The release of a mature ovum from the ovary.
47.hindi_meaning: अंडोत्सर्ग (अंडाशय से परिपक्व अंडाणु का बाहर निकलना)
47.example: Ovulation typically occurs around the 14th day of the menstrual cycle.

47.english_meaning: A temporary endocrine structure formed in the ovary after ovulation that secretes progesterone.
47.hindi_meaning: कॉर्पस ल्यूटियम (अंडोत्सर्ग के बाद अंडाशय में बनने वाली संरचना जो प्रोजेस्टेरोन स्रावित करती है)
47.example: The remaining parts of the Graafian follicle transform into the corpus luteum.

47.english_meaning: A female hormone essential for maintaining the endometrium during pregnancy.
47.hindi_meaning: प्रोजेस्टेरोन (गर्भावस्था के दौरान गर्भाशय की परत को बनाए रखने वाला हार्मोन)
47.example: The corpus luteum secretes large amounts of progesterone.

47.english_meaning: The mucous membrane lining the inner wall of the uterus.
47.hindi_meaning: गर्भाशय अंतःस्तर / एंडोमेट्रियम (गर्भाशय की सबसे भीतर की परत)
47.example: Progesterone is essential for the maintenance of the endometrium.

47.english_meaning: The attachment of the fertilized ovum to the wall of the uterus.
47.hindi_meaning: अंतरापणन / रोपण (निषेचित अंडाणु का गर्भाशय की दीवार से चिपकना)
47.example: Such an endometrium is necessary for the implantation of the fertilised ovum.

47.english_meaning: The permanent cessation of menstrual cycles in women, usually around 50 years of age.
47.hindi_meaning: रजोनिवृत्ति (महिलाओं में मासिक धर्म का हमेशा के लिए बंद होना)
47.example: In human beings, menstrual cycles cease around 50 years of age, which is termed as menopause.

47.english_meaning: The first occurrence of menstruation in a female adolescent.
47.hindi_meaning: पहली माहवारी / रजोदर्शन (जीवन का पहला मासिक धर्म)
47.example: Cyclic menstruation extends between menarche and menopause.
During copulation, semen is released by the penis into the vagina.

47.english_meaning: The release of semen into the female reproductive tract.
47.hindi_meaning: वीर्यसेचन (स्त्री जनन मार्ग में वीर्य का छोड़ा जाना)
47.example: Semen is released into the vagina during insemination.

47.english_meaning: A specific wider section of the fallopian tube where fertilization typically occurs.
47.hindi_meaning: तुम्बिका क्षेत्र / ऐम्पुलरी भाग (फैलोपियन ट्यूब का वह भाग जहाँ निषेचन होता है)
47.example: Sperms and the ovum reach the ampullary region of the fallopian tube.

47.english_meaning: The transparent glycoprotein layer surrounding the plasma membrane of an ovum.
47.hindi_meaning: ज़ोना पेलुसिडा (अंडाणु के चारों ओर मौजूद पारदर्शी झिल्ली)
47.example: During fertilisation, a sperm comes in contact with the zona pellucida layer of the ovum.

47.english_meaning: A cap-like structure at the head of a sperm containing enzymes that help penetrate the ovum.
47.hindi_meaning: एक्रोसोम (शुक्राणु के सिर पर स्थित संरचना जिसमें अंडाणु को भेदने वाले एंजाइम होते हैं)
47.example: The secretions of the acrosome help the sperm enter into the cytoplasm of the ovum.

49.english_meaning: An early embryonic cell produced by cleavage of a fertilized ovum.
49.hindi_meaning: निषेचित अंडे के विभाजन से बनने वाली शुरुआती कोशिका।
49.example: The zygote divides into smaller cells called blastomeres during early development.

49.english_meaning: A solid ball of cells resulting from division of a fertilized ovum, forming a mulberry-like structure.
49.hindi_meaning: कोशिकाओं का एक ठोस गोला जो निषेचित अंडे के विभाजन से बनता है (शहतूत के आकार का)।
49.example: The continuous division of blastomeres ultimately results in the formation of a morula.

49.english_meaning: A mammalian blastula in which the differentiation of cells has begun, consisting of an inner cell mass and an outer trophoblast.
49.hindi_meaning: विकास का वह चरण जिसमें कोशिकाएं ट्रोफब्लास्ट और इनर सेल मास में विभाजित हो जाती हैं।
49.example: The morula transforms into a blastocyst as it moves further into the uterus.

49.english_meaning: The outer layer of cells of the blastocyst that provides nutrients to the embryo and develops into a large part of the placenta.
49.hindi_meaning: ब्लास्टोसिस्ट की बाहरी परत जो भ्रूण को पोषण देती है और प्लेसेंटा का निर्माण करती है।
49.example: The trophoblast layer gets attached directly to the endometrial lining of the uterus.

49.english_meaning: The mucous membrane lining the uterus, which thickens during the menstrual cycle in preparation for possible implantation.
49.hindi_meaning: गर्भाशय की सबसे भीतर की परत जहाँ भ्रूण का रोपण (implantation) होता है।
49.example: The blastocyst becomes embedded deeply in the endometrium of the uterus.

49.english_meaning: The attachment of the fertilized egg or blastocyst to the wall of the uterus at the start of pregnancy.
49.hindi_meaning: गर्भाशय की दीवार से भ्रूण (ब्लास्टोसिस्ट) का चिपकना या रोपण होना।
49.example: Implantation leads to the establishment of pregnancy in females.

49.english_meaning: Finger-like projections arising from the trophoblast that interdigitate with uterine tissue to form the placenta.
49.hindi_meaning: ट्रोफब्लास्ट से निकलने वाली उंगली जैसी संरचनाएं जो प्लेसेंटा का निर्माण करती हैं।
49.example: Chorionic villi are surrounded by maternal blood and uterine tissue.

49.english_meaning: Interlocked like the fingers of folded hands.
49.hindi_meaning: उंगलियों की तरह आपस में गहराई से जुड़े हुए या फँसे हुए।
49.example: The chorionic villi and uterine tissue become interdigitated to form the placenta.

49.english_meaning: A temporary organ that connects the developing fetus to the uterine wall to allow nutrient uptake, waste elimination, and gas exchange.
49.hindi_meaning: वह अंग जो गर्भ में पल रहे बच्चे को माँ के शरीर से पोषण और ऑक्सीजन प्रदान करता है।
49.example: The placenta acts as a structural and functional unit between the embryo and the maternal body.

49.english_meaning: A flexible cord-like structure containing blood vessels connecting a fetus to the placenta.
49.hindi_meaning: नाल या रस्मी संरचना जो भ्रूण को प्लेसेंटा से जोड़ती है।
49.example: Nutrients and oxygen are transported to the embryo through the umbilical cord.

49.english_meaning: Tissue that secretes hormones directly into the bloodstream.
49.hindi_meaning: वह ऊतक जो सीधे रक्त में हार्मोन स्रावित करता है।
49.example: During pregnancy, the placenta also acts as an endocrine tissue.

49.english_meaning: Any of a group of hormones secreted by the pituitary gland or placenta that stimulate the gonads.
49.hindi_meaning: गर्भावस्था के दौरान प्लेसेंटा द्वारा स्रावित होने वाला एक विशिष्ट हार्मोन (hCG)।
49.example: Human chorionic gonadotropin is produced exclusively by women during pregnancy.

49.english_meaning: A hormone that stimulates milk production or lactation.
49.hindi_meaning: दूध के उत्पादन को प्रेरित करने वाला हार्मोन (जैसे hPL)।
49.example: Human placental lactogen plays a crucial role in maternal metabolic changes.

49.english_meaning: The process by which unspecialized cells develop into specialized cells with distinct functions.
49.hindi_meaning: कोशिकाओं का विशेष कार्यों के लिए विकसित और परिपक्व होना।
49.example: The inner cell mass gets differentiated into the embryo after attachment.

49.english_meaning: Relating to the chemical processes occurring within a living organism to maintain life.
49.hindi_meaning: शरीर के आंतरिक जैविक व रासायनिक परिवर्तनों (चयापचय) से संबंधित।
49.example: Hormones secreted during pregnancy support essential metabolic changes in the mother.

50.english_meaning: The outermost of the three primary germ layers of an embryo.
50.hindi_meaning: बाहरी जनन स्तर (भ्रूण की सबसे बाहरी परत)
50.example: The ectoderm gives rise to the nervous system and outer skin.

50.english_meaning: The innermost layer of cells or tissue of an embryo in early development.
50.hindi_meaning: आंतरिक जनन स्तर (भ्रूण की सबसे अंदरूनी परत)
50.example: The endoderm forms the lining of the digestive and respiratory tracts.

50.english_meaning: The middle layer of the three primary germ layers of an young embryo.
50.hindi_meaning: मध्य जनन स्तर (भ्रूण की बीच की परत)
50.example: Muscles, bones, and the circulatory system develop from the mesoderm.

50.english_meaning: Undifferentiated cells that have the potential to develop into many different types of cells.
50.hindi_meaning: मूल कोशिकाएं (ऐसी कोशिकाएं जिनमें विभिन्न अंगों में विकसित होने की क्षमता होती है)
50.example: Stem cells play a crucial role in growth, healing, and tissue regeneration.

50.english_meaning: An unborn offspring of a mammal, especially an unborn human more than eight weeks after conception.
50.example: The heartbeat of the foetus can be detected using a stethoscope.

50.english_meaning: A period of three months, particularly referring to the three periods of pregnancy.
50.hindi_meaning: गर्भावस्था की तीन महीने की अवधि (तिमाही)
50.example: Most major organ systems are formed by the end of the first trimester.

50.english_meaning: The process or period of developing inside the womb between conception and birth.
50.example: The average duration of human gestation is about 9 months.

50.english_meaning: The action of giving birth to young; childbirth.
50.hindi_meaning: प्रसव (बच्चे को जन्म देने की प्रक्रिया)
50.example: Parturition is induced by a complex neuroendocrine mechanism.

50.english_meaning: Relating to the interaction between the nervous system and the endocrine system.
50.hindi_meaning: तंत्रिका-अंतःस्रावी (तंत्रिका तंत्र और हॉर्मोन तंत्र से संबंधित)
50.example: Childbirth is regulated by a neuroendocrine feedback mechanism.

50.english_meaning: A circular organ in the uterus of pregnant mammals, nourishing the foetus through the umbilical cord.
50.hindi_meaning: अपरा (गर्भनाल जिसके जरिए भ्रूण को पोषण मिलता है)
50.example: The placenta acts as an endocrine tissue and produces hormones.

50.english_meaning: A hormone released by the pituitary gland that causes increased contraction of the uterus during labor.
50.hindi_meaning: ऑक्सीटोसिन (एक हॉर्मोन जो प्रसव के दौरान गर्भाशय में संकुचन पैदा करता है)
50.example: Doctors sometimes inject oxytocin to induce delivery.

50.english_meaning: Relating to the milk-producing glands of female mammals.
50.hindi_meaning: स्तन से संबंधित (दुग्ध ग्रंथियों से जुड़ा हुआ)
50.example: The mammary glands undergo structural differentiation during pregnancy.

50.english_meaning: The secretion of milk by the mammary glands.
50.hindi_meaning: दुग्धस्रावण (माता द्वारा दूध उत्पादन की प्रक्रिया)
50.example: Lactation helps the mother in feeding the newborn baby.

50.english_meaning: The first secretion of the mammary glands after giving birth, rich in antibodies.
50.hindi_meaning: खीस (प्रसव के बाद का शुरुआती दूध जो प्रतिरक्षी तत्वों से भरपूर होता है)
50.example: Colostrum contains several antibodies essential for newborn resistance.

50.english_meaning: Blood proteins produced in response to and counteracting specific antigens to provide immunity.
50.hindi_meaning: प्रतिपिंड (रोग प्रतिरोधक प्रोटीन जो संक्रमण से बचाते हैं)
50.example: Colostrum contains antibodies that protect the newborn from diseases.

52.english_meaning: A mature female reproductive cell (egg) that can divide to give rise to an embryo when fertilized by a male cell.
52.example: The process of release of an ovum from a mature follicle is called ovulation.

52.english_meaning: A small secretory cavity, sac, or gland, especially one in the ovary that contains a developing egg.
52.example: The process of release of ovum from a mature follicle is called ovulation.

52.english_meaning: The discharge of ova or eggs from the ovary, marking a crucial phase of the menstrual cycle.
52.example: Ovulation is induced by a surge in luteinizing hormone.

52.english_meaning: A mature haploid male or female germ cell which is able to unite with another of the opposite sex in sexual reproduction.
52.example: The fusion of male and female gametes results in the formation of a zygote.

52.english_meaning: The action or process of fertilizing an egg, female animal, or plant, involving the fusion of male and female gametes.
52.example: Fertilisation normally takes place in the ampulla of the fallopian tube.

52.english_meaning: A diploid cell resulting from the fusion of two haploid gametes; a fertilized ovum.
52.example: The zygote divides rapidly to form a blastocyst which is implanted in the uterus.

52.english_meaning: Relating to, affecting, or consisting of a vessel or vessels, especially those that carry blood.
52.example: The placenta provides a vascular connection between the foetus and the mother's uterus.

52.english_meaning: Producing or conveying semen, specifically applied to the fine tubules in the testes.
52.example: Spermatozoa are produced inside the seminiferous tubules.

52.english_meaning: The production or development of mature spermatozoa from germ cells in the testes.
52.example: Testosterone and FSH are hormones involved in the regulation of spermatogenesis.

52.english_meaning: The final stage of spermatogenesis, in which spermatids transform into mature spermatozoa.
52.example: During spermiogenesis, round spermatids are transformed into flagellated spermatozoa.

52.english_meaning: The process by which mature spermatozoa are released from Sertoli cells into the lumen of seminiferous tubules.
52.example: After spermiation, the sperm are transported by the male accessory ducts.

52.english_meaning: The production, growth, or development of an ovum in the ovary.
52.example: Unlike spermatogenesis, oogenesis begins during embryonic development in females.

52.english_meaning: The mucous membrane lining the uterus, which thickens during the menstrual cycle in preparation for possible implantation.
52.example: The breakdown of the endometrium leads to menstruation if fertilization does not occur.

52.english_meaning: The action of giving birth to young; child-birth.
52.example: Oxytocin is the primary hormone involved in the induction of parturition.

52.english_meaning: Relating to twins developed from separate fertilized eggs, and therefore not identical.
52.example: Fraternal twins share about fifty percent of their genes, just like normal siblings.

54.english_meaning: The production of new offspring by sexual or asexual process.
54.example: Reproduction is a biological process by which an organism makes a new organism similar to itself.

54.english_meaning: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.
54.example: Creating awareness about health issues is essential for a progressive society.

54.english_meaning: The act of spreading something, especially information, widely.
54.example: Teachers play a vital role in the dissemination of correct knowledge among students.

54.english_meaning: The transitional phase of growth and development between childhood and adulthood.
54.example: Adolescence is a period of rapid physical and psychological changes.

54.english_meaning: The deliberate use of artificial methods to prevent pregnancy.
54.example: Various methods of contraception help couples plan their families effectively.

54.english_meaning: The biological inability of an individual to contribute to conception.
54.example: Medical science offers various treatments to help couples suffering from infertility.

54.english_meaning: A medical procedure used to diagnose certain genetic disorders in a fetus by testing amniotic fluid.
54.hindi_meaning: एमनियोसेंटेसिस (भ्रूण की जांच की एक तकनीक)
54.example: Statutory ban has been imposed on amniocentesis for illegal sex-determination.

54.english_meaning: The deliberate killing of a foetus in the uterus; abortion of a foetus, especially on the basis of gender.
54.example: Female foeticide is a serious social crime and a punishable offense.

54.english_meaning: The action of making a person or animal immune to infection, typically by inoculation.
54.example: Child immunisation protects young ones from many deadly infectious diseases.

54.english_meaning: Required, permitted, or enacted by statute or law.
54.example: There is a statutory warning printed on every packet of tobacco products.

54.english_meaning: Relating to the basic physical and organizational structures and facilities needed for operation.
54.example: Strong infrastructural facilities are required for implementing effective healthcare programs.

54.english_meaning: Expert skill or knowledge in a particular field.
54.example: Medical expertise is vital for handling complicated pregnancy cases.

54.english_meaning: A disruption of normal physical or mental functions.
54.example: Genetic disorders can be detected through prenatal testing methods.

54.english_meaning: A view or opinion that is incorrect because it is based on faulty thinking or understanding.
54.example: Education helps people overcome superstitions and misconceptions regarding health.

54.english_meaning: The state or fact of continuing to live or exist.
54.example: Doctors checked the genetic report to determine the survivability of the foetus.

55.english_meaning: Relating to the period following the birth of a child, especially concerning the mother or newborn.
55.hindi_meaning: प्रसवोत्तर (बच्चे के जन्म के बाद का)
55.example: Good post-natal care is essential for the health of both the mother and the newborn infant.

55.english_meaning: Relating to or characteristic of a mother.
55.example: Efforts are being made across the country to reduce the maternal mortality rate.

55.english_meaning: The state of being subject to death; the number of deaths in a given area or period.
55.example: Improved medical facilities have significantly lowered infant mortality rates.

55.english_meaning: The action of making something stable or the process of becoming stable.
55.example: Population stabilisation is crucial for the sustainable development of any nation.

55.english_meaning: Increasing or expanding very rapidly and suddenly.
55.example: The explosive growth of the population has put immense pressure on natural resources.

55.english_meaning: An official count or survey of a population, typically recording various details of individuals.
55.example: According to the 2011 census report, the population growth rate showed a decline.

55.english_meaning: Worrying or disturbing; causing fear or anxiety.
55.example: The alarming rise in pollution levels requires immediate action from the government.

55.english_meaning: The state of being scarce or in short supply; shortage.
55.example: Rapid population growth can lead to an absolute scarcity of basic resources.

55.english_meaning: A method or device used to prevent pregnancy.
55.example: Various contraceptive methods are used to prevent unwanted pregnancies and plan families.

55.english_meaning: Required, permitted, or enacted by statute or law.
55.example: There is a statutory raising of the marriageable age for females to 18 years.

55.english_meaning: A thing that motivates or encourages one to do something.
55.example: The government offers incentives to couples who adopt small family norms.

55.english_meaning: Able to be reversed or turned back to a previous state.
55.hindi_meaning: उत्क्रमणीय (जिसे पहले जैसी स्थिति में लाया जा सके)
55.example: An ideal contraceptive method should be safe, effective, and reversible.

55.english_meaning: An obstacle or hindrance, or in medical terms, a device that blocks sperm from reaching the egg.
55.example: Condoms are a common type of barrier method used during sexual acts.

55.english_meaning: A piece of tissue, metal, or device placed in the body, such as long-term hormonal contraceptives.
55.example: Sub-dermal implants are one of the modern medical methods used for birth control.

55.english_meaning: Relating to or involving surgical operations.
55.example: Surgical methods like vasectomy and tubectomy act as permanent contraceptive options.

56.english_meaning: The practice of restraining oneself from indulging in something, such as sexual intercourse.
56.example: Periodic abstinence is a natural method of birth control.
Couples avoid coitus during the fertile period to prevent conception.

56.english_meaning: The discharge of ova or eggs from the ovary.
56.example: Ovulation typically occurs midway through the menstrual cycle.

56.english_meaning: The action or process of fertilizing an egg involving the fusion of male and female gametes.
56.example: The chances of fertilisation are very high during the fertile period.

56.english_meaning: The action of conceiving a child or of a egg being fertilized.
The introduction of semen into a female tract.
56.example: Withdrawal method helps to avoid insemination.

56.english_meaning: Temporary absence of menstruation following childbirth during intense lactation.
56.hindi_meaning: स्तनपान के दौरान आर्तव निवृत्ति (मासिक धर्म का अनुपस्थित रहना)
56.example: Lactational amenorrhea acts as a natural method of birth control.

56.english_meaning: The action of giving birth to young; child-birth.
56.example: Intense lactation following parturition suppresses the menstrual cycle.

56.english_meaning: A fence or other obstacle that prevents movement or access.
56.example: Condoms are used as barrier methods to prevent pregnancy.

56.english_meaning: The narrow necklike passage forming the lower end of the uterus.
56.example: Diaphragms are inserted to cover the cervix during coitus.

56.english_meaning: The ingestion of bacteria or other material by phagocytes and amoeboid protozoans.
56.example: IUDs increase phagocytosis of sperms within the uterus.

56.english_meaning: The ability of organisms and parts to move spontaneously.
56.example: Copper ions suppress the motility of sperms.

56.english_meaning: Intended to be discarded after use.

86.english_meaning: Prevented from developing, acting, or being expressed.
86.example: Its effect is suppressed by her matching dominant normal gene.

86.english_meaning: The passing of something from one person, place, or generation to another.
86.hindi_meaning: संचरण (एक पीढ़ी से दूसरी पीढ़ी में पहुँचना)
86.example: This sex-linked recessive disease shows its transmission from unaffected carrier female to some of the male progeny.

86.english_meaning: Descendants of a person, animal, or plant; offspring.

86.english_meaning: A process where a succession of chemical reactions or events occurs successively.

86.english_meaning: The recorded ancestry, especially upper-class ancestry, of a person or animal.

86.english_meaning: A person, plant, or animal that is descended from a particular ancestor.
86.example: Queen Victoria had a number of haemophilic descendants as she was a carrier.

86.english_meaning: Any chromosome that is not a sex chromosome.

86.english_meaning: One of two or more alternative forms of a gene that arise by mutation.

86.english_meaning: The genetic constitution of an individual organism.

86.english_meaning: The observable set of characteristics of an individual resulting from the interaction of its genotype with the environment.

86.english_meaning: The action of replacing someone or something with another person or thing.

87.english_meaning: The action of replacing someone or something with another person or thing.

87.example: The substitution of a single base in the DNA sequence causes sickle-cell anaemia.

87.english_meaning: A chemical process that combines several small molecules to form a large molecule.
87.hindi_meaning: बहुलीकरण (छोटे अणुओं का आपस में जुड़कर बड़ी श्रृंखला बनाना)

87.english_meaning: Relating to an autosome (any chromosome that is not a sex chromosome).
87.hindi_meaning: अलिंगसूत्रीय / ऑटोसोमल (लिंग गुणसूत्रों के अलावा अन्य गुणसूत्रों से संबंधित)

87.english_meaning: The acquisition or gradual gathering of something.
87.example: The accumulation of phenylalanine in the brain results in mental retardation.

87.english_meaning: An inherited blood disorder characterized by less oxygen-carrying protein and fewer red blood cells.
87.example: Thalassemia is an autosome-linked recessive blood disease.

87.english_meaning: Having two different alleles of a particular gene or genes.
87.hindi_meaning: विषमयुग्मजी (जब किसी जीन के दोनों युग्म विकल्प भिन्न हों)

87.english_meaning: The production of chemical compounds by reaction from simpler materials.

87.example: Failure of segregation of chromatids during cell division results in aneuploidy.

87.english_meaning: Each of the two thread-like strands into which a chromosome divides during cell division.
87.hindi_meaning: क्रोमैटिड (गुणसूत्र की दो समान धागे जैसी संरचनाएं)
87.example: Failure of segregation of chromatids results in the gain or loss of a chromosome.

87.english_meaning: The presence of an abnormal number of chromosomes in a cell.
87.hindi_meaning: असुगुणिता / एन्यूप्लॉइडर (गुणसूत्रों की संख्या में असमानता या कमी-बेसी)

87.english_meaning: The cytoplasmic division of a cell at the end of mitosis or meiosis.
87.hindi_meaning: कोशिकाद्रव्य विभाजन (कोशिका विभाजन के अंत में साइटोप्लाज्म का बंटवारा)

87.english_meaning: The heritable condition of possessing more than two complete sets of chromosomes.
87.hindi_meaning: बहुगुणिता (गुणसूत्रों के संपूर्ण सेटों की संख्या में वृद्धि)
87.example: Polyploidy is a phenomenon often seen in plants.

87.english_meaning: A chromosome that is not a sex chromosome.
87.example: Out of 23 pairs of human chromosomes, 22 pairs are autosomes.

88.english_meaning: A condition in which an extra copy of a chromosome is present in the cell nuclei.
88.hindi_meaning: त्रिसूत्रता (कोशिकाओं में किसी गुणसूत्र की एक अतिरिक्त प्रति की उपस्थिति)
88.example: Down's syndrome is caused by the trisomy of chromosome number 21.

88.english_meaning: The condition of having a diploid chromosome complement in which one (usually abnormal) chromosome is missing.
88.hindi_meaning: एकसूत्रता (गुणसूत्रों के जोड़े में से एक गुणसूत्र का गायब होना)
88.example: Monosomy results in the absence of one of the chromosomes from a pair.

88.english_meaning: Medical conditions caused by an absence of or defect in a chromosome, or by an extra chromosome.
88.hindi_meaning: गुणसूत्र विकार (गुणसूत्रों की संख्या या संरचना में असामान्यता के कारण होने वाले रोग)
88.example: Turner's syndrome and Down's syndrome are well-known chromosomal disorders.

88.english_meaning: A disease caused by an abnormality in an individual's DNA or chromosomes.
88.hindi_meaning: आनुवंशिक विकार (जीन या गुणसूत्रों में असामान्यता के कारण होने वाली बीमारी)
88.example: A genetic disorder can be inherited from parents or caused by a new mutation.

88.english_meaning: The number and visual appearance of the chromosomes in the cell nuclei of an organism or species.
88.hindi_meaning: कैरीोटाइप (किसी जीव की कोशिकाओं में गुणसूत्रों की संख्या और उनकी आकृति का आरेख)
88.example: Klinefelter's syndrome results in a karyotype of 47, XXY.

88.english_meaning: The development of abnormally large mammary glands in males, resulting in breast enlargement.
88.hindi_meaning: गाइनेकोमैस्टिया (पुरुषों में स्तनों का असामान्य विकास)
88.example: Feminine development such as gynaecomastia is expressed in individuals with Klinefelter's syndrome.

88.english_meaning: Not able to produce children or offspring.
88.hindi_meaning: बंजर या जननक्षम, संताउत्पत्ति में असमर्थ (बांझ)
88.example: Individuals with Turner's syndrome are sterile as their ovaries are rudimentary.

88.english_meaning: Limited to basic principles; of a primitive, undeveloped, or basic form.
88.hindi_meaning: अल्पविकसित, प्रारंभिक या अविकसित अवस्था में
88.example: The ovaries in Turner's syndrome females are small and rudimentary.

88.english_meaning: Relating to the origination of movement in conscious mental activity.
88.hindi_meaning: मनो-प्रेरक (मानसिक गतिविधियों द्वारा नियंत्रित शारीरिक गतिविधियां)
88.example: Children with Down's syndrome often show retarded physical and psychomotor development.
The affected individual is short statured with a small round head.

88.english_meaning: A disease or physical abnormality present from birth.
88.example: Congenital heart disease is one of the medical issues associated with Down's syndrome.

88.english_meaning: Marked with trenches, grooves, or wrinkles.
88.example: The patient had a characteristic furrowed tongue and a partially open mouth.

88.english_meaning: Less advanced in mental, physical, or social development than is usual for one's age.
88.hindi_meaning: अवरुद्ध या मंदित (जिसका विकास धीमा या रुका हुआ हो)

88.english_meaning: Having qualities or appearance traditionally associated with men.

88.english_meaning: Having qualities or appearance traditionally associated with women.
88.example: Some feminine characters are expressed in Klinefelter's syndrome due to an extra X chromosome.

89.english_meaning: The branch of biology that studies heredity and variation in living organisms.
89.example: Genetics helps us understand how traits are passed from parents to offspring.

89.english_meaning: Descendants or offspring of a person, animal, or plant.
89.example: The plant produced progeny with purple flowers.

89.english_meaning: Alternative forms of a gene that arise by mutation and are found at the same place on a chromosome.
89.example: Each parent contributes one allele for every gene to their offspring.

89.english_meaning: Having two different alleles of a particular gene or genes.
89.example: A heterozygous organism carries two different versions of a gene.

89.english_meaning: Having identical alleles for a particular gene on both homologous chromosomes.
89.example: Recessive traits are only expressed in homozygous conditions.

89.english_meaning: To separate or divide along certain lines, such as alleles separating during gamete formation.
89.example: Alleles segregate during the formation of gametes.

89.english_meaning: A relationship between two versions of a gene where both alleles are simultaneously expressed in the heterozygote.
89.example: Blood group AB is a classic example of co-dominance in humans.

89.english_meaning: The genetic constitution of an individual organism.
89.example: An organism's genotype determines its potential physical characteristics.

89.english_meaning: The set of observable characteristics of an individual resulting from the interaction of its genotype with the environment.
89.example: Tallness is the phenotype of the pea plant.

89.english_meaning: A type of cell division that results in four daughter cells each with half the number of chromosomes of the parent cell.
89.example: Meiosis ensures the production of haploid gametes.

89.english_meaning: The rearrangement of genetic material, especially by crossing over in chromosomes.
89.example: Recombination leads to genetic diversity in offspring.

89.english_meaning: Any chromosome that is not a sex chromosome.
89.example: Humans have 22 pairs of autosomes in their somatic cells.

89.english_meaning: The changing of the structure of a gene, resulting in a variant form that may be transmitted to subsequent generations.
89.example: A random mutation in the DNA sequence caused the genetic disorder.

89.english_meaning: A red protein responsible for transporting oxygen in the blood of vertebrates.
89.example: Sickle-cell anemia is caused by a defect in the beta-chain of hemoglobin.

89.english_meaning: The recorded ancestry of a person or family, often used in genetics to track inheritance of traits.
89.example: Geneticists analyzed the family pedigree to trace the inherited disease.

90.english_meaning: The phenomenon where one variant of a gene masks or suppresses the effect of another variant at the same locus.
90.example: The law of dominance states that dominant alleles mask recessive alleles in a heterozygous organism.

90.english_meaning: Relating to a genetic trait that is expressed only when two copies of the gene are present.

90.english_meaning: Having two identical alleles of a particular gene or genes.

90.english_meaning: Having two different alleles of a particular gene or genes.

90.english_meaning: Relating to a cross between two organisms with different variations at one genetic locus of interest.

90.english_meaning: Relating to a cross between two organisms that are identically hybrid for two traits.
90.example: A dihybrid cross helps to demonstrate the independent assortment of two different genes.

90.english_meaning: A mature haploid male or female germ cell that is able to unite with another of the opposite sex in sexual reproduction.

90.english_meaning: The recorded ancestry of a person or family, used in genetics to track inherited traits.

90.english_meaning: A relationship between two versions of a gene where both alleles are separately expressed in the phenotype.

90.english_meaning: The changing of the structure of a gene, resulting in a variant form that may be transmitted to subsequent generations.

90.english_meaning: The condition in which a cell or organism has more than two paired sets of chromosomes.

90.english_meaning: The presence of an abnormal number of chromosomes in a cell.

91.english_meaning: The process by which genetic characteristics are passed from parents to offspring.

91.english_meaning: Substances consisting of large molecules made of many smaller, repeating units linked together.

91.example: The genetic code determines the specific sequence of amino acids in proteins.

91.english_meaning: The process of controlling or directing a biological system or cellular process.

91.english_meaning: The complete set of genes or genetic material present in a cell or organism.

93.hindi_meaning: पिरिमिडिन (नाइट्रोजनयुक्त क्षारक जैसे साइटोसिन और थाइमिन)

94.english_meaning: The state of being stable, resistant to change, or enduring.

95.hindi_meaning: बहुलक / कई छोटी इकाइयों से मिलकर बना एक बड़ा अणु
95.example: DNA is a long polymer made up of nucleotide subunits.

95.hindi_meaning: प्रोकैरियोट / ऐसे जीव जिनमें स्पष्ट केन्द्रक नहीं पाया जाता है

95.example: In E. coli, the negatively charged DNA is held in a region termed as nucleoid.

95.english_meaning: Organisms whose cells have a distinct, membrane-bound nucleus containing genetic material.
95.hindi_meaning: यूकैरियोट / ऐसे जीव जिनकी कोशिकाओं में सुविकसित केन्द्रक होता है
95.example: Human cells are examples of complex eukaryotes.

95.english_meaning: Highly alkaline proteins found in eukaryotic cell nuclei that package and order the DNA into structural units.
95.hindi_meaning: हिस्टोन / क्षारीय प्रोटीन जो डीएनए को संवेष्टित करने में मदद करते हैं
95.example: Histones are rich in basic amino acid residues like lysine and arginine.

95.english_meaning: A specific monomeric unit that forms part of a polymer chain, such as an amino acid in a protein.
95.hindi_meaning: अवशेष / बहुलक श्रृंखला का एक विशिष्ट हिस्सा या इकाई
95.example: The protein contains multiple amino acid residues with charged side chains.

95.english_meaning: An oligomeric protein structure consisting of eight protein subunits.
95.hindi_meaning: ऑक्टामर / आठ अणुओं से मिलकर बना एक समूह या एकक
95.example: Histones are organised to form a unit of eight molecules called a histone octamer.

95.english_meaning: The basic structural unit of eukaryotic chromatin, consisting of a segment of DNA wound in sequence round a histone core.
95.hindi_meaning: न्यूक्लियोसोम / हिस्टोन ऑक्टामर के चारों ओर लिपटे डीएनए की संरचना
95.example: A typical nucleosome contains 200 base pairs of DNA helix.

95.english_meaning: The material of which the chromosomes of organisms other than bacteria are composed, consisting of protein, RNA, and DNA.
95.hindi_meaning: क्रोमैटिन / डीएनए और प्रोटीन से बना धागे जैसा आनुवंशिक पदार्थ
95.example: Nucleosomes constitute the repeating unit of a structure in the nucleus called chromatin.

95.hindi_meaning: क्रमागत / लगातार एक के बाद एक
95.example: The distance between two consecutive base pairs is 0.34 nm.

95.hindi_meaning: आयाम या आकार / माप या परिमाण

95.hindi_meaning: प्रचुरता / किसी चीज़ की अधिक मात्रा

95.english_meaning: Made denser or more compact; packed closely together.

95.hindi_meaning: सामूहिक रूप से / एक साथ मिलकर

96.example: Non-histone Chromosomal proteins play an essential role in packaging DNA within the nucleus.

96.english_meaning: The material of which the chromosomes of organisms other than bacteria are composed, consisting of protein, RNA, and DNA.
96.hindi_meaning: क्रोमैटिन (DNA और प्रोटीन का परिसर जिससे गुणसूत्र बनते हैं)

96.english_meaning: The less condensed form of chromatin that is available for transcription.
96.hindi_meaning: यूक्रोमैटिन (क्रोमैटिन का वह कम संघनित भाग जो अनुलेखन रूप से सक्रिय होता है)
96.example: Euchromatin is transcriptionally active chromatin found within the nucleus.

96.english_meaning: The more densely packed form of chromatin that is generally inactive.
96.hindi_meaning: हेटरोक्रोमैटिन (क्रोमैटिन का अधिक संघनित और निष्क्रिय भाग)

96.english_meaning: In a manner relating to the process of copying genetic information from DNA to RNA.
96.hindi_meaning: अनुलेखनात्मक रूप से (RNA के निर्माण की प्रक्रिया के संदर्भ में)

96.english_meaning: A thorough or dramatic change in form or appearance, or the genetic alteration of a cell.

97.english_meaning: After a particular thing has happened; afterward.

98.english_meaning: Serving as a sign or pointer to something; showing.
98.example: The radioactive results, indicating the presence of DNA, proved the hypothesis.

From the foregoing discussion, the conclusion became apparent.

98.english_meaning: In a way that leaves no doubt; clearly and unambiguously.
98.hindi_meaning: स्पष्ट रूप से / बिना किसी संदेह के

98.english_meaning: Settled or found a solution to a problem or debate.

98.english_meaning: After a particular thing has happened; afterward.

98.english_meaning: A scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

99.english_meaning: The process by which genetic information is passed on from parents to offspring.

99.english_meaning: A virus that parasitizes a bacterium.

100.english_meaning: A substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change.

100.english_meaning: A substance produced by a living organism that acts as a catalyst to bring about a specific biochemical reaction.

100.english_meaning: Tending to react chemically; unstable and prone to change.
100.hindi_meaning: क्रियाशील या प्रतिक्रियाशील (जो आसानी से रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया करे)।

100.english_meaning: Suggest or assume the existence, fact, or truth of something as a basis for reasoning.

100.english_meaning: Relating to DNA replication where each new DNA molecule contains one original strand and one newly synthesized strand.
100.hindi_meaning: अर्ध-संरक्षी (डीएनए प्रतिकृति जिसमें एक स्ट्रैंड पुराना और एक नया होता है)।

101.english_meaning: The process of passing on traits from parents to offspring.
