102.english_meaning: Offspring resulting from crossbreeding between two different species or varieties, or molecules made of mixed components.
102.hindi_meaning: संकर (दो अलग-अलग स्रोतों या घटकों से मिलकर बना)
102.example: The experiment produced a molecule composed of hybrid DNA.

102.english_meaning: Thread-like structures located inside the nucleus of animal and plant cells, carrying genetic information in the form of genes.
102.hindi_meaning: गुणसूत्र (कोशिका के केंद्रक में स्थित धागे जैसी संरचनाएं जो आनुवंशिक जानकारी ले जाती हैं)
102.example: Taylor and colleagues detected the distribution of newly synthesised DNA in the chromosomes.

102.english_meaning: To make an exact copy or reproduce, especially in the context of DNA or biological cells.
102.hindi_meaning: प्रतिरूप बनाना या प्रतिकृति तैयार करना (डीएनए का अपनी ही तरह दूसरा रूप बनाना)
102.example: The experiments proved that the DNA in chromosomes also replicates semiconservatively.

102.english_meaning: Substances that increase the rate of a chemical reaction without themselves undergoing any permanent chemical change.
102.hindi_meaning: उत्प्रेरक (वे पदार्थ जो रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया की गति को बढ़ाते हैं)
102.example: The process of replication requires a set of catalysts known as enzymes.

102.english_meaning: Biological molecules (typically proteins) that act as catalysts in living organisms to speed up chemical reactions.
102.hindi_meaning: एन्जाइम (जैविक उत्प्रेरक जो शरीर की रासायनिक प्रतिक्रियाओं को तेज करते हैं)
102.example: The main enzyme involved is referred to as DNA-dependent DNA polymerase.

102.english_meaning: An enzyme that brings about the formation of a particular polymer, especially DNA or RNA.
102.hindi_meaning: पॉलीमरेज़ (वह एन्जाइम जो डीएनए या आरएनए के बहुलकीकरण को उत्प्रेरित करता है)
102.example: DNA-dependent DNA polymerase uses a template to catalyse polymerisation.

102.english_meaning: A molecular structure that serves as a pattern for the generation of a complementary strand of nucleic acid.
102.hindi_meaning: सांचा या टेंपलेट (एक पैटर्न जिस पर आधारित नया अणु बनता है)
102.example: The enzyme uses a DNA template to catalyse the polymerisation of deoxynucleotides.

102.english_meaning: The chemical process of combining many small molecules (monomers) to form a large chain-like molecule.
102.hindi_meaning: बहुलकीकरण (छोटे अणुओं से मिलकर एक बड़ी श्रृंखला बनाने की प्रक्रिया)
102.example: The average rate of polymerisation has to be approximately 2000 base pairs per second.

102.english_meaning: The basic structural units and building blocks of nucleic acids like DNA and RNA.
102.hindi_meaning: न्यूक्लियोटाइड्स (डीएनए और आरएनए की मूल इकाइयां)
102.example: These enzymes catalyse the polymerisation of a large number of nucleotides in a short time.

102.english_meaning: Permanent alterations in the nucleotide sequence of the genome of an organism.
102.hindi_meaning: उत्परिवर्तन (आनुवंशिक पदार्थ में अचानक होने वाला स्थायी परिवर्तन)
102.example: Any mistake during replication would result into mutations.

102.english_meaning: The substance on which an enzyme acts to form a product during a biochemical reaction.
102.hindi_meaning: क्रियाधार या सबस्ट्रेट (वह पदार्थ जिस पर एन्जाइम काम करता है)
102.example: In addition to acting as substrates, they provide energy for polymerisation.

102.english_meaning: The Y-shaped region of a DNA molecule where the two strands separate and new strands are synthesized.
102.hindi_meaning: प्रतिकृति द्विविभाजन या फोर्क (डीएनए के खुलने का स्थान जहां नया स्ट्रैंड बनता है)
102.example: The replication occurs within a small opening of the DNA helix, referred to as the replication fork.

102.english_meaning: Forming an unbroken whole; without interruption or cessation.
102.example: On one template strand, the replication is continuous.

102.english_meaning: Lacking continuity or marked by breaks, intervals, or interruptions.
102.hindi_meaning: असतत या रुक-रुक कर होने वाला
102.example: On the other template strand, the replication is discontinuous.

102.english_meaning: An enzyme that can catalyze the joining of two large molecules by forming a new chemical bond.
102.hindi_meaning: लाइगेज (वह एन्जाइम जो डीएनए के खंडों को आपस में जोड़ता है)
102.example: The discontinuously synthesised fragments are later joined by the enzyme DNA ligase.

103.english_meaning: The action of copying or reproducing something, particularly DNA.
103.hindi_meaning: प्रतिकृति; डीएनए की हूबहू नकल तैयार करने की प्रक्रिया
103.example: The replication of DNA takes place during the S-phase of the cell-cycle.

103.english_meaning: Breed specimens of a plant or animal by natural processes from the parent stock, or multiply/spread in molecular terms.
103.hindi_meaning: संवर्धित करना; आगे बढ़ाना या बढ़ाना
103.example: A piece of DNA needs to be propagated during recombinant DNA procedures using a vector.

103.english_meaning: An organism or DNA molecule used as a vehicle to artificially carry foreign genetic material into another cell.
103.hindi_meaning: वाहक; डीएनए खंड को दूसरी जगह ले जाने वाला माध्यम
103.example: The vectors provide the necessary origin of replication.

103.english_meaning: Organisms consisting of a cell or cells in which the genetic material is DNA in the form of chromosomes contained within a distinct nucleus.
103.hindi_meaning: सकेन्द्रकीय जीव; ऐसे जीव जिनकी कोशिकाओं में विकसित केंद्रक होता है
103.example: In eukaryotes, the replication of DNA takes place at the S-phase of the cell-cycle.

103.english_meaning: Organized properly so that the different parts work well together.
103.example: The replication of DNA and cell division cycle should be highly coordinated.

103.english_meaning: The condition in which a cell or organism has more than two paired sets of chromosomes.
103.hindi_meaning: बहुगुणित्ता; गुणसूत्रों के दो से अधिक पूरे सेट होने की स्थिति
103.example: A failure in cell division after DNA replication results in polyploidy.

103.english_meaning: Something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected.
103.example: Polyploidy is considered a chromosomal anomaly.

103.english_meaning: The process of copying genetic information from one strand of the DNA into RNA.
103.hindi_meaning: अनुलेखन; डीएनए से आरएनए में आनुवंशिक सूचना की नकल करने की प्रक्रिया
103.example: The process of copying genetic information from DNA into RNA is termed as transcription.

103.english_meaning: The relationship between two structures where each has a corresponding characteristic to the other, such as base-pairing in nucleic acids.
103.hindi_meaning: पूरकता; नाइट्रोजन क्षारों का एक-दूसरे के अनुरूप होना
103.example: The principle of complementarity governs the process of transcription.

103.english_meaning: Made an exact copy or copies of.
103.hindi_meaning: द्विगुणित; बिल्कुल वैसी ही नकल तैयार करना
103.example: In replication, the total DNA of an organism gets duplicated.

103.english_meaning: To set the boundaries or limits of something.
103.hindi_meaning: सीमा तय करना; क्षेत्र निर्धारित करना
103.example: This necessitates defining the boundaries that would demarcate the region of DNA.

103.english_meaning: A molecular structure such as a strand of DNA that guides the synthesis of a complementary molecule.
103.hindi_meaning: सांचा या टेंपलेट; जिसके आधार पर नई प्रतिकृति बनती है
103.example: If both strands act as a template, they would code for RNA molecules with different sequences.
The two RNA molecules if produced simultaneously would form a double-stranded RNA.

103.english_meaning: Incapable of producing any useful result; pointless.
103.example: The exercise of transcription would become a futile one if double-stranded RNA is formed.

103.english_meaning: A section of genetic sequence that marks the end of gene transcription.
103.hindi_meaning: समापक; अनुलेखन प्रक्रिया को समाप्त करने वाला क्षेत्र
103.example: A transcription unit in DNA is defined primarily by a promoter, structural gene, and a terminator.

104.english_meaning: A way in which something is usually done, especially within a particular area or activity.
104.example: There is a convention in defining the two strands of DNA.

104.english_meaning: The state of having two opposite or contradictory tendencies or directions, such as 5' and 3' ends in DNA.
104.example: The two strands of the DNA have opposite polarity.

104.english_meaning: To cause or accelerate a chemical reaction by means of a catalyst.
104.hindi_meaning: उत्प्रेरित करना (रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया की गति बढ़ाना)
104.example: DNA-dependent RNA polymerase helps to catalyse the polymerisation.

104.english_meaning: A process of reacting monomer molecules together in a chemical reaction to form polymer chains.
104.example: The enzyme catalyses the polymerisation in only one direction, that is, 5' to 3'.

104.english_meaning: The strand of DNA that is used by RNA polymerase to guide the synthesis of mRNA.
104.hindi_meaning: सांचा रज्जु (डीएनए का वह स्ट्रैंड जिस पर आरएनए बनता है)
104.example: The strand with the polarity 3' to 5' acts as a template strand.

104.english_meaning: Moved from its original or usual place.
104.hindi_meaning: विस्थापित; अपनी जगह से हटाया गया
104.example: The other strand is displaced during transcription.

104.english_meaning: The strand of a DNA gene that has the same sequence as the mRNA except with thymine instead of uracil.
104.hindi_meaning: कोडिंग रज्जु (जिसका अनुक्रम आरएनए जैसा होता है)
104.example: All the reference points while defining a transcription unit are made with the coding strand.

104.english_meaning: Based on guessed data or a tentative idea rather than a proven fact.
104.example: A hypothetical sequence from a transcription unit is represented below.

104.english_meaning: To make a written copy of or translate genetic information from DNA into RNA.
104.hindi_meaning: प्रतिलेखन किया हुआ (डीएनए से आरएनए में बदला हुआ)
104.example: Can you now write the sequence of RNA transcribed from the above DNA?

104.english_meaning: A region of DNA that initiates transcription of a particular gene.
104.hindi_meaning: संवर्धक या प्रमोटर (वह डीएनए अनुक्रम जो आरएनए पोलीमरेज़ को जोड़ता है)
104.example: The promoter and terminator flank the structural gene in a transcription unit.

104.english_meaning: A section of genetic sequence that marks the end of gene transcription.
104.hindi_meaning: समापक (प्रतिलेखन को समाप्त करने वाला क्षेत्र)
104.example: The terminator usually defines the end of the process of transcription.

104.english_meaning: Located towards the 5'-end of the coding strand relative to a gene.
104.hindi_meaning: ऊपर की ओर (5'-सिरे की दिशा में)
104.example: The promoter is said to be located towards the 5'-end (upstream) of the structural gene.

104.english_meaning: Located towards the 3'-end of the coding strand relative to a gene.
104.hindi_meaning: नीचे की ओर (3'-सिरे की दिशा में)
104.example: The terminator is located towards the 3'-end (downstream) of the coding strand.

104.english_meaning: Serving or intended to regulate something, such as gene expression.
104.example: There are additional regulatory sequences that may be present further upstream.

104.english_meaning: The quality of being open to more than one interpretation; inexactness.
104.example: Though there is no ambiguity that the genes are located on the DNA.

105.english_meaning: A segment of DNA corresponding to a specific polypeptide chain; a gene.
105.hindi_meaning: डीएनए का वह खंड जो एक पॉलीपेप्टाइड श्रृंखला के लिए कोड करता है; जीन।
105.example: A cistron is often defined as a segment of DNA coding for a polypeptide.

105.english_meaning: Describing a structural gene that codes for a single protein molecule, typical of eukaryotes.
105.hindi_meaning: एक संरचनात्मक जीन जो एक ही प्रोटीन अणु के लिए कोड करता है, जो यूकेरियोट्स में आम है।
105.example: Structural genes in eukaryotes are mostly monocistronic.

105.english_meaning: Describing a mRNA molecule or structural gene that codes for multiple proteins, typical of bacteria.
105.hindi_meaning: एक एमआरएनए अणु या संरचनात्मक जीन जो कई प्रोटीनों के लिए कोड करता है, जो बैक्टीरिया में पाया जाता है।
105.example: Prokaryotic genes are often polycistronic, coding for more than one protein.

105.english_meaning: Organisms whose cells have a distinct membrane-bound nucleus.
105.hindi_meaning: वे जीव जिनकी कोशिकाओं में एक स्पष्ट केंद्रक (nucleus) होता है।
105.example: In eukaryotes, the DNA is enclosed within a nuclear membrane.

105.english_meaning: Single-celled organisms that lack a distinct nucleus, such as bacteria.
105.hindi_meaning: एककोशिकीय जीव जिनमें स्पष्ट केंद्रक नहीं होता है, जैसे बैक्टीरिया।
105.example: Bacteria and archaea are examples of prokaryotes.

105.english_meaning: The segments of DNA or RNA that code for proteins and appear in mature RNA.
105.hindi_meaning: डीएनए या आरएनए के वे खंड जो प्रोटीन के लिए कोड करते हैं और परिपक्व आरएनए में मौजूद रहते हैं।
105.example: Exons are the expressed sequences of a split gene.

105.english_meaning: Intervening sequences within a gene that do not code for proteins and are removed during RNA processing.
105.hindi_meaning: जीन के भीतर के वे अनुक्रम जो प्रोटीन के लिए कोड नहीं करते और आरएनए परिपक्वता के दौरान हटा दिए जाते हैं।
105.example: Introns are intervening sequences that do not appear in mature RNA.

105.english_meaning: The process of copying genetic information from one strand of DNA into RNA.
105.hindi_meaning: डीएनए के एक रज्जु से आनुवंशिक सूचना को आरएनए में प्रतिलिपि करने की प्रक्रिया।
105.example: RNA polymerase catalyses the transcription of DNA into RNA.

105.english_meaning: A DNA sequence located near a gene where RNA polymerase binds to initiate transcription.
105.hindi_meaning: जीन के पास स्थित डीएनए अनुक्रम जहां आरएनए पॉलीमरेज बाइंड होकर ट्रांसक्रिप्शन शुरू करता है।
105.example: The RNA polymerase enzyme binds to the promoter to initiate transcription.

105.english_meaning: Serving to control or direct a biological process.
105.hindi_meaning: किसी जैविक प्रक्रिया को नियंत्रित या निर्देशित करने वाला।
105.example: Regulatory sequences affect the inheritance and expression of a character.

105.english_meaning: A molecular mold or pattern that guides the synthesis of a complementary molecule.
105.hindi_meaning: एक सांचा जो किसी पूरक अणु के निर्माण का मार्गदर्शन करता है।
105.example: The mRNA provides the template for protein synthesis.

105.english_meaning: Functioning to accelerate or facilitate a chemical reaction.
105.hindi_meaning: किसी रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया को तेज या सुगम बनाने का कार्य करने वाला।
105.example: Ribosomal RNAs play structural and catalytic roles during translation.

105.english_meaning: An enzyme that brings about the formation of a particular polymer, especially DNA or RNA.
105.hindi_meaning: एक एंजाइम जो डीएनए या आरएनए जैसे बहुलक (polymer) के निर्माण को उत्प्रेरित करता है।
105.example: There is a single DNA-dependent RNA polymerase in bacteria.

105.english_meaning: The action of beginning or starting a process, such as transcription.
105.hindi_meaning: किसी प्रक्रिया, जैसे कि ट्रांसक्रिप्शन को शुरू करने की क्रिया।
105.example: RNA polymerase binds to the promoter and initiates transcription.

105.english_meaning: The substance on which an enzyme acts to form a product.
105.hindi_meaning: वह पदार्थ जिस पर एंजाइम क्रिया करके उत्पाद बनाता है।
105.example: RNA polymerase uses nucleoside triphosphates as substrate.

106.english_meaning: To combine small molecules (monomers) to form a larger chain-like molecule (polymer).
106.hindi_meaning: बहुलकीकरण करना (छोटे अणुओं को जोड़कर बड़ी श्रृंखला बनाना)
106.example: The enzyme polymerises nucleotides in a template-dependent fashion.

106.english_meaning: The relationship between two structures, like DNA strands, where base pairs precisely match each other.
106.hindi_meaning: पूरकता (नाइट्रोजन क्षारों का विशिष्ट रूप से जोड़ा बनाना)
106.example: DNA replication follows the strict rule of complementarity.

106.english_meaning: The process of lengthening or extending something, such as an RNA chain during transcription.
106.example: Elongation is the second major step of transcription.

106.english_meaning: Just beginning to exist or form; newly created, especially regarding an RNA transcript.
106.example: Once the polymerase reaches the terminator, the nascent RNA falls off.

106.english_meaning: The act of ending something or bringing it to a conclusion.
106.example: The termination of transcription occurs at the terminator region.

106.english_meaning: Arousing one's curiosity or interest; fascinating.
106.example: An intriguing question is how RNA polymerase catalyses all steps.

106.english_meaning: To accelerate or cause a chemical reaction using a catalyst or enzyme.
106.hindi_meaning: उत्प्रेरित करना (रासायनिक प्रक्रिया की गति बढ़ाना)
106.example: Enzymes catalyse biological reactions inside living cells.

106.english_meaning: For a very short time or temporarily.
106.hindi_meaning: क्षणिक रूप से / थोड़े समय के लिए
106.example: The enzyme associates transiently with the initiation factor.

106.english_meaning: The quality or condition of being specific or selective in operation.
106.hindi_meaning: विशिष्टता (किसी कार्य विशेष के प्रति अनुकूल होना)
106.example: Association with factors alters the specificity of the RNA polymerase.

106.english_meaning: A separate section or space within a larger structure.
106.example: Transcription and translation take place in the same compartment in bacteria.

106.english_meaning: The aqueous component of the cytoplasm of a cell.
106.example: There is no separation of cytosol and nucleus in bacterial cells.

106.english_meaning: Linked or connected together in action or process.
106.example: Transcription and translation can be coupled in bacteria.

106.english_meaning: Organisms whose cells have a nucleus enclosed within membranes.
106.hindi_meaning: ससीमकेन्द्रकी जीव (जिनमें विकसित केंद्रक होता है)
106.example: In eukaryotes, there are at least three RNA polymerases in the nucleus.

106.english_meaning: The state or quality of being intricate or complicated.
106.example: Eukaryotes exhibit two additional complexities in transcription.

106.english_meaning: Any of a number of organized or specialized structures within a living cell.
106.hindi_meaning: कोशिकांग (कोशिका के भीतर विशेष कार्य करने वाले अंग)
106.example: RNA polymerases are also found in cellular organelles.

107.english_meaning: The process by which genetic information represented by a sequence of DNA nucleotides is copied into newly synthesized molecules of RNA.
107.hindi_meaning: अनुलेखन (डीएनए से आरएनए बनने की प्रक्रिया)
107.example: RNA polymerase is responsible for the transcription of tRNA.

107.english_meaning: A post-transcriptional process in which introns are removed and exons are joined together to form mature mRNA.
107.hindi_meaning: स्प्लिसिंग (आरएनए से अनावश्यक हिस्सों को हटाकर उपयोगी हिस्सों को जोड़ना)
107.example: During splicing, the introns are removed and exons are joined in a defined order.

107.english_meaning: Consisting of parts or things that are very different from each other.
107.hindi_meaning: विषम (विभिन्न प्रकार के तत्वों से बना)
107.example: The primary transcript is known as heterogeneous nuclear RNA (hnRNA).

107.english_meaning: The state of being complementary, especially in DNA base pairing (A-T, G-C).
107.hindi_meaning: पूरकता (एक-दूसरे के अनुकूल होने का गुण)
107.example: Replication is easy to conceptualize on the basis of complementarity.

107.english_meaning: The basic structural unit of nucleic acids such as DNA and RNA.
107.hindi_meaning: न्यूक्लियोटाइड (डीएनए या आरएनए की मूल इकाई)
107.example: An unusual nucleotide is added to the 5'-end of hnRNA during capping.

107.english_meaning: The ancient past, especially the period before the Middle Ages.
107.example: The presence of introns is reminiscent of antiquity.

107.english_meaning: To succeed in understanding, interpreting, or identifying something difficult.
107.hindi_meaning: अर्थ निकालना या गूढ़ रहस्य सुलझाना
107.example: The deciphering of the genetic code was a challenging task for scientists.

107.english_meaning: A way, especially one of several possible variations, in which a set or number of things can be ordered or arranged.
107.example: A permutation combination of 4x4x4 would generate 64 codons.

107.english_meaning: A sequence of three nucleotides which together form a unit of genetic code in a DNA or RNA molecule.
107.hindi_meaning: कोडोन (तीन न्यूक्लियोटाइड का समूह जो एक अमीनो एसिड को कोड करता है)
107.example: George Gamow suggested that the code should be made up of three nucleotides, forming a codon.

107.english_meaning: A statement or theory that is put forward to be considered or accepted.
107.example: Gamow made a bold proposition regarding the structure of the genetic code.

107.english_meaning: Seeming difficult to deal with in anticipation; intimidating.
107.example: Providing proof that the codon was a triplet was a daunting task.

107.english_meaning: To form a concept or idea of something.
107.example: These processes are easy to conceptualise on the basis of complementarity.

107.english_meaning: A substance from which another, more mature substance is formed.
107.example: RNA polymerase II transcribes the precursor of mRNA.

107.english_meaning: A small amount of something that remains after the main part has gone or been taken.
107.example: Adenylate residues are added at the 3'-end of the RNA.
The process of splicing represents the dominance of the RNA-world.

108.english_meaning: The process of producing a chemical compound by reaction from simpler materials.
108.example: The laboratory is synthesising new RNA molecules for the experiment.

108.english_meaning: To succeed in understanding, interpreting, or identifying something difficult.
108.hindi_meaning: अर्थ निकालना या गूढ़ रहस्य सुलझाना
108.example: Scientists finally deciphered the complex genetic code of the organism.

108.english_meaning: The process of reacting monomer molecules together in a chemical reaction to form polymer chains.
108.hindi_meaning: बहुलीकरण करना (अणुओं को जोड़कर श्रृंखला बनाना)
108.example: The enzyme is responsible for polymerising nucleotides into RNA.

108.english_meaning: A pattern or model used as a guide for creating something.
108.hindi_meaning: खाका या प्रतिरूप (जिसका अनुसरण किया जाए)
108.example: The DNA strand acts as a template for the synthesis of mRNA.
These are the salient features of the new government policy.

108.english_meaning: A sequence of three nucleotides that together form a unit of genetic code in a DNA or RNA molecule.
108.hindi_meaning: कोडॉन (आनुवंशिक कूट की तीन न्यूक्लियोटाइड इकाई)
108.example: Each codon specifies a particular amino acid during protein synthesis.

108.english_meaning: A group or set of three.
108.example: The genetic code is a triplet, meaning three bases code for one amino acid.

108.english_meaning: In genetics, having more than one codon that codes for the same amino acid.
108.hindi_meaning: अपभ्रष्ट (आनुवंशिकी में: एक से अधिक कोडॉन का एक ही अमीनो एसिड के लिए होना)
108.example: Because multiple codons can code for the same amino acid, the genetic code is said to be degenerate.

108.english_meaning: Touching, or sharing a common border; touching or connected throughout in an unbroken sequence.
108.example: The codons are read in a contiguous fashion without any gaps.

108.english_meaning: Marks used in writing to separate sentences and clauses; in genetics, gaps between codes.
108.hindi_meaning: विराम चिह्न (आनुवंशिकी में: कोड के बीच कोई अंतराल नहीं)
108.example: There are no punctuations in the mRNA sequence.
The genetic code is nearly universal across all living organisms.

108.english_meaning: Relating to mitochondria, the powerhouses of the cell.
108.example: Some exceptions to the universal genetic code are found in mitochondrial codons.

108.english_meaning: A single-celled microscopic animal of a group that includes amoebas and flagellates.
108.example: Certain protozoans exhibit variations in their genetic coding rules.

108.english_meaning: A person or thing that starts something.
108.example: AUG acts as the initiator codon to start protein synthesis.

108.english_meaning: Something that brings something to an end.
108.example: The terminator codons signal the end of the protein chain.

109.english_meaning: Relating to or consisting of molecules.
109.example: The molecular basis of inheritance explains how traits are passed down through DNA.

109.english_meaning: The process of receiving genetic qualities by transmission from parent to offspring.
109.example: The study of inheritance helps us understand why children resemble their parents.

109.english_meaning: A compound consisting of a nucleoside linked to a phosphate group, forming the basic structural unit of nucleic acids.
109.example: Each nucleotide in the DNA sequence plays a crucial role in coding for proteins.

109.english_meaning: To have a mutual relationship or connection.
109.example: Can you correlate the structure of DNA with its function in the cell?

109.english_meaning: A change in the DNA sequence of an organism.
109.example: A single mutation in the gene can lead to significant changes in an organism's traits.

109.english_meaning: The action of changing the order or position of something.
109.example: Chromosomal rearrangement can sometimes result in genetic disorders.
It is easy to comprehend the effects of large deletions in a DNA segment.

109.english_meaning: A mutation affecting only one or very few nucleotides in a gene sequence.
109.example: Sickle cell anemia is a classic example of a point mutation.

109.english_meaning: An amino acid that serves as a building block of proteins.
109.example: The substitution of glutamate with valine causes the hemoglobin to malfunction.

109.english_meaning: An essential amino acid found in proteins.
109.example: In sickle cell anemia, valine replaces glutamate in the beta globin chain.

109.english_meaning: A genetic blood disorder characterized by red blood cells that assume an abnormal, rigid, sickle shape.
109.example: Sickle cell anemia is caused by a specific point mutation in the DNA.

109.english_meaning: A gene that codes for any RNA or protein product other than a regulatory factor.
109.example: The structural gene determines the sequence of amino acids in a protein.

109.english_meaning: A group or set of three.
109.example: The genetic code is read in triplets known as codons.

109.english_meaning: The action of adding or placing something into something else.
109.example: The insertion of a base pair can shift the entire reading frame of the gene.

109.english_meaning: A way of dividing the sequence of nucleotides in a nucleic acid molecule into a set of consecutive, non-overlapping triplets.
109.example: A frameshift mutation changes the reading frame, often resulting in a non-functional protein.

110.english_meaning: A genetic mutation caused by insertions or deletions of a number of nucleotides that is not divisible by three.
110.hindi_meaning: आनुवंशिक उत्परिवर्तन जिसमें न्यूक्लियोटाइड के जुड़ने या हटने से कोड का क्रम बदल जाता है।
110.example: A frameshift mutation often leads to the production of non-functional proteins.

110.english_meaning: A sequence of three nucleotides that together form a unit of genetic code in a DNA or RNA molecule.
110.hindi_meaning: तीन न्यूक्लियोटाइड का समूह जो आनुवंशिक कोड की एक इकाई बनाता है।
110.example: Each codon specifies a particular amino acid during protein synthesis.

110.english_meaning: To suggest or assume the existence or truth of something as a basis for reasoning or discussion.
110.hindi_meaning: किसी सिद्धांत को आधार मानकर कल्पना करना या प्रस्तावित करना।
110.example: Francis Crick postulated the existence of an adapter molecule to link codes to amino acids.

110.english_meaning: A device or molecule that connects two different parts or functions together.
110.hindi_meaning: एक अणु जो दो अलग-अलग कार्यों या घटकों को आपस में जोड़ता है।
110.example: The tRNA acts as an adapter molecule between the mRNA code and amino acids.

110.english_meaning: A sequence of three nucleotides forming a unit of genetic code in a transfer RNA molecule, corresponding to a complementary codon in messenger RNA.
110.hindi_meaning: tRNA में स्थित तीन न्यूक्लियोटाइड का क्रम जो mRNA के कोडॉन के पूरक होता है।
110.example: The anticodon loop of tRNA ensures the correct amino acid is brought to the ribosome.

110.english_meaning: Combining in such a way as to enhance or emphasize the qualities of each other or to complete a pair.
110.hindi_meaning: पूरक; जो एक-दूसरे के साथ मिलकर पूर्णता प्रदान करते हैं।
110.example: Adenine is complementary to uracil in RNA base pairing.

110.hindi_meaning: प्रारंभ या शुरुआत करने की प्रक्रिया।
110.example: The initiation of protein synthesis requires a specific initiator tRNA.

110.english_meaning: Shown or represented by a drawing, painting, or other art form.
110.example: The secondary structure of tRNA is depicted as a clover-leaf in the diagram.

110.english_meaning: A chemical process that combines several monomers to form a polymer.
110.hindi_meaning: बहुलीकरण; छोटी इकाइयों को जोड़कर एक लंबी श्रृंखला बनाने की प्रक्रिया।
110.example: Translation involves the polymerisation of amino acids into a polypeptide chain.

110.english_meaning: A linear organic polymer consisting of a large number of amino-acid residues bonded together in a chain.
110.hindi_meaning: अमीनो एसिड की एक लंबी श्रृंखला जो पेप्टाइड बंधों से जुड़ी होती है।
110.example: The ribosome synthesizes a polypeptide chain based on the mRNA sequence.

110.english_meaning: A compound consisting of two or more amino acids linked in a chain.
110.hindi_meaning: दो या दो से अधिक अमीनो एसिड से बना यौगिक।
110.example: A peptide bond connects the carboxyl group of one amino acid to the amino group of another.

110.english_meaning: Related or connected; in biology, it refers to the specific tRNA that matches a particular amino acid.
110.hindi_meaning: संबंधित या विशिष्ट; यहाँ इसका अर्थ उस tRNA से है जो एक विशिष्ट अमीनो एसिड के लिए होता है।
110.example: Each amino acid is linked to its cognate tRNA during the charging process.

110.english_meaning: The process of adding an amino acid to a tRNA molecule.
110.hindi_meaning: tRNA अणु के साथ अमीनो एसिड को जोड़ने की प्रक्रिया।
110.example: Aminoacylation is essential for the activation of amino acids before protein synthesis.

110.english_meaning: The process in which cellular ribosomes create proteins using mRNA as a template.
110.hindi_meaning: अनुवादन; वह प्रक्रिया जिसमें mRNA के कोड को पढ़कर प्रोटीन का निर्माण किया जाता है।
110.example: Translation occurs in the cytoplasm of the cell.

110.english_meaning: Closely and neatly packed together; dense.
110.example: In its actual structure, the tRNA is a compact molecule.

111.english_meaning: A substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change.
111.hindi_meaning: उत्प्रेरक (वह पदार्थ जो रासायनिक अभिक्रिया की गति को बढ़ा देता है)
111.example: The ribosome acts as a catalyst to speed up the formation of peptide bonds.

111.english_meaning: A minute particle consisting of RNA and associated proteins found in large numbers in the cytoplasm of living cells.
111.hindi_meaning: राइबोसोम (कोशिका का वह अंग जो प्रोटीन संश्लेषण करता है)
111.example: The ribosome is known as the cellular factory for synthesising proteins.

111.english_meaning: The process in which cellular ribosomes create proteins using messenger RNA (mRNA) as a template.
111.hindi_meaning: अनुवादन (mRNA से प्रोटीन बनने की प्रक्रिया)
111.example: The process of translation begins when the small subunit encounters an mRNA.

111.english_meaning: An RNA molecule capable of acting as an enzyme.
111.hindi_meaning: राइबोजाइम (एक RNA अणु जो एंजाइम की तरह कार्य करता है)
111.example: In bacteria, the 23S rRNA acts as a ribozyme during protein synthesis.

111.english_meaning: A linear organic polymer consisting of a large number of amino-acid residues bonded together in a chain.
111.hindi_meaning: पॉलीपेप्टाइड (अमीनो एसिड की एक लंबी श्रृंखला)
111.example: The ribosome releases a complete polypeptide chain at the end of translation.

111.english_meaning: A sequence of three nucleotides which together form a unit of genetic code in a DNA or RNA molecule.
111.hindi_meaning: कोडोन (तीन न्यूक्लियोटाइड का समूह जो एक विशिष्ट अमीनो एसिड को कोड करता है)
111.example: The start codon AUG signals the beginning of protein synthesis.

111.english_meaning: To be situated on each side of or on one side of something.
111.hindi_meaning: घिरा हुआ (किसी चीज के दोनों ओर स्थित होना)
111.example: The translational unit is flanked by the start and stop codons.

111.english_meaning: Regions of mRNA that are not translated into protein.
111.hindi_meaning: अनुवादित न होने वाला (mRNA का वह भाग जो प्रोटीन में नहीं बदलता)
111.example: Untranslated regions (UTRs) are required for an efficient translation process.
For initiation, the ribosome binds to the mRNA at the start codon.

111.english_meaning: The process of lengthening or extending.

111.english_meaning: Combining in such a way as to enhance or emphasize the qualities of each other or another.
111.hindi_meaning: पूरक (एक-दूसरे के अनुकूल या मेल खाने वाला)
111.example: The tRNA anticodon forms complementary base pairs with the mRNA codon.

111.english_meaning: A sequence of three nucleotides forming a unit of genetic code in a transfer RNA molecule, corresponding to a complementary codon in messenger RNA.
111.hindi_meaning: एंटीकोडोन (tRNA पर स्थित तीन न्यूक्लियोटाइड का समूह)
111.example: The anticodon on the tRNA ensures the correct amino acid is added.

111.english_meaning: The act of controlling or directing according to rule.

111.english_meaning: Organisms whose cells have a nucleus enclosed within membranes.
111.hindi_meaning: सुकेंद्रकी (वे जीव जिनकी कोशिकाओं में स्पष्ट केंद्रक होता है)

111.english_meaning: A form of RNA processing in which a newly made precursor messenger RNA transcript is transformed into a mature messenger RNA.
111.example: The regulation of splicing is a key step in eukaryotic gene expression.

112.english_meaning: To produce a substance by chemical or biological processes.
112.example: Proteins are synthesised within the cell to perform various functions.

112.english_meaning: The chemical breakdown of a compound due to reaction with water.
112.hindi_meaning: जल-अपघटन (पानी के साथ प्रतिक्रिया द्वारा यौगिक का टूटना)
112.example: The enzyme facilitates the hydrolysis of lactose into simpler sugars.

112.english_meaning: A sugar formed from two monosaccharides joined by a glycosidic bond.
112.hindi_meaning: द्विशर्करा (दो शर्करा इकाइयों से बनी शर्करा)
112.example: Lactose is a common disaccharide found in milk.

112.english_meaning: The process by which cells become specialized in structure and function.
112.hindi_meaning: विभेदन (कोशिकाओं का विशिष्ट कार्य के लिए विकसित होना)
112.example: Cell differentiation is crucial for the development of an embryo.

112.english_meaning: Microscopic single-celled organisms that lack a distinct nucleus.
112.hindi_meaning: असीमकेन्द्रकी (वे जीव जिनमें स्पष्ट केंद्रक नहीं होता)

112.english_meaning: Relating to the process of copying DNA into RNA.
112.hindi_meaning: अनुलेखन संबंधी (DNA से RNA बनने की प्रक्रिया)
112.example: Transcriptional control is the primary way bacteria regulate gene expression.

112.english_meaning: A region of DNA that initiates the transcription of a particular gene.

112.english_meaning: Proteins that bind to DNA and inhibit the expression of one or more genes.

112.english_meaning: The act of making something clear or explaining it fully.

112.english_meaning: Refers to a messenger RNA that encodes several proteins.

112.english_meaning: A substance that slows down or prevents a particular chemical reaction.
112.hindi_meaning: निवारक (किसी प्रक्रिया को रोकने वाला पदार्थ)
112.example: The i gene acts as an inhibitor for the lac operon.

112.english_meaning: Consisting of a single unit or molecule.
112.example: Lactose is broken down into its monomeric units: glucose and galactose.

112.english_meaning: The quality of a material that allows liquids or gases to pass through it.
112.hindi_meaning: पारगम्यता (किसी झिल्ली से पदार्थों के गुजरने की क्षमता)
112.example: The protein permease increases the permeability of the cell membrane to lactose.

112.english_meaning: Relating to the chemical processes that occur within a living organism.
112.hindi_meaning: चयापचय संबंधी (जीव के भीतर होने वाली रासायनिक प्रक्रियाएं)
112.example: The cell regulates its metabolic pathway based on available nutrients.

113.english_meaning: The fundamental cellular and molecular mechanisms, such as DNA and RNA functions, that explain biological inheritance and traits.

113.english_meaning: A molecule upon which an enzyme acts to form a product.

113.english_meaning: A chemical or molecule that regulates gene expression by binding to a repressor, thereby switching an operon on.

113.english_meaning: A functioning unit of genomic DNA containing a cluster of genes under the control of a single promoter.
113.example: The lac operon controls the metabolism of lactose in bacteria.

113.english_meaning: A transport protein that facilitates the movement of specific molecules, such as lactose, across the cell membrane.
113.example: Permease allows lactose molecules to be transported into the bacterial cell.

113.english_meaning: Happening constantly and at a steady level, without being subject to regulation or external control.
113.hindi_meaning: निरंतर रूप से / सदैव रूप से
113.example: The repressor protein is synthesised constitutively from the i gene.

113.english_meaning: A regulatory protein that binds to an operator and blocks the transcription of a gene or operon.
113.example: The repressor prevents RNA polymerase from transcribing the operon in the absence of lactose.

113.english_meaning: A genetic sequence in DNA to which a repressor protein binds to control the expression of the operon.
113.example: The repressor protein binds directly to the operator region to halt transcription.

113.english_meaning: An enzyme responsible for copying a DNA sequence into an RNA sequence during transcription.
113.example: RNA polymerase transcribes the structural genes when the operator is free.

113.english_meaning: The process of making an RNA copy from a DNA template strand.
113.example: The enzyme prevents RNA polymerase from transcribing the genes.

113.english_meaning: An isomer of lactose that acts as the actual inducer molecule for the lac operon.
113.example: In the presence of lactose, allolactose inactivates the repressor protein.

113.english_meaning: A region of DNA where RNA polymerase binds to initiate transcription.
113.example: The inducer allows RNA polymerase access to the promoter region.

113.english_meaning: The first step of gene expression where a segment of DNA is copied into RNA.
113.example: Once the repressor is inactivated, transcription proceeds smoothly.

113.english_meaning: Gene regulation in which a repressor protein binds to DNA to prevent transcription.
113.example: Regulation of the lac operon by a repressor is referred to as negative regulation.

113.english_meaning: Gene regulation in which an active regulatory protein stimulates transcription.
113.example: The lac operon is also under the control of positive regulation.

114.english_meaning: The complete set of genetic material present in a cell or organism.
114.hindi_meaning: किसी जीव के कोशिका में मौजूद आनुवंशिक सामग्री का पूर्ण समूह।
114.example: The Human Genome Project aimed to map the entire sequence of human DNA.

114.english_meaning: A particular order in which related things follow each other.
114.hindi_meaning: क्रम; एक विशिष्ट व्यवस्था जिसमें चीजें एक के बाद एक आती हैं।
114.example: Scientists determined the sequence of base pairs in the DNA strand.

114.english_meaning: To identify and separate a specific substance or organism from others.
114.hindi_meaning: अलग करना; किसी पदार्थ या जीव को दूसरों से पृथक करना।
114.example: Researchers were able to isolate the specific gene responsible for the trait.

114.english_meaning: To make an identical genetic copy of a living organism or a piece of DNA.
114.hindi_meaning: प्रतिलिपि बनाना; किसी जीव या डीएनए के टुकड़े की आनुवंशिक रूप से समान प्रतिलिपि तैयार करना।
114.example: The laboratory used advanced techniques to clone the DNA segment.

114.english_meaning: The great size or extent of something.
114.hindi_meaning: विशालता; किसी चीज़ का बहुत बड़ा आकार या विस्तार।
114.example: The magnitude of the project required international cooperation.

114.english_meaning: Relating to or using computers for calculation or data processing.
114.hindi_meaning: संगणकीय; गणना या डेटा प्रसंस्करण के लिए कंप्यूटर का उपयोग करने से संबंधित।
114.example: Computational devices are essential for analyzing large biological datasets.

114.english_meaning: The process of getting something back from where it is stored.
114.hindi_meaning: पुनर्प्राप्ति; संग्रहीत जानकारी को वापस प्राप्त करने की प्रक्रिया।
114.example: The database allows for the rapid retrieval of genetic information.

114.english_meaning: The science of collecting and analyzing complex biological data using computers.
114.hindi_meaning: जैव-सूचना विज्ञान; कंप्यूटर का उपयोग करके जटिल जैविक डेटा एकत्र करने और विश्लेषण करने का विज्ञान।
114.example: Bioinformatics has become a crucial field in modern biological research.

114.english_meaning: Relating to moral principles or the rules of conduct.
114.hindi_meaning: नैतिक; नैतिक सिद्धांतों या आचरण के नियमों से संबंधित।
114.example: The project raised several ethical questions regarding genetic privacy.

114.english_meaning: Organized the different elements of a complex activity to work together effectively.
114.hindi_meaning: समन्वित; किसी जटिल कार्य के विभिन्न तत्वों को प्रभावी ढंग से एक साथ काम करने के लिए व्यवस्थित करना।
114.example: The international team coordinated their efforts to complete the study.

114.english_meaning: Differences in the characteristics or genetic makeup of individuals.
114.hindi_meaning: विभिन्नताएँ; व्यक्तियों के लक्षणों या आनुवंशिक संरचना में अंतर।
114.example: DNA variations explain why individuals have different physical traits.

114.english_meaning: To identify the nature of an illness or other problem by examination.
114.hindi_meaning: रोग का निदान करना; परीक्षण द्वारा बीमारी या समस्या की पहचान करना।
