139.english_meaning: Substances that induce insensitivity to pain.
139.example: Surgery became much safer after the invention of effective anaesthetics.

139.english_meaning: The state of thinking or hoping that something will happen; specifically, the average period a person is expected to live.
139.example: Better healthcare has significantly increased the average life expectancy.

139.english_meaning: The identification of the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms.
139.example: Modern medical diagnostics allow doctors to detect diseases at an early stage.

139.english_meaning: Relating to the combination or interaction of social and cultural factors.
139.example: Technological advancements have brought significant socio-cultural changes to our society.

139.english_meaning: Microscopic organisms, especially those that cause disease.
139.example: Not all microbes are harmful; some are essential for human welfare.

139.english_meaning: The state of being able to be seen or noticed.
139.example: The visibility of chemical applications in daily life is very high.

139.english_meaning: Clearly shown or proved by evidence.
139.example: The experiment demonstrated the effectiveness of the new drug.

139.english_meaning: The science or practice of farming.
139.example: Biological knowledge has greatly improved modern agriculture.

139.english_meaning: Groups of people living in the same place or having a particular characteristic in common.
139.example: The new policy will benefit rural communities across the country.

140.example: She completed her post-graduation in botany to understand plant life better.

140.english_meaning: The study of heredity and the variation of inherited characteristics in living organisms.
140.example: He developed his expertise in genetics and plant breeding.

140.english_meaning: The art and science of changing the traits of plants in order to produce desired characteristics.
140.example: Plant breeding helps in developing disease-resistant crop varieties.

140.english_meaning: A branch of genetics that relates to the structure and function of cells, especially chromosomes.
140.example: The School of Cytogenetics focused on advanced research in plant cells.

140.english_meaning: Producing a large amount of crop or product relative to the resource invested.
140.example: Farmers were encouraged to plant high-yielding varieties of rice.

140.english_meaning: The action of working with someone to produce or create something.
140.example: His collaboration with international scientists led to remarkable agricultural breakthroughs.

140.english_meaning: Reached a climax or point of highest development.
140.example: Their joint research culminated in the historic Green Revolution.

140.english_meaning: A large-scale increase in agricultural production in developing countries achieved by the use of high-yielding varieties, fertilizers, and irrigation.
140.example: The Green Revolution made India self-sufficient in food grain production.

140.english_meaning: The state of having reliable access to a sufficient quantity of affordable, nutritious food.
140.example: Ensuring food security for the growing population is a primary national goal.

140.english_meaning: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.
140.example: Several environmental programmes were launched to preserve biodiversity.

140.english_meaning: Given public praise or reward for an achievement.
140.example: He was honoured with the Padma Bhushan for his outstanding service.

140.english_meaning: Inspiring respect and admiration; having high status.
140.example: She received a prestigious fellowship to study abroad.

140.english_meaning: Official positions or grants given to advanced scholars or researchers to fund their work.
140.example: Numerous academic fellowships were awarded to recognize scientific excellence.

140.english_meaning: A person who causes a process or action to begin.
140.example: He is recognized as the initiator of several vital agricultural reforms.

140.english_meaning: The specified roles, positions, or functions in which someone works or acts.
140.example: He served in different capacities across numerous scientific institutions.

141.english_meaning: In ancient medicine, the bodily fluids believed to determine a person's physical and mental health.
141.hindi_meaning: शरीर के वे तरल पदार्थ जिन्हें प्राचीन चिकित्सा में स्वास्थ्य का आधार माना जाता था।
141.example: Ancient physicians believed that a balance of four humors was essential for good health.

141.english_meaning: Stated a fact or belief confidently and forcefully.
141.example: The researchers asserted that the new treatment would significantly improve patient outcomes.

141.english_meaning: Relating to deep thought or contemplation.
141.hindi_meaning: गहन चिंतन या विचार से संबंधित।
141.example: The theory was based on pure reflective thought rather than empirical evidence.

141.english_meaning: A proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence as a starting point for further investigation.
141.hindi_meaning: परिकल्पना; किसी तथ्य को समझाने के लिए बनाया गया प्रारंभिक अनुमान।
141.example: The scientist tested her hypothesis through a series of controlled experiments.

141.english_meaning: Relating to a nerve or the nervous system.
141.hindi_meaning: तंत्रिका संबंधी; तंत्रिका तंत्र से जुड़ा हुआ।
141.example: The neural system transmits signals throughout the human body.

141.english_meaning: Relating to glands that secrete hormones directly into the blood.
141.hindi_meaning: अंतःस्रावी; शरीर की वे ग्रंथियां जो हार्मोन का स्राव करती हैं।
141.example: The endocrine system plays a crucial role in regulating body metabolism.

141.english_meaning: Relating to the body's ability to resist infection or toxins.
141.hindi_meaning: प्रतिरक्षा; रोगों से लड़ने की क्षमता रखने वाला।
141.example: A healthy diet helps strengthen the immune system.

141.hindi_meaning: आनुवंशिक; जो पीढ़ी-दर-पीढ़ी स्थानांतरित होता है।
141.example: Genetic disorders are often passed down from parents to their children.

141.english_meaning: A lack or shortage of something necessary.
141.example: Vitamin deficiencies can lead to various health problems.

141.english_meaning: To receive a quality or characteristic from one's parents through genes.
141.hindi_meaning: विरासत में मिलना या आनुवंशिक रूप से प्राप्त करना।
141.example: The child inherits certain physical traits from his parents.

141.english_meaning: The process of infecting or the state of being infected by a pathogen.
141.hindi_meaning: संक्रमण; रोगाणुओं द्वारा होने वाली बीमारी।
141.example: Proper hygiene is essential to prevent the spread of infections.

141.english_meaning: Based on or derived from experiments.
141.example: The experimental method is the foundation of modern scientific research.

141.english_meaning: The action or process of showing the existence or truth of something by giving proof or evidence.
141.example: The demonstration of the new technology impressed the entire audience.

141.english_meaning: To prove that something is false.
141.example: New evidence eventually disproved the old theory.

141.english_meaning: The continuous movement of blood through the heart and blood vessels.
141.hindi_meaning: परिसंचरण; शरीर में रक्त का प्रवाह।
141.example: Regular exercise helps improve blood circulation.

142.english_meaning: Long life; the length of time that a person or animal lives.
142.example: Regular exercise and a balanced diet contribute to the longevity of an individual.

142.english_meaning: The state of being subject to death; the number of deaths in a given area or period.
142.example: Improved healthcare facilities have significantly reduced infant mortality rates.

142.english_meaning: Conditions or practices conducive to maintaining health and preventing disease, especially through cleanliness.
142.example: Personal hygiene is essential to prevent the spread of infectious diseases.

142.english_meaning: The action of making a person or animal immune to infection, typically by inoculation.
142.example: Widespread immunisation has helped eradicate many dangerous diseases.

142.english_meaning: Organisms, typically biting insects, that transmit a disease or parasite from one animal or plant to another.
142.example: Mosquitoes act as vectors for diseases like malaria and dengue.

142.english_meaning: In a way that prevents success or development; harmfully or unfavorably.
142.example: Pollution affects the health of citizens adversely.

142.english_meaning: Likely to be transmitted to people, organisms, etc., through the environment.
142.example: Common cold is an infectious disease that spreads through air droplets.
If left untreated, some infections can become fatal.

142.english_meaning: A bacterium, virus, or other microorganism that can cause disease.
142.example: Pathogens enter the human body and interfere with normal vital activities.

142.english_meaning: Organisms that live on or in a host organism and get their food from or at the expense of their host.
142.example: Many parasites cause harm to the host by living inside their body.

142.english_meaning: Relating to the form or structure of living organisms.
142.example: The pathogen caused significant morphological changes in the host's tissues.

142.english_meaning: Having been made impure by exposure to or addition of a poisonous or polluting substance.
142.example: Drinking contaminated water is a primary cause of typhoid fever.

142.english_meaning: A condition in which there is difficulty in emptying the bowels.
142.example: Severe stomach pain and constipation are common symptoms of typhoid.

142.english_meaning: A hole made in something, especially in a body organ.
142.example: Intestinal perforation is a life-threatening complication of untreated typhoid.

142.english_meaning: Continuing for an extended period or without interruption.
142.example: The patient suffered from sustained high fever for over a week.

143.english_meaning: Tiny air sacs in the lungs where gas exchange occurs.
143.example: Pneumonia causes the alveoli to fill with fluid, making it difficult to breathe.

143.english_meaning: Fine particles or droplets suspended in the air.
143.hindi_meaning: हवा में निलंबित सूक्ष्म कण या बूंदें
143.example: The virus spreads through aerosols released when an infected person coughs.

143.english_meaning: The state of being blocked or clogged, often referring to nasal passages.
143.hindi_meaning: रुकावट या जमाव (जैसे नाक बंद होना)
143.example: Nasal congestion is a common symptom of the common cold.

143.english_meaning: A rough or harsh quality of voice, usually due to a sore throat.
143.example: A sore throat and hoarseness are typical signs of a viral infection.

143.english_meaning: Made impure or harmful by contact with a poisonous or infectious substance.
143.example: Touching contaminated objects can lead to the spread of diseases.

143.english_meaning: A single-celled microscopic animal of a group that includes amoebas and flagellates.
143.example: Malaria is caused by a protozoan parasite called Plasmodium.

143.english_meaning: Very infectious, dangerous, or likely to cause death.
143.example: Plasmodium falciparum causes the most malignant form of malaria.

143.english_meaning: Causing or capable of causing death.
143.example: If left untreated, some infections can become fatal.

143.english_meaning: The infectious stage of the Plasmodium parasite that enters the human body.
143.example: Sporozoites are injected into the human bloodstream by the mosquito's bite.
The rupture of red blood cells releases toxins into the body.

143.english_meaning: A toxic substance released during the breakdown of red blood cells by malaria parasites.
143.example: The release of haemozoin is responsible for the recurring chills in malaria patients.

143.english_meaning: An organism that transmits a disease or parasite from one animal or plant to another.
143.example: The female Anopheles mosquito acts as a vector for malaria.

143.english_meaning: Relating to the organs involved in breathing.
143.example: The virus infects the upper respiratory passage.
The patient suffered from recurring bouts of high fever.

143.english_meaning: A person or animal that transmits a disease to others without showing symptoms themselves.
143.example: Mary Mallon was a famous typhoid carrier who spread the disease to many people.

144.english_meaning: A species of anaerobic parasitic amoebae that infects the human intestinal tract.
144.hindi_meaning: मानव आंत में पाया जाने वाला एक परजीवी प्रोटोजोआ।
144.example: Entamoeba histolytica is the causative agent of amoebic dysentery.

144.english_meaning: A single-celled microscopic animal of a group of phyla of the kingdom Protista.
144.example: Malaria is caused by a protozoan parasite.

144.english_meaning: An organism that lives in or on another organism and benefits by deriving nutrients at the host's expense.
144.hindi_meaning: परजीवी; वह जीव जो दूसरे जीव पर आश्रित रहता है।
144.example: The parasite feeds on the host's blood to survive.

144.english_meaning: An infection of the intestines caused by the parasite Entamoeba histolytica.
144.hindi_meaning: अमीबा के संक्रमण से होने वाली बीमारी।
144.example: Poor sanitation is the primary cause of the spread of amoebiasis.

144.english_meaning: Infection of the intestines resulting in severe diarrhea with the presence of blood and mucus in the feces.
144.hindi_meaning: पेचिश; आंतों का संक्रमण जिसमें दस्त के साथ खून आता है।
144.example: The patient was diagnosed with amoebic dysentery after complaining of severe stomach pain.

144.english_meaning: A condition in which there is difficulty in emptying the bowels.
144.example: A high-fiber diet helps in preventing constipation.

144.english_meaning: Relating to the abdomen or the belly area.
144.example: He felt sharp abdominal pain after eating contaminated food.

144.english_meaning: Painful, involuntary contractions of a muscle or group of muscles.
144.hindi_meaning: ऐंठन; मांसपेशियों में खिंचाव या दर्द।
144.example: Stomach cramps are a common symptom of food poisoning.

144.english_meaning: A slippery, viscous substance secreted by the body's membranes.
144.hindi_meaning: श्लेष्मा; शरीर के अंगों द्वारा स्रावित चिपचिपा पदार्थ।
144.example: The stool sample showed excess mucous, indicating an infection.

144.english_meaning: Relating to physical forces or movement; in this context, acting as a physical transporter.
144.hindi_meaning: यांत्रिक; भौतिक रूप से ढोने वाला।
144.example: Houseflies act as mechanical carriers for various pathogens.

144.english_meaning: To cause something to pass on from one place or person to another.
144.hindi_meaning: संचरित करना; एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान तक पहुँचाना।
144.example: Mosquitoes transmit malaria from one person to another.

144.english_meaning: Waste matter remaining after food has been digested, discharged from the bowels.
144.example: Proper disposal of faeces is essential to prevent the spread of diseases.
The infected person should be isolated to prevent further spread.

144.english_meaning: A genus of parasitic protozoa that causes malaria in humans.
144.example: The life cycle of Plasmodium involves both human and mosquito hosts.

144.english_meaning: The part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus.
144.hindi_meaning: आंत; पाचन तंत्र का एक हिस्सा।
144.example: The parasite resides in the large intestine of the human body.

145.example: Certain bacteria and viruses are pathogenic to humans.

145.english_meaning: Parasitic worms, such as roundworms and flatworms
145.example: Helminths live inside the digestive tract or other tissues of their host.

145.english_meaning: A disease caused by the parasitic roundworm Ascaris
145.hindi_meaning: एस्कैरियसिस (गोलकृमि के कारण होने वाला रोग)
145.example: Ascariasis can cause internal bleeding and blockage of the intestinal passage.

145.english_meaning: A condition in which the blood lacks adequate healthy red blood cells
145.example: Poor nutrition and parasitic infections often lead to anemia.

145.english_meaning: Persisting for a long time or constantly recurring
145.example: Elephantiasis is a chronic condition affecting the lymphatic vessels.

145.english_meaning: Relating to the tissues and vessels that convey lymph through the body
145.example: Filarial worms commonly live in the lymphatic vessels of the lower limbs.

145.english_meaning: A disease characterized by gross enlargement of the limbs, typically caused by filarial worms
145.example: Elephantiasis causes severe swelling and deformities in the legs and genital organs.

145.english_meaning: Physical distortions or irregularities in the shape of a body part
145.hindi_meaning: विकृति (शरीर के अंग का असमान आकार)
145.example: Severe infections can lead to gross deformities of the affected organs.

145.english_meaning: Organisms that transmit disease-causing pathogens from one host to another
145.example: Female mosquitoes act as vectors for transmitting the filarial parasite.

145.english_meaning: A group of spore-producing organisms feeding on organic matter, including molds and yeasts
145.example: Certain fungi are responsible for causing ringworm infections on the skin.

145.english_meaning: Regions of damaged or abnormal tissue on or inside the body
145.example: Ringworm infection appears as dry, scaly lesions on the skin and scalp.

145.english_meaning: Conditions or practices conducive to maintaining health and preventing disease
145.example: Maintenance of personal and public hygiene is essential for disease prevention.

145.english_meaning: The process of cleaning something, especially with chemicals, in order to destroy bacteria
145.example: Periodic disinfection of water reservoirs prevents the spread of water-borne diseases.

145.english_meaning: Underground tanks or pits for the disposal of liquid waste or sewage
145.hindi_meaning: मलकुंड या गंदे पानी का गड्ढा
145.example: Stagnant water and cesspools should be cleaned periodically to maintain public hygiene.

145.english_meaning: The action or process of spreading something, such as a disease, from one person to another
145.example: Contaminated food and water facilitate the transmission of typhoid and ascariasis.

146.english_meaning: A tropical disease caused by parasitic worms and transmitted by mosquitoes, characterized by severe swelling of the limbs.
146.hindi_meaning: हाथीपांव या फाइलेरिया (एक परजीवी रोग जो मच्छरों द्वारा फैलता है)
146.example: Filariasis and malaria are diseases transmitted through insect vectors.

146.english_meaning: An organism, typically a biting insect or tick, that transmits a disease or parasite from one animal or plant to another.
146.hindi_meaning: रोग वाहक (वह जीव जो रोगाणुओं को एक से दूसरे तक पहुँचाता है)
146.example: Mosquitoes act as vectors for diseases like malaria and dengue.

146.english_meaning: The state of not flowing or moving, creating still water where mosquitoes can breed.
146.example: Avoiding the stagnation of water around houses helps prevent mosquito breeding.

146.english_meaning: The active immature form of an insect, especially one that differs greatly from the adult.
146.example: Fishes like Gambusia are introduced into ponds to feed on mosquito larvae.
Spraying of insecticides in ditches and swamps controls insect vectors.

146.english_meaning: To destroy completely; put an end to.
146.hindi_meaning: पूरी तरह समाप्त करना या उन्मूलन करना
146.example: Immunisation programmes have enabled us to completely eradicate smallpox.

146.english_meaning: The action of making a person or animal immune to infection, typically by inoculation.
146.example: Immunisation programmes protect children from various infectious diseases.

146.english_meaning: Medicines that inhibit the growth of or destroy microorganisms like bacteria.
146.example: The discovery of antibiotics has helped effectively treat bacterial infections.

146.english_meaning: The ability of an organism to resist a particular infection or toxin.
146.example: A strong immune system provides immunity against harmful foreign agents.
Innate immunity is a non-specific type of defence present at birth.

146.english_meaning: Obtained or developed over time during a person's lifetime.
146.hindi_meaning: उपार्जित (जो जन्म के बाद जीवनकाल में प्राप्त हो)
146.example: Acquired immunity is pathogen-specific and develops after exposure to infections.

146.english_meaning: A slippery secretion produced by mucous membranes that traps dust and microbes.
146.hindi_meaning: श्लेष्म या कफ (शरीर के अंगों के अंदरूनी स्तर द्वारा स्रावित गाढ़ा तरल)
146.example: Mucus coating in the respiratory tract helps trap entering microbes.

146.english_meaning: The thin tissue forming the outer layer of a body's surface and lining the hollow structures.
146.hindi_meaning: उपकला ऊतक (त्वचा या अंगों की अंदरूनी परत बनाने वाला ऊतक)
146.example: The epithelium lines the respiratory and gastrointestinal tracts.

146.english_meaning: Relating to the branch of biology that deals with the normal functions of living organisms and their parts.
146.example: Stomach acid and saliva act as physiological barriers against pathogens.

146.english_meaning: White blood cells that circulate in the blood and body fluids and are involved in counteracting foreign substances and disease.
146.example: Certain leukocytes in our body act as cellular barriers against infections.

147.english_meaning: A type of large phagocytic white blood cell involved in the immune system.
147.hindi_meaning: एक प्रकार की बड़ी श्वेत रक्त कणिका जो रोगजनकों को नष्ट करती है।
147.example: Monocytes in the blood help phagocytose and destroy harmful microbes.

147.english_meaning: Large phagocytic cells found in tissues that engulf and digest cellular debris and pathogens.
147.hindi_meaning: ऊतकों में पाई जाने वाली बड़ी कोशिकाएं जो रोगाणुओं और मलबे को खाकर नष्ट करती हैं।
147.example: Macrophages in tissues act as frontline defenders against invading microbes.

147.english_meaning: To engulf and absorb bacteria and other foreign particles and cells.
147.hindi_meaning: रोगाणुओं या विदेशी कणों को अपने अंदर घेरकर नष्ट करना।
147.example: Certain white blood cells can phagocytose and destroy foreign microbes.

147.english_meaning: Proteins secreted by virus-infected cells that protect non-infected cells from viral infections.
147.hindi_meaning: विषाणु-संक्रमित कोशिकाओं द्वारा स्रावित प्रोटीन जो अन्य स्वस्थ कोशिकाओं को संक्रमण से बचाते हैं।
147.example: Virus-infected cells secrete proteins called interferons as a cytokine barrier.

147.english_meaning: Pathogen-specific immunity that develops after exposure to a pathogen and is characterized by memory.
147.hindi_meaning: उपार्जित प्रतिरक्षा जो किसी रोगजनक के संपर्क में आने के बाद विकसित होती है और इसमें स्मरण शक्ति होती है।
147.example: Acquired immunity is pathogen-specific and provides long-lasting protection.

147.english_meaning: Relating to a secondary immune response that is rapid and intensified due to previous exposure.
147.hindi_meaning: द्वितीयक प्रतिरक्षा प्रतिक्रिया से संबंधित जो पिछले संपर्क के कारण अत्यधिक तीव्र होती है।
147.example: Subsequent encounters with the same pathogen elicit a secondary or anamnestic response.

147.english_meaning: A type of white blood cell central to vertebrate immune systems, including B-cells and T-cells.
147.hindi_meaning: श्वेत रक्त कोशिकाओं का एक प्रकार जो प्रतिरक्षा तंत्र में मुख्य भूमिका निभाता है।
147.example: Immune responses are carried out with the help of B-lymphocytes and T-lymphocytes.

147.english_meaning: Proteins produced by B-lymphocytes in response to pathogens to neutralize them.
147.hindi_meaning: प्रतिरक्षी प्रोटीन जो बी-लिम्फोसाइट्स द्वारा रोगजनकों से लड़ने के लिए उत्पन्न किए जाते हैं।
147.example: The B-lymphocytes produce an army of proteins called antibodies to fight pathogens.

147.english_meaning: A compound consisting of two or more amino acids linked in a chain.
147.hindi_meaning: अमीनो एसिड की श्रृंखला से बना यौगिक या अणु।
147.example: Each antibody molecule has four peptide chains, including light and heavy chains.

147.english_meaning: Relating to body fluids, specifically antibody-mediated immune responses found in the blood.
147.hindi_meaning: शरीर के तरलों (जैसे रक्त) से संबंधित, विशेषकर एंटीबॉडी-मध्यस्थता वाली प्रतिरक्षा प्रतिक्रिया।
147.example: Because these antibodies are found in the blood, the response is called humoral immune response.

147.english_meaning: Brought about or controlled through a specific agent or biological mechanism.
147.hindi_meaning: किसी माध्यम या जैविक प्रक्रिया द्वारा संचालित या नियंत्रित।
147.example: Cell-mediated immunity is primarily managed by T-lymphocytes.

147.english_meaning: The medical operation of transferring an organ from one person to another.
147.hindi_meaning: अंग प्रत्यारोपण; एक शरीर से दूसरे शरीर में अंग का स्थानांतरण।
147.example: When vital organs fail, transplantation is often the only remedy for survival.

147.english_meaning: A medicine or treatment for a disease or injury, or a solution to a problem.
147.example: Organ transplantation is the only remedy to enable the patient to live a normal life.

147.english_meaning: A person who donates blood, tissue, or an organ for medical use.
147.hindi_meaning: दाता; जो चिकित्सा उपयोग के लिए अंग, ऊतक या रक्त दान करता है।
147.example: The doctors began a careful search to find a suitable organ donor.

147.english_meaning: Pieces of living tissue or organs transplanted surgically.
147.hindi_meaning: शल्य चिकित्सा द्वारा रोपित जीवित ऊतक या अंग के टुकड़े।
147.example: Doctors carefully examine biological compatibility before accepting tissue grafts.

148.english_meaning: A piece of living tissue that is transplanted surgically.
148.hindi_meaning: ऊतक प्रत्यारोपण (शरीर का कोई अंग या ऊतक जो सर्जरी द्वारा बदला जाता है)
148.example: Tissue matching is essential before undertaking any skin or organ graft.

148.english_meaning: A substance or drug that dampens or reduces the immune system's response.
148.hindi_meaning: प्रतिरक्षा को दबाने वाली औषधि (जो शरीर की रोग प्रतिरोधक क्षमता को कमजोर करती है ताकि अंग अस्वीकार न हो)
148.example: The patient has to take immunosuppressants for the rest of their life after an organ transplant.

148.english_meaning: An immune response that does not involve antibodies, but rather involves the activation of phagocytes and antigen-specific cytotoxic T-lymphocytes.
148.hindi_meaning: कोशिका-माध्यित (जो एंटीबॉडी के बजाय कोशिकाओं द्वारा संचालित होता है)
148.example: Cell-mediated immune response is primarily responsible for the rejection of tissue grafts.

148.english_meaning: A toxin or other foreign substance that induces an immune response in the body.
148.hindi_meaning: प्रतिजन (बाहरी पदार्थ या सूक्ष्मजीव जो शरीर में प्रवेश कर प्रतिरक्षा प्रतिक्रिया को प्रेरित करता है)
148.example: When a host is exposed to antigens, antibodies are produced in the body.

148.english_meaning: Immunity that results from the production of antibodies by the immune system in response to the presence of an antigen.
148.hindi_meaning: सक्रिय प्रतिरक्षा (वह प्रतिरक्षा जो शरीर द्वारा खुद एंटीबॉडी बनाने पर उत्पन्न होती है)
148.example: Active immunity takes time to give its full effective response after an infection.

148.english_meaning: Short-term immunity resulting from the introduction of preformed antibodies from another person or animal.
148.hindi_meaning: निष्क्रिय प्रतिरक्षा (जब शरीर को सीधे बने-बनाए एंटीबॉडी बाहर से दिए जाते हैं)
148.example: Mother's milk provides passive immunity to the new-born infant.

148.english_meaning: The first secretion from the mammary glands after giving birth, rich in antibodies.
148.hindi_meaning: खीस (प्रसव के शुरुआती दिनों में माता द्वारा स्रावित पीला गाढ़ा तरल पदार्थ)
148.example: Colostrum contains abundant antibodies to protect the newborn infant from infections.

148.english_meaning: A organ that develops in the uterus during pregnancy, providing oxygen and nutrients to the growing baby.
148.hindi_meaning: अपरा या गर्भनाल (गर्भावस्था के दौरान भ्रूण को पोषण और एंटीबॉडी देने वाला अंग)
148.example: The foetus receives some antibodies from the mother through the placenta during pregnancy.

148.english_meaning: The administration of a vaccine to help the immune system develop protection from a disease.
148.hindi_meaning: टीकाकरण (शरीर में बीमारी से लड़ने की क्षमता विकसित करने के लिए टीका देना)
148.example: Vaccination is based on the property of 'memory' of the immune system.

148.english_meaning: A bacterium, virus, or other microorganism that can cause disease.
148.hindi_meaning: रोगाणु (बीमारी पैदा करने वाले सूक्ष्मजीव जैसे बैक्टीरिया या वायरस)
148.example: Inactivated pathogens are often used to manufacture safe vaccines.

148.english_meaning: To render something ineffective or harmless by applying an opposite force or effect.
148.hindi_meaning: निष्क्रिय करना (किसी हानिकारक प्रभाव को बेअसर करना)
148.example: The antibodies produced in the body would neutralise the pathogenic agents.

148.english_meaning: An antibody that neutralizes a particular toxin.
148.hindi_meaning: विषनाशक (एक ऐसी तैयारी जिसमें किसी विष या टॉक्सिन को बेअसर करने वाले एंटीबॉडी होते हैं)
148.example: In cases of deadly infections like tetanus, we need to directly inject an antitoxin.

148.english_meaning: A poisonous substance secreted by animals such as snakes, spiders, etc., usually transmitted by a bite or sting.
148.hindi_meaning: विष (सांप या बिच्छू आदि द्वारा काड़े जाने पर शरीर में छोड़ा जाने वाला जहर)
148.example: The injection given for snakebites contains preformed antibodies against the snake venom.

148.english_meaning: Denoting or relating to genetic material formed by combining genetic material from different sources.
148.hindi_meaning: पुनर्संयोजक (जेनेटिक इंजीनियरिंग द्वारा विभिन्न स्रोतों के डीएनए को मिलाकर बनाया गया)
148.example: Recombinant DNA technology allows the large-scale production of vaccines in yeast.

148.english_meaning: A linear organic polymer consisting of a large number of amino-acid residues bonded in a chain.
148.hindi_meaning: पॉलीपेप्टाइड (अमीनो एसिड की लंबी श्रृंखला से बना प्रोटीन का अणु)
148.example: Recombinant DNA technology has allowed the production of antigenic polypeptides of pathogens.

149.english_meaning: An exaggerated response of the immune system to certain environmental antigens.
149.hindi_meaning: पर्यावरण में मौजूद कुछ बाहरी पदार्थों के प्रति प्रतिरक्षा तंत्र की अत्यधिक प्रतिक्रिया (एलर्जी)
149.example: Pollen and dust mites are common triggers for a seasonal allergy.

149.english_meaning: Making a high-pitched whistling sound while breathing, typically due to obstructed airways.
149.hindi_meaning: सांस लेते समय सीटी जैसी आवाज आना (घड़घड़ाहट)
149.example: Asthma can cause coughing and wheezing during physical activity.

149.english_meaning: A substance that causes an allergic reaction.
149.example: Common indoor allergens include pet dander and house dust mites.

149.english_meaning: A blood protein produced in response to and counteracting a specific antigen.
149.hindi_meaning: प्रतिपिंड या एंटीबॉडी (शरीर द्वारा रोगजनकों से लड़ने के लिए बनाई जाने वाली प्रोटीन)
149.example: The body produces IgE antibodies during an allergic reaction.

149.english_meaning: A toxin or other foreign substance that induces an immune response in the body.
149.hindi_meaning: प्रतिजन या एंटीजन (वह पदार्थ जो प्रतिरक्षा प्रतिक्रिया को प्रेरित करता है)
149.example: White blood cells recognize specific antigens on the surface of bacteria.

149.english_meaning: A compound released by cells in response to injury and in allergic and inflammatory reactions.
149.hindi_meaning: हिस्टामाइन (मास्ट कोशिकाओं से स्रावित होने वाला रसायन जो एलर्जी के लक्षण पैदा करता है)
149.example: Anti-allergic medications work by blocking the effects of histamine.

149.english_meaning: A type of cell filled with histamine and other granules, found in connective tissue and involved in allergic responses.
149.hindi_meaning: मास्ट कोशिका (संयोजी ऊतक में पाई जाने वाली कोशिका जो हिस्टामाइन मुक्त करती है)
149.example: Mast cells release chemicals like histamine during an allergic flare-up.

149.english_meaning: The system of immune responses of an organism against its own healthy cells and tissues.
149.hindi_meaning: स्व-प्रतिरक्षिता (जब शरीर की अपनी ही कोशिकाओं के विरुद्ध प्रतिरक्षा तंत्र काम करने लगे)
149.example: Auto-immunity leads to the destruction of healthy body tissues.

149.english_meaning: A chronic progressive disease causing inflammation in the joints and resulting in painful deformity.
149.hindi_meaning: गठिया या रूमेटॉइड आर्थ्राइटिस (जोड़ों में सूजन और दर्द पैदा करने वाला ऑटो-इम्यून रोग)
149.example: Rheumatoid arthritis is a well-known chronic auto-immune condition.

149.english_meaning: Organs where the origin, maturation, and proliferation of lymphocytes occur.
149.hindi_meaning: लसिका अंग (वे अंग जहाँ लिम्फोसाइट्स का निर्माण, परिपक्वता और प्रचुरोद्भवन होता है)
149.example: Bone marrow and thymus are primary lymphoid organs.

149.english_meaning: A form of small white blood cell with a single round nucleus, occurring especially in the lymphatic system.
149.hindi_meaning: लिम्फोसाइट्स (श्वेत रक्त कणिकाओं का एक प्रकार जो प्रतिरक्षा में मुख्य भूमिका निभाता है)
149.example: Immature lymphocytes differentiate in primary lymphoid organs.

149.english_meaning: The process during which young, unspecialized cells take on individual characteristics and reach their mature form.
149.hindi_meaning: विभेदन (कोशिकाओं का परिपक्व और विशिष्ट कार्य के लिए रूप बदलना)
149.example: Stem cells undergo differentiation to become specialized tissue cells.

149.english_meaning: Rapid reproduction of a cell, part, or organism.
149.hindi_meaning: तेजी से संख्या में वृद्धि होना या प्रचुरोद्भवन
149.example: Antigen stimulation leads to the proliferation of specific lymphocytes.

149.english_meaning: A bacterium, virus, or other microorganism that can cause disease.
149.hindi_meaning: रोगजनक (बीमारी फैलाने वाले सूक्ष्मजीव जैसे बैक्टीरिया या वायरस)
149.example: The immune system protects the body from harmful pathogens.

149.english_meaning: A respiratory condition marked by spasms in the bronchi of the lungs, causing difficulty in breathing.
149.hindi_meaning: दमा या अस्थमा (सांस की नली में सूजन और संकुचन के कारण सांस लेने में कठिनाई होना)
149.example: Air pollution can trigger severe asthma attacks in children.

150.english_meaning: A type of white blood cell that is a fundamental part of the immune system.
150.hindi_meaning: श्वेत रक्त कोशिकाओं का एक प्रकार जो प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली का मुख्य हिस्सा है।
150.example: Lymphocytes play a crucial role in defending the body against infections.

150.english_meaning: The process of becoming fully developed or grown.
150.hindi_meaning: पूर्ण विकास या परिपक्व होने की प्रक्रिया।
150.example: The thymus provides a micro-environment for the maturation of T-cells.

150.english_meaning: To increase rapidly in numbers; multiply.
150.hindi_meaning: संख्या में तेजी से बढ़ना या गुणन करना।
150.example: After interacting with antigens, lymphocytes proliferate to fight the infection.

150.english_meaning: A lymphoid organ situated in the neck of vertebrates that produces T-cells.
150.hindi_meaning: हृदय के पास स्थित एक ग्रंथि जो टी-कोशिकाओं का निर्माण करती है।
150.example: The thymus is quite large at birth but shrinks as we age.

150.english_meaning: The period during which adolescents reach sexual maturity.
150.hindi_meaning: यौवनारंभ; वह अवस्था जब शरीर प्रजनन के लिए परिपक्व होता है।
150.example: The thymus gland reduces in size significantly by the time puberty is attained.

150.english_meaning: Cells that protect the body by ingesting harmful foreign particles and bacteria.
150.hindi_meaning: वे कोशिकाएं जो हानिकारक कणों और बैक्टीरिया को खाकर शरीर की रक्षा करती हैं।
150.example: Phagocytes act as the body's cleanup crew by destroying pathogens.

150.english_meaning: Red blood cells that carry oxygen throughout the body.
150.hindi_meaning: लाल रक्त कोशिकाएं जो शरीर में ऑक्सीजन का परिवहन करती हैं।
150.example: The spleen acts as a large reservoir for erythrocytes.

150.hindi_meaning: जन्मजात; जो जन्म से ही मौजूद हो।
150.example: AIDS is not a congenital disease as it is acquired during a person's lifetime.

150.english_meaning: A type of virus that uses RNA as its genetic material.
150.hindi_meaning: एक प्रकार का वायरस जो अपनी आनुवंशिक सामग्री के रूप में आरएनए (RNA) का उपयोग करता है।
150.example: HIV belongs to a group of viruses known as retroviruses.

150.english_meaning: The complete set of genetic material present in a cell or organism.
150.hindi_meaning: किसी कोशिका या जीव में मौजूद आनुवंशिक सामग्री का पूरा सेट।
150.example: The virus has an envelope enclosing its RNA genome.

150.english_meaning: The process of transferring blood or blood products into the circulation of a person.
150.hindi_meaning: रक्त या रक्त उत्पादों को किसी व्यक्ति के शरीर में चढ़ाने की प्रक्रिया।
150.example: HIV can be transmitted through the transfusion of contaminated blood.

150.english_meaning: Existing or taking place within, or administered into, a vein.
150.hindi_meaning: नसों के भीतर; जो सीधे नस में दिया या डाला जाए।
150.example: Intravenous drug abuse is a high-risk factor for HIV transmission.

150.english_meaning: An organ that develops in the uterus during pregnancy to provide nutrients to the fetus.
150.hindi_meaning: गर्भावस्था के दौरान गर्भाशय में विकसित होने वाला अंग जो भ्रूण को पोषण देता है।
150.example: The virus can pass from an infected mother to her child through the placenta.

150.english_meaning: A mucous membrane that lines various body cavities and tracts.
150.hindi_meaning: श्लेष्म झिल्ली जो शरीर के विभिन्न अंगों और नलिकाओं की आंतरिक परत बनाती है।
150.example: MALT is found in the lining of the respiratory and digestive tracts.

150.english_meaning: A toxin or other foreign substance that induces an immune response in the body.
150.hindi_meaning: कोई भी बाहरी पदार्थ जो शरीर में प्रतिरक्षा प्रतिक्रिया उत्पन्न करता है।
150.example: Lymph nodes trap antigens to trigger the immune response.

151.english_meaning: A type of virus that uses RNA as its genetic material and uses an enzyme called reverse transcriptase to copy that genetic material into the DNA of a host cell.
151.hindi_meaning: एक प्रकार का विषाणु जो आनुवंशिक पदार्थ के रूप में आरएनए (RNA) का उपयोग करता है
151.example: HIV is a retrovirus that attacks the immune system.

151.english_meaning: The action of copying or reproducing something, such as DNA or a virus.
151.hindi_meaning: प्रतिकृति या कॉपी तैयार करने की प्रक्रिया
151.example: The figure illustrates the replication of the retrovirus inside the host cell.

151.english_meaning: Existing or taking place within, or administered into, a vein or veins.
151.hindi_meaning: नसों के माध्यम से या शिराओं में सीधे
151.example: Drug addicts who take drugs intravenously are at a higher risk of contracting infections.

151.english_meaning: The process of pouring blood or blood components from one person into another's bloodstream.
151.hindi_meaning: रक्ताधान (एक व्यक्ति के शरीर से दूसरे व्यक्ति के शरीर में रक्त चढ़ाना)
151.example: Patients with severe anemia often require repeated blood transfusions.

151.english_meaning: Of vital importance; crucial; highly necessary.
151.example: It is imperative to maintain proper hygiene to prevent diseases.

151.english_meaning: Relating to the mental and emotional state of a person.
151.example: Counseling helps patients deal with the psychological stress of chronic illness.

151.english_meaning: Far away from other places, buildings, or people; remoted or separated.
151.example: Infected persons should not be isolated from their families and society.

151.english_meaning: A physical or mental feature which is regarded as indicating a condition of disease.
151.example: Fever and fatigue are common symptoms of many infections.

151.english_meaning: The process of infecting or the state of being infected by disease-causing organisms.
151.example: There is a time-lag between the initial infection and the appearance of symptoms.

151.english_meaning: Resistant to a particular infection or toxin.
151.example: HIV attacks the immune system, making the body vulnerable to other diseases.

151.english_meaning: A group of symptoms that consistently occur together or a condition characterized by a set of associated symptoms.
151.example: AIDS stands for Acquired Immuno Deficiency Syndrome.

151.english_meaning: Developed or obtained over time, rather than being innate or inherited.
151.hindi_meaning: अर्जित (जन्मजात नहीं बल्कि जीवनकाल में प्राप्त)
151.example: AIDS is an acquired condition, meaning it is not inherited from parents.

151.english_meaning: A lack or shortage of something essential.
151.example: Immune deficiency leaves the body unable to fight off minor infections.

151.english_meaning: The action or process of spreading something, such as a disease, from one person to another.
151.example: Understanding the modes of transmission helps in preventing HIV.

151.english_meaning: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy.
151.example: Physical and psychological well-being is important for every individual.

152.english_meaning: A type of white blood cell that surrounds and kills microorganisms and removes dead cells.
152.hindi_meaning: महाभक्षक कोशिकाएं (शरीर की वे कोशिकाएं जो रोगाणुओं को नष्ट करती हैं)
152.example: Macrophages play a crucial role in the body's immune response.

152.english_meaning: To make an exact copy of something, especially DNA or a virus.
152.hindi_meaning: प्रतिकृति बनाना (अपनी हूबहू नकल तैयार करना)
152.example: The virus needs a host cell to replicate its genetic material.

152.english_meaning: To include something as part of a larger whole.
152.example: The viral DNA is incorporated into the host cell's genome.

152.english_meaning: The offspring or descendants of a person, animal, or plant; in biology, new virus particles.
152.hindi_meaning: संतति या नई पीढ़ी (वायरस के संदर्भ में नए कण)
152.example: The infected cell releases thousands of progeny viruses.

152.english_meaning: Having an immune system that is not functioning properly or is weakened.
152.hindi_meaning: प्रतिरक्षा-हीन (जिसकी रोग प्रतिरोधक क्षमता कमजोर हो गई हो)
152.example: The patient became immuno-deficient and susceptible to various infections.

152.english_meaning: Relating to the identification of a disease or condition.
152.example: ELISA is a common diagnostic test used to detect HIV.

152.english_meaning: Certain to happen and unable to be avoided or prevented.
152.hindi_meaning: अपरिहार्य या जिसे टाला न जा सके
152.example: In some advanced stages of disease, death becomes inevitable.
The infection was spread inadvertently due to a lack of awareness.

152.english_meaning: Likely to be influenced or harmed by a particular thing.
152.hindi_meaning: संवेदनशील या अतिसंवेदनशील (रोग की चपेट में आने योग्य)
152.example: Elderly people are more susceptible to respiratory infections.

152.english_meaning: To persistently avoid, ignore, or reject someone through antipathy or caution.
152.example: Patients should be supported, not shunned by society.

152.english_meaning: Many and of various types; having many features or forms.
152.example: The risks of ignoring the problem are manifold.
This malady requires a collective effort from the medical fraternity.

152.english_meaning: A group of people sharing a common profession or interests.
152.example: The medical fraternity is working hard to find a cure.

152.english_meaning: Regarded with great fear or apprehension.
152.hindi_meaning: भयानक या जिससे बहुत डर लगता हो
152.example: Cancer is one of the most dreaded diseases worldwide.

152.english_meaning: Publicly recommending or supporting a particular cause or policy.
152.example: Health organizations are advocating for safe sex practices.

153.english_meaning: Causing or tending to cause the development of a tumor or tumors.
153.hindi_meaning: ट्यूमर या कैंसर उत्पन्न करने वाला
153.example: Oncogenic transformation of cells is a major area of biological research.

153.english_meaning: The process during which young, unspecialized cells take on individual characteristics and reach their mature form and function.
153.hindi_meaning: कोशिका विभेदन (अविभाजित कोशिकाओं का परिपक्व और विशिष्ट बनना)
153.example: In a healthy body, cell growth and differentiation are highly controlled and regulated.

153.english_meaning: A regulatory mechanism that stops normal cells from dividing when they come into contact with other cells.
153.hindi_meaning: संपर्क संदमन (वह प्रक्रिया जिसमें अन्य कोशिकाओं के संपर्क में आने से कोशिकाओं की अनियंत्रित वृद्धि रुक जाती है)
153.example: Normal cells show a property called contact inhibition, which is lost in cancer cells.

153.english_meaning: A swelling of a part of the body, generally without inflammation, caused by an abnormal growth of tissue.
153.hindi_meaning: गाँठ या ट्यूमर (कोशिकाओं की अनियंत्रित वृद्धि से बना समूह)
153.example: Cancerous cells continue to divide, giving rise to masses of cells called tumors.

153.english_meaning: Not harmful in effect; a tumor that does not spread to other parts of the body.
153.hindi_meaning: सौम्य (वह ट्यूमर जो अपने मूल स्थान तक ही सीमित रहता है और फैलता नहीं है)
153.example: Benign tumors normally remain confined to their original location and cause little damage.

153.english_meaning: Very virulent or infectious; cancerous tumors that invade surrounding tissues and spread to other parts of the body.
153.hindi_meaning: घातक या दुर्दम (वह कैंसरयुक्त ट्यूमर जो आसपास के ऊतकों को नुकसान पहुँचाता है और शरीर में फैलता है)
153.example: Malignant tumors consist of rapidly proliferating cells that invade surrounding tissues.

153.english_meaning: Relating to a new, abnormal growth of tissue (a neoplasm or tumor).
153.hindi_meaning: नियोप्लास्टिक (असामान्य या नई कोशिका वृद्धि से संबंधित)
153.example: The malignant tumors are a mass of proliferating cells called neoplastic cells.

153.hindi_meaning: तीव्रता से बढ़ने या गुणन करने वाली (कोशिकाएँ)
153.example: Malignant tumors are masses of proliferating cells that grow very rapidly.

153.english_meaning: The development of secondary malignant growths at a distance from a primary site of cancer.
153.hindi_meaning: मेटास्टेसिस (कैंसर कोशिकाओं का रक्त के माध्यम से शरीर के अन्य भागों में फैलकर नए ट्यूमर बनाना)
153.example: Metastasis is the most feared property of malignant tumors.

153.english_meaning: Substances capable of causing cancer in living tissue.
153.hindi_meaning: कार्सिनोजेन या कैंसरकारक पदार्थ (कैंसर पैदा करने वाले भौतिक, रासायनिक या जैविक कारक)
153.example: Tobacco smoke contains chemical carcinogens that are a major cause of lung cancer.

153.english_meaning: Normal genes in a cell that can be mutated into oncogenes, potentially causing cancer.
153.hindi_meaning: प्रोटो-ऑन्कोजीन (सामान्य कोशिकाओं में पाए जाने वाले वे जीन जो सक्रिय होने पर कैंसर का कारण बन सकते हैं)
153.example: Cellular oncogenes or proto-oncogenes are present in normal cells and can lead to oncogenic transformation when activated.

153.english_meaning: An examination of tissue removed from a living body to discover the presence, cause, or extent of a disease.
153.hindi_meaning: बायोप्सी या ऊतक परीक्षण (जांच के लिए जीवित शरीर से ऊतक का नमूना लेना)
153.example: Cancer detection is primarily based on biopsy and histopathological studies of the tissue.

153.english_meaning: Relating to the microscopic study of diseased tissue.
153.example: Thin sections of suspected tissue are stained and examined under a microscope for histopathological studies.

153.english_meaning: A malignant progressive disease in which the bone marrow and other blood-forming organs produce increased numbers of immature or abnormal leucocytes.
153.hindi_meaning: ल्यूकेमिया या रक्त का कैंसर (श्वेत रक्त कोशिकाओं की अनियंत्रित वृद्धि)
153.example: Blood and bone marrow tests are conducted for increased cell counts in the case of leukemias.

153.english_meaning: Imaging by sections or sectioning, through the use of any kind of penetrating wave.
153.hindi_meaning: टोमोग्राफी (एक्स-रे या अन्य तरंगों की मदद से शरीर के अंगों की त्रि-आयामी छवि प्राप्त करने की तकनीक)
153.example: Computed tomography uses X-rays to generate a three-dimensional image of the internals of an object.

154.english_meaning: The state of being likely or liable to be influenced or harmed by a particular thing.
154.hindi_meaning: संवेदनशीलता या किसी रोग के प्रति प्रवणता
154.example: Genetic testing helps identify an individual's susceptibility to certain hereditary diseases.

154.english_meaning: To make someone more likely to develop a particular illness or condition.
154.hindi_meaning: किसी रोग के प्रति पहले से झुकाव होना या प्रवृत्त करना
154.example: Certain genetic mutations can predispose a person to developing cancer.

154.english_meaning: Substances that are capable of causing cancer in living tissue.
154.example: Tobacco smoke contains numerous carcinogens that damage lung tissue.

154.english_meaning: The treatment of disease, especially cancer, using X-rays or similar forms of radiation.
154.example: The doctor recommended radiotherapy to shrink the tumor mass.

154.english_meaning: Treatment that uses the body's own immune system to fight diseases like cancer.
154.example: Immunotherapy has become a revolutionary approach in modern cancer treatment.

154.english_meaning: Relating to the treatment of disease by the use of chemical substances.
154.example: Chemotherapeutic drugs are designed to target and kill rapidly dividing cancerous cells.

154.english_meaning: Substances that stimulate or restore the ability of the immune system to fight infection and disease.
154.example: Alpha-interferon is a type of biological response modifier used to boost the immune system.

154.english_meaning: Relating to the stomach and the intestines.
154.hindi_meaning: जठरांत्र संबंधी (पेट और आंतों से संबंधित)
154.example: Opioid receptors are found throughout the central nervous system and the gastrointestinal tract.

154.english_meaning: A class of drugs that include natural and synthetic substances that bind to opioid receptors.
154.example: Opioids are often abused due to their powerful pain-relieving and sedative effects.

154.english_meaning: A group of substances found in the cannabis plant that interact with specific receptors in the brain.
154.hindi_meaning: भांग से प्राप्त होने वाले नशीले पदार्थ
154.example: Cannabinoids are known to affect the cardiovascular system of the body.

154.english_meaning: Naturally occurring chemical compounds that contain nitrogen and have physiological effects on humans.
154.example: Coca alkaloids are extracted from the leaves of the coca plant.

154.english_meaning: The chemical name for the drug commonly known as heroin.
154.example: Heroin is chemically known as diacetylmorphine.

154.english_meaning: Having the structure and form of a crystal; clear and transparent.
154.example: The substance appeared as a white, bitter crystalline compound.

154.english_meaning: A chemical reaction that introduces an acetyl group into an organic compound.
154.example: Heroin is produced through the acetylation of morphine.

154.english_meaning: A milky fluid found in many plants, which exudes when the plant is cut.
154.hindi_meaning: क्षीर या दूधिया रस (पौधों से निकलने वाला)
154.example: Morphine is extracted from the dried latex of the opium poppy.

155.english_meaning: A highly addictive illegal drug made from morphine that acts as a depressant on the body.
155.hindi_meaning: एक नशीली दवा (स्मैक) जो शरीर की गतिविधियों को धीमा करती है।
155.example: Heroin is generally taken by snorting and injection, slowing down body functions.

155.english_meaning: A drug that lowers neurotransmitter levels and depresses or slows down the central nervous system.
155.hindi_meaning: तंत्रिका तंत्र की गति को धीमा करने वाला या अवसाद पैदा करने वाला पदार्थ।
155.example: Heroin acts as a depressant and slows down body functions.

155.english_meaning: A group of chemical compounds that interact with receptors found principally in the human brain.
155.hindi_meaning: वे रसायन जो मस्तिष्क में स्थित कैनाबिनॉइड ग्राही (receptors) के साथ क्रिया करते हैं।
155.example: Natural cannabinoids are obtained from the inflorescences of the plant Cannabis sativa.

155.english_meaning: The complete cluster of flowers of a plant arranged on a stem.
155.hindi_meaning: पौधे का पुष्पक्रम या फूलों का गुच्छा।
155.example: Natural cannabinoids are obtained from the inflorescences of the plant Cannabis sativa.

155.english_meaning: The botanical name of the hemp plant from which marijuana and hashish are produced.
155.hindi_meaning: भांग का पौधा जिससे विभिन्न नशीले पदार्थ प्राप्त होते हैं।
155.example: The flower tops, leaves, and resin of Cannabis sativa are used to produce marijuana.

155.english_meaning: Relating to the heart and blood vessels.
155.hindi_meaning: हृदय और रक्त वाहिकाओं से संबंधित।
155.example: Cannabinoids are known for their effects on the cardiovascular system of the body.

155.english_meaning: Any of a class of nitrogenous organic compounds of plant origin which have pronounced physiological actions on humans.
155.hindi_meaning: पौधों से प्राप्त होने वाला नाइट्रोजन युक्त कार्बनिक यौगिक।
155.example: Coca alkaloid or cocaine is obtained from the coca plant Erythroxylum coca.

155.english_meaning: A chemical substance that is released at the end of a nerve fiber by the arrival of a nerve impulse.
155.hindi_meaning: तंत्रिका संकेत पहुंचाने वाला रासायनिक संदेशवाहक।
155.example: Cocaine interferes with the transport of the neuro-transmitter dopamine.

155.english_meaning: A state of intense happiness and self-confidence, often artificially induced by drugs.
155.hindi_meaning: अत्यधिक प्रसन्नता या उल्लास की झूठी भावना।
155.example: Cocaine produces a sense of euphoria and increased energy.

155.english_meaning: An experience involving the apparent perception of something not present.
155.hindi_meaning: भ्रम या ऐसी चीजें देखना-सुनाना जो वास्तव में मौजूद न हों।
155.example: Excessive dosage of cocaine causes hallucinations.

155.hindi_meaning: भ्रम पैदा करने वाला या मानसिक स्थिति बदलने वाला।
155.example: Other well-known plants with hallucinogenic properties are Atropa belladonna and Datura.

155.english_meaning: Drugs that act as central nervous system depressants, used as sedatives or sleeping pills.
155.hindi_meaning: केंद्रीय तंत्रिका तंत्र को शांत करने वाली और नींद लाने वाली दवाइयां।
155.example: Drugs like barbiturates and amphetamines are often abused.

155.english_meaning: A drug promoting calmness or sleep.
155.hindi_meaning: शांत करने वाली या नींद लाने वाली दवा (शामक)।
155.example: Morphine is a very effective sedative and painkiller.

155.english_meaning: Relating to the branch of biology that deals with the normal functions of living organisms.
155.hindi_meaning: शारीरिक या जैविक क्रियाओं से संबंधित।
155.example: Drug abuse impairs one's physical, physiological, or psychological functions.

155.english_meaning: The habitual taking of addictive or illegal drugs for non-medicinal purposes.
155.hindi_meaning: नशीली दवाओं का चिकित्सीय उद्देश्य के अलावा या अत्यधिक मात्रा में दुरुपयोग।
155.example: Taking drugs in amounts that impair physical functions constitutes drug abuse.

156.english_meaning: A class of naturally occurring organic nitrogen-containing compounds, many of which have pharmacological effects.
156.hindi_meaning: एक प्रकार का कार्बनिक यौगिक (क्षarakीय नाइट्रोजन यौगिक)
156.example: Tobacco contains nicotine, which is a harmful alkaloid.

156.english_meaning: A toxic colorless or yellowish oily liquid that is the chief active constituent of tobacco.
156.hindi_meaning: निकोटिन (तंबाकू में पाया जाने वाला विषैला तत्व)
156.example: Nicotine stimulates the adrenal gland to release adrenaline into the blood circulation.

156.english_meaning: Either of two small triangular endocrine glands situated above the kidneys.
156.example: Stress causes the adrenal glands to release hormones like adrenaline.

156.english_meaning: A hormone secreted by the adrenal glands, especially in conditions of stress, increasing rates of blood circulation and breathing.
156.hindi_meaning: एड्रीनलीन (हार्मोन जो हृदय गति और रक्तचाप बढ़ाता है)
156.example: The hormone adrenaline increases heart rate and blood pressure.

156.english_meaning: A serious disease that destroys lung tissue and causes breathing difficulties.
156.hindi_meaning: फेफड़ों की एक गंभीर बीमारी जिसमें सांस लेने में कठिनाई होती है
156.example: Long-term smoking is a primary cause of chronic bronchitis and emphysema.

156.english_meaning: A legally required warning notice placed on consumer products like tobacco or alcohol.
156.example: Cigarette packets must display a prominent statutory warning against smoking.

156.english_meaning: Harmful or damaging, especially to health or reputation.
156.example: Smoking tobacco is injurious to health.

156.english_meaning: Widespread in a particular area or at a particular time.
156.example: Despite the known dangers, smoking remains prevalent among youth.
Nicotine is highly addictive, making it difficult for smokers to quit.

156.english_meaning: Professional guidance of the individual by utilizing psychological methods.
156.example: Drug addicts require proper counselling and medical help to recover.

156.english_meaning: The period following the onset of puberty during which a young person develops from a child into an adult.
156.example: Adolescence is a critical phase of physical and psychological development.

156.english_meaning: Exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed, either physically or emotionally.
156.hindi_meaning: संवेदनशील / असुरक्षित / आघात के प्रति संवेदनशील
156.example: Adolescents are particularly vulnerable to peer pressure and stress.

156.english_meaning: A way of regarding, understanding, or interpreting something; a mental impression.
156.example: The wrong perception that smoking is 'cool' leads many youth towards addiction.

156.english_meaning: The action or process of trying out new ideas, methods, or activities out of curiosity.
156.example: Curiosity and experimentation are common reasons why teenagers try drugs.

156.english_meaning: Influence from members of one's peer group, often pushing someone to adopt certain behaviors.
156.example: Many youngsters start consuming alcohol due to severe peer pressure.

158.english_meaning: Into or connected to the inside of a vein.
158.hindi_meaning: नस के भीतर (सीधे नस में सुई द्वारा)
158.example: The medicine was administered intravenously to ensure a rapid effect.

158.english_meaning: Persisting for a long time or constantly recurring.
158.example: Chronic smoking can lead to serious respiratory problems.

158.english_meaning: Causing or capable of causing death.
158.example: The accident proved fatal for the driver.

158.english_meaning: A chronic disease of the liver marked by degeneration of cells and inflammation.
158.hindi_meaning: यकृत का रोग (लिवर का खराब होना)
158.example: Excessive alcohol consumption is a leading cause of liver cirrhosis.

158.english_meaning: An unborn offspring of a mammal in the later stages of development.
158.example: Smoking during pregnancy can harm the development of the foetus.

158.english_meaning: Drugs that act to relieve pain.
158.example: The doctor prescribed analgesics to manage the patient's post-operative pain.

158.english_meaning: Synthetic substances similar to the male hormone testosterone, used to build muscle.
158.hindi_meaning: मांसपेशियों को बढ़ाने वाली कृत्रिम दवाएं
158.example: The athlete was disqualified for using anabolic steroids to boost performance.

158.english_meaning: Substances that cause increased passing of urine.
158.example: Diuretics are often used to treat high blood pressure by removing excess fluid.

158.english_meaning: The development of male physical characteristics in a female.
158.hindi_meaning: स्त्रियों में पुरुषों जैसे शारीरिक लक्षण विकसित होना
158.example: Hormonal imbalances can sometimes lead to masculinisation in women.

158.english_meaning: Abnormality or impairment in the function of a specified bodily organ or system.
158.example: Prolonged drug use can lead to kidney dysfunction.

158.english_meaning: Prevented from growing or developing properly.
158.example: Malnutrition in childhood often leads to stunted growth.

158.english_meaning: A short, pithy statement expressing a general truth.
158.example: The adage 'haste makes waste' is still relevant today.

158.english_meaning: Intended as a remedy or to improve a situation.
158.example: The school organized remedial classes for students who were struggling.

158.english_meaning: The act of providing care, support, and encouragement.
158.example: Children thrive when they receive both discipline and nurturance.

158.english_meaning: The level or point at which something starts to happen or have an effect.
158.example: Everyone has a different threshold for pain.

159.english_meaning: Relating to the mental and emotional state of a person.
159.example: Health involves complete physical, mental, social, and psychological well-being.

159.english_meaning: Diseases transmitted to humans by blood-feeding insects or other animals.
159.hindi_meaning: वाहन जनित (कीटों आदि द्वारा फैलने वाला)
159.example: Malaria is a well-known vector-borne disease spread by mosquitoes.
Certain strains of malaria, if untreated, may prove fatal.

159.english_meaning: The process of cleansing an object or substance to remove contaminants such as microorganisms or hazardous materials.
159.example: Decontamination of drinking water helps prevent waterborne diseases.

159.english_meaning: The action of making a person or animal immune to infection, typically by vaccination.
159.example: Childhood immunisation protects against many serious infections.

159.english_meaning: Inborn; natural; defenses that an organism is born with.
159.example: Skin and mucous membranes are part of the body's innate defenses.

159.english_meaning: Relating to, secreting, or of the nature of mucus.
159.example: Mucous membranes line various cavities in the body and protect against pathogens.

159.english_meaning: Active against micro-organisms, especially bacteria or other harmful living microorganisms.
159.example: Tears and saliva contain antimicrobial substances that help block pathogens.

159.english_meaning: Relating to cells that engulf and absorb bacteria and other foreign particles.
159.example: Phagocytic cells destroy harmful invaders in the body.

159.english_meaning: A bacterium, virus, or other microorganism that can cause disease.
159.example: White blood cells help destroy pathogens that enter the body.

159.english_meaning: Blood proteins produced in response to and counteracting a specific antigen.
159.example: Specific antibodies protect the body through humoral immune response.

159.english_meaning: Professional guidance of the individual by utilizing psychological methods.
159.example: Education and counselling help young people face stresses and disappointments.
Appropriate medical measures are required to diagnose the underlying malady.

159.english_meaning: Medical practitioners specializing in the diagnosis and treatment of mental illness.
159.example: Psychiatrists and psychologists offer professional help for addiction and mental health issues.

159.english_meaning: A soft boggy area of land; metaphorically, a complex or hazardous situation.
159.hindi_meaning: दलदल / बुरी स्थिति में फंस जाना
159.example: Rehabilitation programmes help individuals trapped in the quagmire of drug abuse.

160.english_meaning: Treatment with a vaccine to produce immunity against a disease.
160.example: Vaccination is a crucial public health measure to prevent infectious diseases.

160.english_meaning: The process by which an individual's immune system becomes fortified against an agent.
160.example: Proper immunisation helps the body fight off harmful pathogens.

160.english_meaning: Relating to the healing of disease.
160.example: Early detection allows for more effective therapeutic measures against cancer.

160.english_meaning: Young people in the process of developing from a child into an adult.
160.example: Adolescents are often more susceptible to peer pressure regarding drug abuse.

160.english_meaning: Causing or likely to cause someone to become dependent on a substance.
160.example: The addictive nature of these substances makes them extremely difficult to quit.

160.english_meaning: The provision of professional assistance and guidance in resolving personal problems.
160.example: Professional counselling can help individuals overcome substance abuse.

160.english_meaning: Likely to be transmitted to people, organisms, etc., through the environment.
160.example: Public health measures are essential to control the spread of infectious diseases.

160.english_meaning: The action or process of passing something from one person or place to another.
160.example: Understanding the mode of transmission is key to preventing malaria.

160.english_meaning: Relating to or denoting the tissue in which lymphocytes are formed.
160.example: The bone marrow and thymus are primary lymphoid organs.

160.english_meaning: Inborn; natural immunity present from birth.
160.example: Innate immunity provides the first line of defense against pathogens.

160.english_meaning: Developed or learned; not present at birth.
160.example: Acquired immunity is developed after exposure to a specific antigen.

160.english_meaning: A blood protein produced in response to and counteracting a specific antigen.
160.example: The body produces an antibody molecule to neutralize the virus.

160.english_meaning: A system of parts working together in a machine or a biological process.
160.example: The mechanism of viral replication explains how the disease spreads.

160.english_meaning: The development of secondary malignant growths at a distance from a primary site of cancer.
160.example: Metastasis is the most dangerous characteristic of malignant tumors.

160.english_meaning: A lack or shortage of something.
160.example: HIV causes a severe deficiency in the immune system.

161.english_meaning: Visible to the naked eye; not microscopic.
161.hindi_meaning: स्थूल या विशाल (जिसे नग्न आँखों से देखा जा सके)
161.example: Besides macroscopic plants and animals, microbes are major components of biological systems.

161.english_meaning: A microorganism, especially a bacterium causing disease or fermentation.
161.example: Microbes are present everywhere in soil, water, air, and inside our bodies.

161.english_meaning: The state of being diverse; variety.
161.example: You have studied about the diversity of living organisms in Class XI.

161.english_meaning: So small as to be visible only with a microscope.
161.example: Which are the ones that are only microscopic?

161.english_meaning: Hot springs in which water intermittently boils, sending a column of water and steam into the air.
161.example: Microbes exist deep inside the geysers where the temperature may be very high.

161.english_meaning: Relating to or caused by heat.
161.example: Thermal vents support life-forms that can survive extreme heat.

161.english_meaning: Having the properties of an acid; having a pH below 7.
161.example: Some microbes can survive in highly acidic environments.

161.english_meaning: A diverse group of single-celled eukaryotic organisms.
161.example: Microbes are diverse, including protozoa, bacteria, and fungi.

161.english_meaning: A group of spore-producing organisms feeding on organic matter, including moulds, yeast, and mushrooms.
161.example: Microbes like bacteria and many fungi can be grown on nutritive media.

161.english_meaning: Infectious agents consisting of a short piece of naked RNA, affecting plants.
161.hindi_meaning: वायरोइड (संक्रमित करने वाले छोटे आरएनए अणु)
161.example: Plant viruses, viroids, and prions are also studied under microbiology.

161.english_meaning: Misfolded proteins that can transmit their misfolded shape onto normal variants of the same protein.
Relating to or consisting of protein.

161.example: Bacteria and fungi can be grown on nutritive media to form colonies.

161.english_meaning: A visible cluster of microorganisms growing on a solid medium.
161.example: Bacteria can be grown on nutritive media to form colonies.

161.english_meaning: A method of cultivating microorganisms in a prepared nutrient medium.
161.hindi_meaning: संवर्धन (माइक्रोब्स को कृत्रिम रूप से उगाना)
161.example: Such cultures are useful in studies on micro-organisms.

164.english_meaning: A metabolic process that converts sugar to acids, gases, or alcohol using yeasts or bacteria.
164.hindi_meaning: किण्वन (शर्करा का अल्कोहल या अम्ल में बदलने की जैव रासायनिक प्रक्रिया)
164.example: Yeast is used for the fermentation of malted cereals to produce ethanol.

164.english_meaning: Drinks of any kind, especially alcoholic drinks in this context.
164.example: Microbes have been used from time immemorial for the production of beverages like wine and beer.

164.english_meaning: A volatile, flammable, colorless liquid that is the active ingredient in alcoholic drinks.
164.example: Brewer's yeast is used for fermenting fruit juices to produce ethanol.

164.english_meaning: The action of purifying a liquid by a process of heating and cooling.
164.hindi_meaning: आसवन (पदार्थ को गर्म करके वाष्प बनाने और फिर उसे ठंडा करके शुद्ध करने की प्रक्रिया)
164.example: Whisky and brandy are produced by distillation of the fermented broth.

164.english_meaning: A liquid medium containing nutrients used for growing microorganisms.
164.hindi_meaning: सूप / पोषक द्रव माध्यम (सूक्ष्मजीवों को उगाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला तरल)
164.example: Whisky, brandy, and rum are produced by distillation of the fermented broth.

164.english_meaning: Medicines that inhibit the growth of or destroy microorganisms like bacteria.
164.hindi_meaning: प्रतिजैविक (सूक्ष्मजीवों द्वारा निर्मित पदार्थ जो अन्य रोग पैदा करने वाले जीवों को मारते हैं)
164.example: Antibiotics produced by microbes are regarded as one of the most significant discoveries of the twentieth century.

174.english_meaning: To make an exact copy of or reproduce, as DNA does during cell division.
174.example: These molecules can replicate independently within the cell.

174.english_meaning: Placing something back into position or into something else.
174.example: He developed a method of reinserting plasmids into other cells.

174.english_meaning: The process of joining or connecting pieces of DNA together.
174.example: DNA splicing enabled scientists to combine segments of genetic material.

174.english_meaning: To combine elements or parts in a new way.
174.example: They learned how to recombine segments of DNA in desired configurations.

174.english_meaning: A sudden, important advance or discovery.
174.example: This scientific breakthrough changed the field of medicine.

174.english_meaning: The exploitation of biological processes for industrial and other purposes.
174.example: This discovery was the basis upon which the discipline of biotechnology was founded.

175.english_meaning: The use of living organisms or their products to modify human health and human environment.
175.example: Biotechnology plays a crucial role in developing modern vaccines and medicines.

175.english_meaning: Substances produced by living organisms that act as catalysts to bring about specific biochemical reactions.
175.example: Digestive enzymes help break down food in the stomach.

175.english_meaning: Brought about or influenced by microbes or microorganisms.
175.example: Making curd from milk is a microbe-mediated process.

175.english_meaning: Having had its genetic material altered using genetic engineering techniques.
175.example: Genetically modified crops can resist certain pests and diseases.

175.english_meaning: Taking place in a test tube, culture dish, or elsewhere outside a living organism.
175.example: In vitro fertilisation has helped many couples have children.

175.english_meaning: Producing something by chemical or biochemical synthesis.
175.example: Scientists are working on synthesising artificial genes in the laboratory.

175.english_meaning: Surrounds and holds within; includes comprehensively.
175.example: The new syllabus encompasses both traditional and modern topics.

175.english_meaning: The action or process of combining two or more things to be more effective.
175.example: The integration of technology in education improves learning outcomes.

175.english_meaning: A person or thing comparable to another in certain respects.
175.example: Researchers study molecular analogues to understand drug interactions.

175.english_meaning: The deliberate modification of the characteristics of an organism by manipulating its genetic material.
175.example: Genetic engineering allows scientists to transfer useful genes between species.
Recombinant DNA technology is widely used in producing insulin.

175.english_meaning: Individual animal, plant, or single-celled life form.
175.example: Microscopic organisms live in every corner of the earth.

175.english_meaning: Relating to or consisting of molecules.
175.example: Molecular biology helps us understand the structure of DNA.

175.english_meaning: A group of states or organizations with a central government or coordinating body.
175.example: The European Federation of Biotechnology sets guidelines for research.

175.english_meaning: The branch of science concerned with the substances of which matter is composed.
175.example: Genetic engineering alters the chemistry of genetic material.

176.english_meaning: The observable physical or biochemical characteristics of an organism, determined by both genetic makeup and environmental influences.
176.hindi_meaning: दृश्यप्ररूप; किसी जीव के शारीरिक या जैवरासायनिक लक्षण जो उसके जीन और पर्यावरण द्वारा तय होते हैं।
176.example: Genetic engineering changes the phenotype of the host organism by introducing foreign DNA.

176.english_meaning: Maintenance of sterile ambience in chemical engineering processes to grow desired microbes or eukaryotic cells in large quantities.
176.hindi_meaning: जैव-प्रक्रिया अभियांत्रिकीय; रासायनिक प्रक्रियाओं में रोगाणुमुक्त वातावरण बनाए रखना ताकि केवल वांछित सूक्ष्मजीवों का संवर्धन किया जा सके।
176.example: Bioprocess engineering is essential for the large-scale manufacture of antibiotics and vaccines.

176.english_meaning: Free from bacteria or other living microorganisms; totally clean and aseptic.
176.hindi_meaning: संक्रमणमुक्त या रोगाणुमुक्त; जो बैक्टीरिया या अन्य सूक्ष्मजीवों से पूरी तरह मुक्त हो।
176.example: It is necessary to maintain a sterile ambience to prevent microbial contamination.

176.english_meaning: The process of combining different varieties of organisms or species to create a hybrid.
176.hindi_meaning: संकरण; दो अलग-अलग प्रजातियों या किस्मों के जीवों को आपस में मिलाकर नई नस्ल या हाइब्रिड तैयार करने की प्रक्रिया।
176.example: Traditional hybridisation procedures often lead to the inclusion of undesirable genes.

176.english_meaning: DNA molecules formed by laboratory methods of genetic recombination to bring together genetic material from multiple sources.
176.hindi_meaning: पुनर्योगज डीएनए; प्रयोगशाला में विभिन्न स्रोतों से डीएनए खंडों को जोड़कर बनाया गया कृत्रिम डीएनए अणु।
176.example: The techniques of genetic engineering include the creation of recombinant DNA.

176.english_meaning: The process of producing genetically identical copies of a biological entity.
176.hindi_meaning: क्लोनिंग; किसी जैविक इकाई या डीएनए की बिल्कुल समान प्रतियां बनाने की प्रक्रिया।
176.example: Gene cloning allows researchers to make multiple identical copies of any template DNA.

176.english_meaning: A descendant or the descendants of a person, animal, or plant; offspring.
176.hindi_meaning: संतान या संतति; किसी जीव या पौधे की अगली पीढ़ी।
176.example: The alien DNA might not be able to multiply itself in the progeny cells of the organism.

176.english_meaning: Combined with other parts or entities to form a coordinated whole.
176.hindi_meaning: समेकित या अंतःस्थापित; जो किसी अन्य व्यवस्था या संरचना का हिस्सा बन गया हो।
176.example: When foreign DNA gets integrated into the recipient genome, it multiplies along with host DNA.

176.english_meaning: The complete set of genes or genetic material present in a cell or organism.
176.hindi_meaning: जीनोम; किसी जीव की कोशिकाओं में मौजूद कुल आनुवंशिक सामग्री या जीन का संपूर्ण सेट।
176.example: The transferred gene successfully integrated into the host genome.

176.english_meaning: To make an exact copy of; reproduce, as in DNA replication.
176.hindi_meaning: प्रतिकृतिकरण करना या हूबहू प्रतिलिपि बनाना; डीएनए का अपनी जैसी दूसरी कॉपी तैयार करना।
176.example: The origin of replication enables the chromosome to replicate itself.

176.english_meaning: Causing a process or action to begin.

176.english_meaning: A genetic structure in a cell that can replicate independently of the chromosomes, typically a small circular DNA strand in bacteria.
176.hindi_meaning: प्लास्मिड; जीवाणु कोशिका के भीतर पाया जाने वाला वृत्ताकार अतिरिक्त गुणसूकीय डीएनए जो स्वतंत्र रूप से प्रतिकृति कर सकता है।

176.english_meaning: Acting independently or having the freedom to do so.
176.hindi_meaning: स्वायत्त रूप से या स्वतंत्र रूप से।

176.english_meaning: Granting or bestowing a quality, power, or advantage.
176.hindi_meaning: प्रदान करना या सौंपना (कोई गुण या विशेषता)।

176.hindi_meaning: सफलतापूर्वक पूरा किया गया या संपादित किया गया।

177.english_meaning: The exploitation of biological processes for industrial and other purposes, especially the genetic manipulation of microorganisms for the production of antibiotics, hormones, etc.
177.example: Biotechnology plays a crucial role in developing new medicines and vaccines.

177.english_meaning: A genetic structure in a cell that can replicate independently of the chromosomes, typically a small circular DNA strand in the cytoplasm of a bacterium or protozoan.
177.hindi_meaning: प्लास्मिड (स्वतंत्र रूप से प्रतिकृति बनाने वाला वृत्ताकार डीएनए)
177.example: Plasmids are commonly used as vectors in recombinant DNA technology.

177.english_meaning: An organism, typically a biting insect or virus, that transmits a disease or parasite from one animal or plant to another, or a DNA molecule used as a vehicle to artificially carry foreign genetic material into another cell.
177.example: A plasmid can be used as a vector to deliver an alien piece of DNA into the host organism.

177.english_meaning: DNA that has been formed artificially by combining constituents from different organisms.
177.example: Recombinant DNA technology allows scientists to combine genes from different species.

177.english_meaning: (Of a process) performed or taking place in a test tube, culture dish, or elsewhere outside a living organism.

177.english_meaning: The process of producing genetically identical individuals of an organism either naturally or artificially.

177.english_meaning: A descendant or the descendants of a person, animal, or plant; offspring.

177.hindi_meaning: एंडोन्यूक्लीज (डीएनए श्रृंखला को भीतर से काटने वाला एन्जाइम)

177.english_meaning: An enzyme that brings about ligation of DNA or another substance.
177.hindi_meaning: लाइगेज (डीएनए खंडों को जोड़ने वाला एन्जाइम)

177.english_meaning: Deduce or conclude (information) from evidence and reasoning rather than from explicit statements.

178.english_meaning: A particular order in which related things (like nucleotides in DNA) follow each other.

179.english_meaning: Formed by recombining genetic material from different sources.
