179.english_meaning: The complete set of genes or genetic material present in a cell or organism.
179.hindi_meaning: किसी जीव के कुल जीनों या आनुवंशिक सामग्री का संपूर्ण सेट (जीनोम)।

179.english_meaning: Small parts broken off or derived from something larger.

179.english_meaning: Represented in or in the form of a diagram or graph.

179.english_meaning: People or things holding a position or having a function corresponding to that of another person or thing.

180.english_meaning: A DNA molecule used as a vehicle to artificially carry foreign genetic material into another cell.

181.example: Modern biotechnology has revolutionized the production of medicines and agricultural crops.

181.english_meaning: The process of producing genetically identical individuals of an organism either naturally or artificially.
181.example: Gene cloning is essential for producing multiple copies of a specific DNA segment.

181.english_meaning: A DNA molecule used as a vehicle to artificially carry foreign genetic material into another cell.
181.example: Plasmids are commonly used as vectors in recombinant DNA technology.

181.english_meaning: The action of copying or reproducing something, specifically the process by which a double-stranded DNA molecule is copied to produce two identical DNA molecules.
181.example: DNA replication ensures that each resulting cell receives an exact copy of the genetic material.

181.english_meaning: An organism or cell that harbors another organism or foreign genetic material.
181.example: Bacteria are often used as host cells to express foreign genes.

181.english_meaning: A gene introduced into a cell that confers a trait suitable for artificial selection, helping to identify transformants.
181.example: Antibiotic resistance genes act as effective selectable markers in molecular biology.

181.english_meaning: A cell that has taken up foreign DNA and undergone transformation.
181.example: The nutrient medium selectively allows the growth of bacterial transformants.

181.english_meaning: A medicine that inhibits the growth of or destroys microorganisms like bacteria.
181.example: Ampicillin and tetracycline are commonly used antibiotics in genetic research.

181.english_meaning: An enzyme that cleaves DNA into fragments at specific recognition sites.
181.example: Restriction enzymes act as molecular scissors to cut DNA at precise locations.

181.english_meaning: A small part broken off or detached from something.
181.example: The restriction enzyme cut the DNA into multiple fragments.

181.english_meaning: The joining of two nucleic acid fragments together through the action of an enzyme like DNA ligase.
181.example: The ligation of alien DNA into the plasmid vector is a crucial step in genetic engineering.

181.english_meaning: Foreign DNA originating from a different organism that is inserted into a host vector.
181.example: Scientists successfully integrated alien DNA into the plasmid.

181.english_meaning: Denoting or relating to an organism or cell produced by the recombination of genes.
181.example: Recombinant plasmids carry foreign DNA inserted into their sequence.

181.english_meaning: A genetic structure in a cell that can replicate independently of the chromosomes, typically a small circular DNA strand in bacteria.
181.example: pBR322 is a widely used artificial plasmid vector in laboratories.

181.english_meaning: The action of introducing something inside or into something else.
181.example: The insertion of foreign DNA disrupted the tetracycline resistance gene.

182.english_meaning: Cells or organisms that contain newly combined genetic material formed by recombinant DNA technology.
182.hindi_meaning: पुनर्संयोजज; वे जीव या कोशिकाएँ जिनमें पुनः संयोजित डीएनए होता है।
182.example: The selection of recombinants is crucial for successful genetic engineering experiments.

182.english_meaning: Large, heavy, slow, or complicated and therefore inefficient.
182.hindi_meaning: बोझिल या जटिल; जो कठिन और समय लेने वाला हो।
182.example: This manual procedure is too cumbersome for large-scale industrial production.

182.english_meaning: Producing color or capable of producing color, especially as a result of a chemical reaction.
182.hindi_meaning: वर्णोत्पादक; रंग उत्पन्न करने वाला पदार्थ।
182.example: A chromogenic substrate is used to detect the activity of the enzyme.

182.english_meaning: The disruption of a gene's function by inserting a piece of foreign DNA into its coding sequence.
182.hindi_meaning: निवेशन निष्क्रियीकरण; बाहरी डीएनए के प्रवेश से जीन की कार्यक्षमता का समाप्त होना।
182.example: Insertional inactivation of the beta-galactosidase gene helps in identifying recombinant colonies.

182.english_meaning: A bacterium, virus, or other microorganism that can cause disease.
182.hindi_meaning: रोगाणु या जनक; बीमारी पैदा करने वाला सूक्ष्मजीव।
182.example: Agrobacterium tumefaciens is a well-known plant pathogen.

182.english_meaning: Relating to an organism consisting of a cell or cells in which the genetic material is DNA in the form of chromosomes contained within a distinct nucleus.
182.example: Plants and animals are composed of eukaryotic cells.

182.english_meaning: A type of virus that uses RNA as its genetic material and inserts a DNA copy of its genome into the host cell.
182.hindi_meaning: रेट्रोवाइरस; एक प्रकार का वायरस जो आरएनए को आनुवंशिक सामग्री के रूप में उपयोग करता है।
182.example: Retroviruses in animals have the ability to transform normal cells into cancerous cells.

182.english_meaning: An organism or DNA molecule used as a vehicle to artificially carry foreign genetic material into another cell.
182.hindi_meaning: वाहक; डीएनए या जीन को दूसरी कोशिका तक पहुँचाने वाला माध्यम।
182.example: Plasmids are commonly used as cloning vectors in biotechnology.

182.english_meaning: Deprived of the ability to harm or cause disease (referring to a pathogen).
182.hindi_meaning: हानिरहित किया गया; रोग फैलाने की क्षमता से मुक्त किया हुआ।
182.example: The tumor-inducing plasmid was disarmed before being used as a vector.

182.english_meaning: Joined together, typically strands of DNA, using an enzyme like DNA ligase.
182.hindi_meaning: जुड़ा हुआ; डीएनए खंडों का आपस में जोड़ा जाना।
182.example: The foreign gene was successfully ligated into the plasmid vector.

182.english_meaning: Having the necessary ability or qualities; in cell biology, able to take up extracellular DNA.
182.hindi_meaning: सक्षम; कोशिका के संदर्भ में, डीएनए ग्रहण करने में सक्षम।
182.example: Bacterial cells must be made competent before they can take up recombinant DNA.

182.english_meaning: Having a tendency to mix with, dissolve in, or be wetted by water.
182.hindi_meaning: जलरागी; पानी की ओर आकर्षित होने वाला या पानी में घुलनशील।
182.example: Because DNA is a hydrophilic molecule, it cannot easily pass through cell membranes.

182.english_meaning: Having a valence of two; capable of combining with two monovalent atoms or groups.
182.hindi_meaning: द्विंसयोजी; जिसकी संयोजकता दो हो (जैसे कैल्शियम आयन)।
182.example: A specific concentration of a divalent cation like calcium is used to treat bacterial cells.

182.english_meaning: A positively charged ion, as would be attracted to the cathode in electrolysis.
182.hindi_meaning: धनायन; सकारात्मक रूप से आवेशित आयन।
182.example: Calcium is a divalent cation used in the transformation process.

182.english_meaning: The genetic alteration of a cell resulting from the direct uptake and incorporation of exogenous genetic material from its surroundings.
182.hindi_meaning: रूपांतरण; कोशिकाओं द्वारा बाहर से डीएनए ग्रहण करके उसके आनुवंशिक स्वरूप में बदलाव।
182.example: Transformation is a key step in introducing recombinant DNA into host cells.

183.english_meaning: Formed by combining genetic material from different sources.
183.hindi_meaning: पुनर्संयोजक (विभिन्न स्रोतों से आनुवंशिक सामग्री को मिलाकर बनाया गया)
183.example: Recombinant DNA is forced into bacterial cells during the transformation process.

183.english_meaning: A technique where DNA is directly injected into the nucleus of a cell using a microscopic needle.
183.hindi_meaning: सूक्ष्म-अंतःक्षेपण (कोशिका के केंद्रक में सीधे डीएनए डालने की तकनीक)
183.example: In micro-injection, recombinant DNA is directly injected into the nucleus of an animal cell.

183.english_meaning: A method of introducing DNA into cells by bombarding them with high-velocity micro-particles coated with DNA.
183.hindi_meaning: बायोलिस्टिक्स / जीन गन तकनीक (उच्च वेग वाले कणों द्वारा कोशिकाओं में डीएनए प्रवेश कराना)
183.example: Biolistics is a method suitable for plant cells where they are bombarded with gold particles.

183.english_meaning: An organism or DNA molecule used as a vehicle to artificially carry foreign genetic material into another cell.
183.hindi_meaning: संवाहक / वेक्टर (विदेशी आनुवंशिक सामग्री को दूसरी कोशिका में ले जाने वाला माध्यम)
183.example: Disarmed pathogen vectors can transfer recombinant DNA into the host cell.

183.english_meaning: An enzyme that cleaves the phosphodiester bond within a polynucleotide chain.
183.hindi_meaning: एंडोन्यूक्लीज (न्यूक्लिक अम्ल श्रृंखला के भीतर से काटने वाला एंजाइम)
183.example: DNA is fragmented using restriction endonucleases during genetic engineering.

183.english_meaning: The joining of two nucleic acid fragments through the action of an enzyme.
183.hindi_meaning: लाइगेशन (डीएनए खंडों को आपस में जोड़ने की प्रक्रिया)
183.example: Ligation of the DNA fragment into a vector is a crucial step in recombinant DNA technology.

183.english_meaning: The action of isolating or setting apart something from other material.
183.hindi_meaning: विलगाव / निष्कर्षण (किसी शुद्ध पदार्थ को अन्य पदार्थों से अलग करना)
183.example: The first step in recombinant DNA technology is the isolation of pure DNA.

183.english_meaning: A molecule containing a very large number of atoms, such as a protein, nucleic acid, or synthetic polymer.
183.hindi_meaning: वृहत् अणु (प्रोटीन, न्यूक्लिक एसिड आदि बड़े आकार के अणु)
183.example: Cell membranes must be broken open to release DNA along with other macromolecules.

183.english_meaning: An antimicrobial enzyme that damages bacterial cell walls.
183.hindi_meaning: लाइसोजाइम (बैक्टीरिया की कोशिका भित्ति को तोड़ने वाला एंजाइम)
183.example: Bacterial cells are treated with lysozyme to break open their cell walls.

183.english_meaning: An enzyme that breaks down cellulose, used to degrade plant cell walls.
183.hindi_meaning: सेल्युलेज (पादप कोशिका भित्ति को पचाने वाला एंजाइम)
183.example: Plant cells are treated with cellulase during the isolation of genetic material.

183.english_meaning: An enzyme that breaks down chitin, found in fungal cell walls.
183.hindi_meaning: चिटिनेज (कवक की कोशिका भित्ति को तोड़ने वाला एंजाइम)
183.example: Chitinase is used to break open the cell walls of fungi to extract DNA.

183.english_meaning: An enzyme that breaks down proteins into smaller polypeptides or amino acids.
183.hindi_meaning: प्रोटीएज (प्रोटीन का पाचन करने वाला एंजाइम)
183.example: Proteins associated with DNA are removed by treatment with protease.

183.english_meaning: Cause a substance to be deposited in solid form from a solution.
183.hindi_meaning: अवक्षेपित होना (घोल से ठोस रूप में नीचे बैठना या अलग होना)
183.example: Purified DNA ultimately precipitates out after the addition of chilled ethanol.

183.english_meaning: A mixture in which fine solid particles are scattered through a liquid or gas.
183.hindi_meaning: निलंबन (किसी द्रव में ठोस कणों का बिखरा होना)
183.example: Precipitated DNA can be seen as a collection of fine threads in the suspension.

183.english_meaning: The process of winding separated DNA strands onto a rod or spool.
183.hindi_meaning: स्पूलिंग (विलगित डीएनए धागों को लपेटकर बाहर निकालना)
183.example: DNA that separates out during precipitation can be removed by spooling.

184.english_meaning: An enzyme that cuts DNA at specific recognition nucleotide sequences.
184.hindi_meaning: प्रतिबंधन एंजाइम (वह एंजाइम जो डीएनए को विशिष्ट स्थानों पर काटता है)
184.example: Restriction enzyme digestions are performed by incubating purified DNA molecules.

184.english_meaning: Maintaining something at a favorable temperature and condition for development or reaction.
184.hindi_meaning: निश्चित तापमान पर रखना (अभिक्रिया या वृद्धि के अनुकूल स्थिति प्रदान करना)
184.example: Restriction enzyme digestions are performed by incubating purified DNA molecules.

184.english_meaning: A method used in biochemistry to separate DNA, RNA, or proteins based on size using an electric field.
184.hindi_meaning: अगारोज जेल इलेक्ट्रोफोरेसिस (विद्युत क्षेत्र का उपयोग करके आकार के आधार पर डीएनए को अलग करने की तकनीक)
184.example: Agarose gel electrophoresis is employed to check the progression of a restriction enzyme digestion.

184.english_meaning: A conductor through which electricity enters or leaves an object or substance.
184.hindi_meaning: इलेक्ट्रोड (चालक सिरा जिसके माध्यम से विद्युत प्रवाहित होती है)
184.example: DNA is a negatively charged molecule, hence it moves towards the positive electrode.

184.english_meaning: The positively charged electrode by which the electrons leave an electrical device.
184.example: DNA moves towards the positive electrode (anode).

184.english_meaning: A DNA molecule used as a vehicle to artificially carry foreign genetic material into another cell.
184.hindi_meaning: वाहक डीएनए (डीएनए का वह अणु जो बाहरी आनुवंशिक सामग्री को कोशिका में ले जाता है)
184.example: The process is repeated with the vector DNA also.

184.english_meaning: An enzyme that can bring about joining of two large molecules by forming a new chemical bond.
184.hindi_meaning: लाइगेज एंजाइम (डीएनए के टुकड़ों को जोड़ने वाला एंजाइम)
184.example: The cut out gene of interest and the cut vector are mixed and ligase is added.

184.english_meaning: DNA molecules formed by laboratory methods of genetic recombination to bring together genetic material from multiple sources.
184.hindi_meaning: पुनर्योगज डीएनए (विभिन्न स्रोतों के डीएनए को जोड़कर बनाया गया नया डीएनए)
184.example: This results in the preparation of recombinant DNA.

184.english_meaning: The production of multiple copies of a sequence of DNA or RNA.
184.hindi_meaning: प्रवर्धन या प्रवर्धन प्रक्रिया (डीएनए की प्रतियों की संख्या बढ़ाना)
184.example: 9.3.3 Amplification of Gene of Interest using PCR.

184.english_meaning: A laboratory technique used to make multiple copies of a segment of DNA.
184.hindi_meaning: पॉलीमरेज़ चेन रिएक्शन (पीसीआर - डीएनए खंड की अनेक प्रतियां बनाने की तकनीक)
184.example: PCR stands for Polymerase Chain Reaction.

184.english_meaning: Taking place in a test tube, culture dish, or elsewhere outside a living organism.
184.hindi_meaning: शरीर के बाहर (प्रयोगशाला में कांच के बर्तन आदि में)
184.example: Multiple copies of the gene of interest is synthesised in vitro.

184.english_meaning: Produced by chemical or biochemical synthesis.
184.example: Multiple copies of the gene of interest is synthesised in vitro.

184.english_meaning: A process in which proteins or nucleic acids lose the quaternary, tertiary, and secondary structure.
184.hindi_meaning: विकृतीकरण (डीएनए की दोनों लड़ियों का उच्च ताप पर अलग होना)
184.example: Each cycle has three steps: (i) Denaturation.

184.english_meaning: A short single-stranded nucleic acid utilized by all living organisms in the initiation of DNA synthesis.
184.hindi_meaning: प्राइमर (छोटे न्यूक्लियोटाइड खंड जो डीएनए संश्लेषण की शुरुआत करते हैं)
184.example: Each cycle has three steps: (ii) Primer annealing.

184.english_meaning: The process where complementary strands of nucleic acids hydrogen bond to one another.
184.hindi_meaning: संयुग्मन या एनीलिंग (प्राइमर का डीएनए टेंपलेट से जुड़ना)
184.example: Each cycle has three steps: (ii) Primer annealing.

185.english_meaning: Small chemically synthesized oligonucleotides that are complementary to specific regions of DNA, used to start DNA replication.
185.hindi_meaning: डीएनए के विशिष्ट क्षेत्रों के पूरक छोटे रासायनिक रूप से संश्लेषित ऑलिगोन्यूक्लियोटाइड्स, जिनका उपयोग डीएनए प्रतिकृति शुरू करने के लिए किया जाता है।
185.example: The PCR technique requires two sets of primers to amplify the DNA segment.

185.english_meaning: Short DNA or RNA molecules, comprising a few nucleotides, that have a wide range of applications in genetic testing and research.
185.hindi_meaning: छोटे डीएनए या आरएनए अणु, जिनमें कुछ न्यूक्लियोटाइड होते हैं।
185.example: Oligonucleotides are commonly used as primers in genetic amplification processes.

185.english_meaning: An enzyme that brings about the formation of a particular polymer, especially DNA or RNA.
185.hindi_meaning: एक एंजाइम जो एक विशेष बहुलक (विशेष रूप से डीएनए या आरएनए) के निर्माण को उत्प्रेरित करता है।
185.example: DNA polymerase extends the primers using the nucleotides provided in the reaction.

185.english_meaning: Increased or made larger, specifically referring to the multiplication of DNA copies through techniques like PCR.
185.hindi_meaning: बढ़ाया गया या प्रवर्धित (डीएनए की प्रतियों की संख्या को कई गुना बढ़ाना)।
185.example: The segment of DNA can be amplified to approximately one billion copies.

185.english_meaning: Resistant to the action of heat; able to maintain structure and function at high temperatures.
185.hindi_meaning: ताप-स्थायी; जो उच्च तापमान पर भी सक्रिय और स्थिर बना रहे।
185.example: Taq polymerase is a thermostable enzyme isolated from Thermus aquaticus.

185.english_meaning: A process in which the folding structure of a protein or nucleic acid is altered, often by heat, causing it to lose its biological activity.
185.hindi_meaning: वह प्रक्रिया जिसमें उच्च तापमान के कारण डीएनए के दोनों स्ट्रैंड अलग हो जाते हैं (विकृतीकरण)।
185.example: High temperature induces the denaturation of double-stranded DNA.

185.english_meaning: To join or bind together, typically DNA fragments.
185.hindi_meaning: जोड़ना (विशेषकर डीएनए के टुकड़ों को आपस में जोड़ना)।
185.example: The amplified fragment is used to ligate with a vector for further cloning.

185.english_meaning: In biology, made capable of taking up foreign DNA from its surrounding environment.
185.hindi_meaning: जीव विज्ञान में, कोशिका का बाहरी डीएनए ग्रहण करने के लिए सक्षम बनाया जाना।
185.example: Recipient cells are made competent before introducing the recombinant DNA.

185.english_meaning: Cells that have successfully taken up foreign DNA and undergone genetic transformation.
185.hindi_meaning: वे कोशिकाएं जिन्होंने सफलतापूर्वक बाहरी डीएनए को ग्रहण कर लिया है और रूपांतरित हो चुकी हैं।
185.example: Only transformants will grow on the agar plates containing ampicillin.

185.english_meaning: A gene introduced into a cell that confers a trait suitable for artificial selection, such as antibiotic resistance.
185.hindi_meaning: एक जीन जो रूपांतरित कोशिकाओं की पहचान करने और उन्हें चुनने में सहायता करता है।
185.example: The ampicillin resistance gene acts as a selectable marker in this experiment.

185.english_meaning: Foreign DNA inserted into a host organism or vector.
185.hindi_meaning: बाहरी या विदेशी डीएनए जिसे किसी परपोषी जीव में डाला जाता है।
185.example: When you insert a piece of alien DNA into a cloning vector, it gets multiplied.

185.english_meaning: Made as effective, perfect, or functional as possible.
185.hindi_meaning: सबसे अनुकूल या सर्वोत्तम रूप से व्यवस्थित किया गया।
185.example: The laboratory conditions were optimised to induce the expression of the target protein.

185.english_meaning: Derived from a different species or originating from outside the organism.
185.hindi_meaning: एक अलग प्रजाति से प्राप्त या भिन्न जीवों से संबंधित।
185.example: Any protein-encoding gene expressed in a heterologous host produces a recombinant protein.

185.english_meaning: A protein whose corresponding genetic code was engineered in a heterologous host.
185.hindi_meaning: वह प्रोटीन जो किसी परपोषी जीव में बाहरी जीन की अभिव्यक्ति से बनता है।
185.example: Large-scale production of recombinant protein is essential for medical applications.

185.english_meaning: An open system where fresh medium is continuously added and used medium is drained out to keep cells growing.
185.hindi_meaning: एक ऐसी संवर्धन प्रणाली जिसमें लगातार ताजा पोषक माध्यम मिलाया जाता है और पुराना माध्यम निकाला जाता है।
185.example: Cells can be multiplied in a continuous culture system to maintain them in a physiological state.

186.english_meaning: A vessel or device in which raw materials are biologically converted into specific products using microbial, plant, animal, or human cells.
186.hindi_meaning: बायोरिएक्टर (वह पात्र जिसमें सूक्ष्मजीवों या कोशिकाओं द्वारा कच्चे माल को जैविक रूप से उत्पादों में बदला जाता है)
186.example: Large volumes of culture are processed inside an industrial bioreactor.

186.english_meaning: A cylindrical or curved-base vessel equipped with a stirrer to facilitate even mixing and oxygen availability of contents.
186.hindi_meaning: स्टर्ड-टैंक रिएक्टर (एक बेलनाकार बर्तन जिसमें मिश्रण को एकसमान रखने के लिए विलोडक या स्टिरर लगा होता है)
186.example: A stirred-tank reactor is commonly used in biotechnology for large-scale production.

186.english_meaning: A device or mechanism used for stirring or agitating substances in a reactor.
186.hindi_meaning: विलोडक / एजीटेटर (घोल या मिश्रण को हिलाने और मिलाने वाला यंत्र)
186.example: The agitator system ensures that nutrients are evenly distributed throughout the tank.

186.english_meaning: A series of processes including separation and purification that a biosynthetic product undergoes before being ready for marketing.
186.hindi_meaning: डाउनस्ट्रीम प्रोसेसिंग (उत्पाद के निर्माण के बाद उसे शुद्ध करने और बाजार में लाने योग्य बनाने की प्रक्रिया)
186.example: Downstream processing and quality control testing are crucial stages in drug manufacturing.

186.english_meaning: Relating to the production of a chemical compound by a living organism.
186.hindi_meaning: जैव-संश्लेषित (जीवित जीवों द्वारा किसी पदार्थ का निर्माण)
186.example: After completion of the biosynthetic stage, the product enters purification.

186.english_meaning: The total quantity or weight of organisms in a given area or volume.
186.hindi_meaning: जीवभार / बायोमास (किसी जीव या जीवों की कुल मात्रा)
186.example: This type of culturing method produces a larger biomass leading to higher yields.

186.english_meaning: Subjected to the introduction of gas bubbles (such as sterile air) through a liquid.
186.hindi_meaning: स्पार्ज्ड (जिसमें गैस या हवा के बुलबुले प्रविष्ट कराए गए हों)
186.example: Sterile air bubbles are sparged through the culture medium in the reactor.

186.english_meaning: Large enough to be noticed or considered; significant in amount.
186.hindi_meaning: पर्याप्त / उल्लेखनीय (जो ध्यान देने योग्य या अच्छी मात्रा में हो)
186.example: Small volume cultures cannot yield appreciable quantities of products.
A bioreactor provides the optimal conditions for achieving the desired product.
Small volumes of the culture can be withdrawn periodically for testing.

186.english_meaning: Having the shape of a cylinder.
186.example: A stirred-tank reactor is usually cylindrical or has a curved base.

186.english_meaning: To make an action or process easy or easier.
186.example: The stirrer facilitates even mixing of the reactor contents.

186.english_meaning: A substance on which an enzyme acts or a surface on which an organism grows.
186.hindi_meaning: आधार-पदार्थ / सब्सट्रेट (जिस पर एंजाइम क्रिया करता है या जीव वृद्धि करता है)
186.example: Optimum growth conditions include the right temperature, pH, and substrate.

186.english_meaning: Free from bacteria or other living microorganisms; totally clean.
186.example: Sterile air is passed into the bioreactor to prevent contamination.

186.english_meaning: The amount of a product obtained from a natural or industrial process.
186.example: This method leads to higher yields of the desired protein.

187.english_meaning: The exploration and utilization of biological processes, living organisms, or cells for industrial, medical, and agricultural advancements.
187.hindi_meaning: जैव प्रौद्योगिकी (जीवों या कोशिकाओं का उपयोग करके उत्पादों का निर्माण)
187.example: Biotechnology plays a crucial role in developing life-saving medicines and vaccines.

187.english_meaning: Biological catalysts, typically proteins, that speed up chemical reactions within living cells.
187.hindi_meaning: उत्प्रेरक (जैविक प्रतिक्रियाओं को तेज करने वाले प्रोटीन)
187.example: Digestive enzymes help break down food into smaller molecules in our body.

187.english_meaning: Pertaining to genetic material formed by combining DNA from different organisms.
187.hindi_meaning: पुनर्योजन (विभिन्न स्रोतों के डीएनए को मिलाकर बनाया गया)
187.example: Scientists use recombinant DNA technology to produce human insulin in bacteria.

187.english_meaning: The deliberate modification of the characteristics of an organism by manipulating its genetic material.
187.hindi_meaning: आनुवंशिक इंजीनियरिंग (जीव के आनुवंशिक पदार्थों में कृत्रिम बदलाव)
187.example: Genetic engineering has allowed farmers to grow pest-resistant crops.

187.english_meaning: Enzymes that cut DNA molecules at specific internal base sequences.
187.hindi_meaning: प्रतिबंधन एंडोन्यूक्लीज (डीएनए को विशिष्ट स्थलों पर काटने वाले एंजाइम)

187.english_meaning: A small, circular, double-stranded DNA molecule that is distinct from a cell's chromosomal DNA, commonly used as a vector.
187.hindi_meaning: प्लाज्मिड (जीवाणु के भीतर पाया जाने वाला अतिरिक्त वृत्ताकार डीएनए)
187.example: Plasmids are frequently used as vectors to transfer foreign genes into host cells.

187.english_meaning: DNA molecules used as vehicles to artificially carry foreign genetic material into another cell.
187.hindi_meaning: वाहक (विदेशी डीएनए को परपोषी कोशिका में ले जाने वाले साधन)
187.example: Viruses can sometimes act as natural vectors to introduce genetic material into hosts.

187.english_meaning: Vessels or systems in which a biological process is carried out on a large scale, especially involving microorganisms.
187.hindi_meaning: बायोरिएक्टर (बड़े पैमाने पर जैविक उत्पादों को बनाने वाला बर्तन या संयंत्र)
187.example: Large quantities of antibiotics are produced using industrial bioreactors.

187.english_meaning: Healing agents or medical treatments used to cure or alleviate diseases.
187.example: Monoclonal antibodies have become important therapeutics in cancer treatment.

187.english_meaning: Relating to organisms whose cells contain a nucleus enclosed within membranes.
187.hindi_meaning: यूकैरियोटिक (सुकेन्द्रिक कोशिका वाले जीव जिनमें स्पष्ट केंद्रक होता है)
187.example: Plants, animals, and fungi are all eukaryotic organisms.

187.english_meaning: Referring to nucleic acid sequences that read the same forward and backward on complementary strands.
187.hindi_meaning: पेलिंड्रोमिक (दोनों सिरों से पढ़ने पर एक समान दिखने वाले न्यूक्लियोटाइड क्रम)
187.example: Restriction enzymes recognize specific palindromic sequences on DNA.

187.english_meaning: The genetic alteration of a cell resulting from the direct uptake and incorporation of exogenous genetic material from its surroundings.
187.hindi_meaning: रूपांतरण (कोशिका द्वारा बाहरी डीएनए को ग्रहण करने की प्रक्रिया)
187.example: Successful transformation of bacterial cells is essential for genetic cloning.

187.english_meaning: Relating to the later stages of a biochemical process, particularly involving the separation and purification of products.
187.hindi_meaning: डाउनस्ट्रीम प्रक्रिया (उत्पाद के शोधन और शुद्धिकरण से जुड़े अंतिम चरण)
187.example: Downstream processing ensures that the final medical product is pure and safe.

187.english_meaning: The action of creating something according to a precise formula, such as mixing active pharmaceutical ingredients with preservatives.
187.hindi_meaning: औषधि निर्माण (विभिन्न घटकों को मिलाकर दवा या उत्पाद तैयार करना)
187.example: The safe formulation of the vaccine requires strict adherence to quality standards.

187.english_meaning: Substances added to products to prevent decomposition by microbial growth or undesirable chemical changes.
187.hindi_meaning: परिरक्षक (उत्पादों को खराब होने से बचाने वाले रसायन)
187.example: Certain biological formulations need specific preservatives to increase their shelf life.

188.english_meaning: A specific sequence on a DNA molecule where replication is initiated.
188.hindi_meaning: प्रतिकृति की उत्पत्ति (डीएनए का वह विशिष्ट स्थान जहाँ से प्रतिकृति शुरू होती है)
188.example: The origin of replication is essential for the autonomous replication of a plasmid in a host cell.

188.english_meaning: Vessels in which raw materials are biologically converted into specific products using microbial or plant cells.
188.hindi_meaning: जैव-अभिक्रियाएं (ऐसे बर्तन जिनमें जैविक पदार्थों या कोशिकाओं का उपयोग करके उत्पादों का निर्माण किया जाता है)
188.example: Large volumes of culture are processed in stainless steel bioreactors to yield commercial products.

188.english_meaning: The stage of biotechnology processing that includes separation and purification of products before marketing.
188.hindi_meaning: अनुप्रवाह प्रसंस्करण (उत्पाद के विपणन से पहले उसका शोधन और पृथक्करण चरण)
188.example: Downstream processing and quality control testing are crucial steps in manufacturing therapeutic proteins.

188.english_meaning: Polymerase Chain Reaction, a technique used to amplify a segment of DNA rapidly.
188.hindi_meaning: पीसीआर (पॉलीमरेज श्रृंखला अभिक्रिया - डीएनए की कई प्रतियां बनाने की तकनीक)
188.example: PCR is widely used in forensic science to amplify minute traces of DNA.

188.english_meaning: Enzymes that cut DNA at specific recognition sites, commonly known as molecular scissors.
188.hindi_meaning: प्रतिबंध एंजाइम (वे एंजाइम जो डीएनए को विशिष्ट स्थलों पर काटते हैं)
188.example: Restriction enzymes are fundamental tools in recombinant DNA technology.

188.english_meaning: An enzyme that breaks down chitin, often used to lyse fungal cell walls during DNA extraction.
188.hindi_meaning: चिटिनेस (एक एंजाइम जो चिटिन को तोड़ता है, कवक कोशिका भित्ति को गलाने के काम आता है)
188.example: Scientists use chitinase to break open the tough cell walls of fungi to extract their DNA.

188.english_meaning: A small, circular, double-stranded DNA molecule that is distinct from a cell's chromosomal DNA.
188.hindi_meaning: प्लाज्मिड (जीवाणु कोशिका में पाया जाने वाला अतिरिक्त वर्तुल डीएनए अणु)
188.example: Plasmids are frequently used as vectors in genetic engineering.

188.english_meaning: Relating to a chromosome, which carries genetic information in the form of genes.
188.example: Chromosomal DNA contains the essential genetic instructions for an organism's development.

188.english_meaning: An enzyme that removes nucleotides from the ends of a DNA or RNA molecule.
188.hindi_meaning: एक्सोन्यूक्लीज (वह एंजाइम जो डीएनए या आरएनए के सिरों से न्यूक्लियोटाइड को हटाता है)

188.english_meaning: An enzyme that cleaves phosphodiester bonds within a polynucleotide chain.
188.hindi_meaning: एंडोन्यूक्लीज (वह एंजाइम जो डीएनए श्रृंखला के भीतर से काटता है)
188.example: Restriction endonucleases recognize specific palindromic sequences inside DNA strands.

188.english_meaning: To recognize or point out a difference between two or more things.
188.example: It is important to distinguish between prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells.

188.english_meaning: For a short time, or in a few words without unnecessary details.
188.example: Please explain the main highlights of the experiment briefly.

188.english_meaning: The action of increasing the volume or number of something, such as copies of a DNA segment.
188.hindi_meaning: वर्धन / प्रवर्धन (किसी चीज की मात्रा या डीएनए की प्रतियों को बढ़ाना)
188.example: The amplification of DNA fragments is achieved through thermal cycling in PCR.

188.english_meaning: The removal of impurities or unwanted elements from a substance.
188.example: The purification of the target protein requires several chromatography steps.

188.english_meaning: A substance produced by a living organism that acts as a catalyst to bring about a specific biochemical reaction.
188.hindi_meaning: एंजाइम / प्रकिण्व (जैविक उत्प्रेरक जो रासायनिक प्रतिक्रियाओं को गति देते हैं)
188.example: Digestive enzymes help break down complex food molecules into simpler absorbable forms.

189.english_meaning: The exploitation of biological processes for industrial and other purposes, especially the genetic manipulation of microorganisms for the production of antibiotics, hormones, etc.
189.hindi_meaning: जैव प्रौद्योगिकी (जीव विज्ञान और तकनीक का उपयोग करके उत्पाद या तकनीक विकसित करना)
189.example: Biotechnology plays a vital role in developing pest-resistant crops and life-saving medicines.

189.english_meaning: Medical drugs produced using biotechnology, such as proteins and recombinant DNA products.
189.hindi_meaning: जैव-औषधियाँ (जैविक स्रोतों या जैव प्रौद्योगिकी से निर्मित दवाइयाँ)
189.example: Insulin and vaccines are common examples of biopharmaceuticals used globally.

189.english_meaning: Having the genetic material altered artificially using genetic engineering techniques.
189.hindi_meaning: आनुवंशिक रूप से रूपांतरित (जीन में कृत्रिम रूप से बदलाव किया गया)
189.example: Genetically modified crops can withstand harsh environmental conditions and pests.

189.english_meaning: The branch of medicine concerned with the treatment of disease and the application of remedial agents.
189.example: Recent advancements in therapeutics have made cancer treatments more effective.

189.english_meaning: The identification of the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms.
189.hindi_meaning: रोग की पहचान या निदान संबंधी विधियाँ
189.example: Molecular diagnostics help in detecting diseases at an early stage.

189.example: Bioremediation is widely used to clean up oil spills in oceans.

189.english_meaning: A substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself being consumed.
189.hindi_meaning: उत्प्रेरक (रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया की गति को बढ़ाने वाला पदार्थ)
189.example: Enzymes act as biological catalysts in various metabolic pathways.

189.english_meaning: A microorganism, especially a bacterium causing disease or fermentation.
189.hindi_meaning: सूक्ष्म जीव (जीवाणु या कवक जैसे नग्न आँखों से न दिखने वाले जीव)
189.example: Certain beneficial microbes are used in the production of curd and bread.

189.english_meaning: Relating to the later stages in a process, such as the purification of a synthesized product.
189.hindi_meaning: डाउनस्ट्रीम प्रक्रिया (उत्पादन के बाद शुद्धिकरण और पृथक्करण चरण)
189.example: Downstream processing is essential to make the protein product safe for human use.

189.english_meaning: Perform a series of actions on something to change or preserve it.
189.hindi_meaning: प्रसंस्करण (किसी वस्तु को उपयोग योग्य बनाने की प्रक्रिया)
189.example: Food processing industries convert raw agricultural goods into marketable items.

189.english_meaning: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals.

189.hindi_meaning: पराजीनी (जिस जीव में बाहरी या अन्य प्रजाति का जीन डाला गया हो)

189.english_meaning: Morally good or correct; relating to moral principles.

189.hindi_meaning: यौगिक (दो या दो से अधिक तत्वों से बना पदार्थ)
189.example: Organic compounds form the structural basis of all living organisms.

190.english_meaning: Chemical products used in agriculture, such as pesticides and fertilisers.
190.example: Many farmers in developing countries find agrochemicals too expensive to use.

190.english_meaning: The technique or process of keeping tissue alive and growing in a culture medium outside the organism.
190.example: Tissue culture allows scientists to grow thousands of plants in a very short duration.

190.english_meaning: Any part of a plant taken out and grown in a test tube under sterile conditions.
190.hindi_meaning: कर्तत ऊतक / पौधे का वह भाग जिसे संवर्धन के लिए अलग किया जाता है
190.example: Whole plants can be successfully regenerated from various types of explants.

190.english_meaning: Free from bacteria or other living microorganisms; totally clean.
190.example: The plant parts must be grown under sterile conditions to prevent contamination.

190.english_meaning: The ability of a single cell to divide and produce all the differentiated cells in an organism.
190.hindi_meaning: पूर्णशक्तता (एक कोशिका से पूरा पौधा बनाने की क्षमता)
190.example: Totipotency is the fundamental principle behind plant tissue culture.

190.english_meaning: The propagation of plants by growing plantlets in tissue culture and on a micro scale.

190.english_meaning: Genetically identical plants produced asexually through tissue culture.
190.example: All the plants produced via this method are somaclones of the original parent plant.

190.hindi_meaning: विभज्योतक (पादप ऊतक जो वृद्धि में सहायक है)
190.example: The apical meristem of the infected plant remains completely free of viruses.

190.example: Scientists grow the isolated meristem in vitro to obtain virus-free plants.

191.hindi_meaning: दैहिक संकरण (विभिन्न पादप कोशिकाओं के संलयन की प्रक्रिया)
191.example: Somatic hybridisation led to the creation of pomato by fusing tomato and potato protoplasts.

191.english_meaning: The living content of a plant, fungal, or bacterial cell minus its outer cell wall.
191.hindi_meaning: जीवद्रव्यक (कोशिका भित्ति के बिना जीवित कोशिका)
191.example: The cell wall of the plant was enzymatically removed to obtain a naked protoplast.

191.english_meaning: Plants, animals, or microorganisms whose genetic material has been altered using genetic engineering techniques.
191.example: Genetically Modified Organisms help in reducing the reliance on chemical pesticides.

191.english_meaning: Negative impacts of non-living factors like drought, cold, heat, or salt on living organisms.
191.hindi_meaning: अजैविक तनाव (सूखा, ठंड, गर्मी या नमक जैसे कारक)
191.example: GM crops are engineered to be more tolerant to abiotic stresses like extreme drought.

191.english_meaning: Medicinal drugs and compounds used for therapeutic purposes.

191.english_meaning: A soil-dwelling bacterium naturally producing crystal proteins that are toxic to specific insects.
191.hindi_meaning: बैसिलस थुरिंजिएंसिस (एक जीवाणु जो कीटनाशक प्रोटीन बनाता है)
191.example: Bacillus thuringiensis produces proteins that can kill certain insect pests.

191.english_meaning: A certain type of pesticide derived from natural materials such as animals, plants, bacteria, and certain minerals.
191.example: Bt toxin acts as a natural bio-pesticide in engineered crop plants.

191.english_meaning: An order of insects comprising butterflies, moths, and skippers.
191.hindi_meaning: लेपिडोप्टेरा वर्ग के कीट (जैसे तितलियाँ और पतंगे)
191.example: Tobacco budworms and armyworms belong to lepidopterans.

191.english_meaning: An order of insects comprising beetles.
191.example: Certain strains of Bt protein can effectively kill coleopterans like beetles.

191.english_meaning: An order of insects comprising flies and mosquitoes having two wings.
191.hindi_meaning: डिप्टेरा वर्ग के कीट (मक्खियाँ और मच्छर)
191.example: Mosquitoes and flies are common examples of dipterans.

191.english_meaning: An inactive precursor of a toxin that requires biochemical activation.
191.example: Bt toxin exists as inactive protoxins inside the bacterial crystal.

191.english_meaning: Having a pH greater than 7; basic in chemical nature.
191.example: The alkaline pH of the insect gut solubilises the Bt toxin crystals.

191.english_meaning: To make a substance soluble or dissolve it in a liquid.
191.example: The crystals solubilise in the alkaline environment of the insect's midgut.

191.english_meaning: Cells that line the surfaces of the body, including the internal cavities and organs like the gut.
191.example: The activated toxin binds to the surface of midgut epithelial cells.

191.english_meaning: The disintegration of a cell by rupture of its cell wall or membrane.
191.example: Pores created by the toxin cause cell swelling and lysis, eventually killing the insect.

192.example: Specific Bt toxin genes were incorporated into several crop plants such as cotton.

192.english_meaning: A soil-dwelling bacterium naturally producing crystal proteins that are toxic to specific insects.
192.hindi_meaning: मिट्टी में पाया जाने वाला एक जीवाणु जो प्राकृतिक रूप से कीटों के लिए विषैले क्रिस्टल प्रोटीन उत्पन्न करता है।
192.example: Specific Bt toxin genes were isolated from Bacillus thuringiensis.

192.english_meaning: A type of unsegmented roundworm, many species of which are parasites of plants and animals.
192.hindi_meaning: एक प्रकार का सूत्रकृमि या गोलकृमि, जिसकी कई प्रजातियाँ पौधे और जंतुओं में परजीवी होती हैं।
192.example: Several nematodes parasitise a wide variety of plants and animals.

192.english_meaning: The presence of an unusually large number of pests or parasites in a place, causing damage or disease.
192.hindi_meaning: किसी स्थान या जीव पर कीटों या परजीवियों का भारी संख्या में आक्रमण या संक्रमण।
192.example: A novel strategy was adopted to prevent this infestation.

192.english_meaning: A biological process in which RNA molecules inhibit gene expression or translation by neutralizing targeted mRNA molecules.
192.hindi_meaning: एक जैविक प्रक्रिया जिसमें आर.एन.ए. अणु विशिष्ट एम.आर.एन.ए. (mRNA) को निष्क्रिय करके जीन की अभिव्यक्ति को रोकते हैं।
192.example: This method was based on the process of RNA interference (RNAi).

192.english_meaning: Relating to an organism consisting of a cell or cells in which the genetic material is DNA in the form of chromosomes contained within a distinct nucleus.
192.hindi_meaning: ऐसे जीवों से संबंधित जिनकी कोशिकाओं में स्पष्ट केंद्रक और झिल्ली-बद्ध कोशिकांग पाए जाते हैं।
192.example: RNAi takes place in all eukaryotic organisms as a method of cellular defense.

192.english_meaning: The regulation of gene expression in a cell to prevent the expression of a certain gene.
192.hindi_meaning: किसी विशिष्ट जीन की अभिव्यक्ति को रोकने या बंद करने की प्रक्रिया।
192.example: This method involves silencing of a specific mRNA due to a complementary dsRNA molecule.

192.english_meaning: Combining in such a way as to enhance or emphasize each other's qualities, or in genetics, matching base sequences (like A-T and G-C).
192.hindi_meaning: एक-दूसरे के अनुरूप या पूरक होने की स्थिति (जैसे आनुवंशिकी में बेस जोड़ों का मेल)।
192.example: These two RNAs being complementary to each other formed a double stranded RNA.

192.english_meaning: A chromosomal segment that can undergo transposition, also known as a mobile genetic element.
192.hindi_meaning: एक आनुवंशिक खंड जो डीएनए के भीतर अपना स्थान बदल सकता है, इसे मोबाइल जेनेटिक एलिमेंट भी कहते हैं।
192.example: The source of this complementary RNA could be mobile genetic elements (transposons).

192.english_meaning: A genus of bacteria used in genetic engineering as a vector to transfer foreign DNA into plant cells.
192.hindi_meaning: जीवाणु का एक वंश जिसका उपयोग आनुवंशिक इंजीनियरिंग में पौधों की कोशिकाओं में डीएनए स्थानांतरित करने के लिए किया जाता है।
192.example: Using Agrobacterium vectors, nematode-specific genes were introduced into the host plant.

192.english_meaning: An organism or DNA molecule used as a vehicle to artificially carry foreign genetic material into another cell.
192.hindi_meaning: बाहरी आनुवंशिक सामग्री को किसी कोशिका में पहुँचाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला वाहक (जैसे प्लाज्मड या वायरस)।
192.example: Using Agrobacterium vectors, nematode-specific genes were introduced into the host plant.

192.english_meaning: Relating to a nucleic acid sequence that is complementary to the meaningful strand (sense strand) of mRNA.
192.hindi_meaning: उस न्यूक्लिक एसिड अनुक्रम से संबंधित जो एम.आर.एन.ए. के मूल सेंस स्ट्रैंड के पूरक होता है।
192.example: The introduction of DNA was such that it produced both sense and anti-sense RNA in the host cells.

192.english_meaning: Containing a gene that has been artificially inserted from another species.
192.hindi_meaning: ऐसा जीव या पौधा जिसके जीनोम में किसी अन्य प्रजाति का जीन कृत्रिम रूप से डाला गया हो।
192.example: The parasite could not survive in a transgenic host expressing specific interfering RNA.

192.english_meaning: An organism that lives in or on another organism (its host) and benefits at the host's expense.
192.hindi_meaning: वह जीव जो अन्य जीव (पोषणकर्ता) के शरीर पर या उसके भीतर रहकर उससे पोषण प्राप्त करता है और उसे नुकसान पहुँचाता है।
192.example: The transgenic plant therefore got itself protected from the parasite.

192.english_meaning: A result or effect of an action or condition.
192.hindi_meaning: किसी कार्य, घटना या स्थिति का परिणाम या नतीजा।
192.example: The consequence was that the parasite could not survive in a transgenic host.

194.english_meaning: A precursor to a hormone, needing chemical processing to become fully mature and active.
194.hindi_meaning: एक अग्र-हॉर्मोन जो पूर्ण रूप से परिपक्व और सक्रिय होने से पहले रासायनिक प्रक्रिया से गुजरता है।
194.example: Insulin is synthesized in the body as a pro-hormone before it becomes fully functional.

194.english_meaning: The process of becoming fully developed or mature.
194.hindi_meaning: पूर्ण रूप से विकसित या परिपक्व होने की प्रक्रिया।
194.example: The C peptide is removed during the maturation of pro-insulin into insulin.

194.english_meaning: A covalent bond between two sulfur atoms, important in stabilizing protein structures.
194.hindi_meaning: दो सल्फर परमाणुओं के बीच का सहसंयोजक बंध जो प्रोटीन संरचना को स्थिर करने में मदद करता है।
194.example: Chains A and B of insulin were combined by creating disulfide bonds.

194.english_meaning: An experimental technique that uses genes to treat or prevent diseases by correcting defective DNA.
194.hindi_meaning: दोषपूर्ण डीएनए को ठीक करके बीमारियों के इलाज या रोकथाम के लिए जीन का उपयोग करने की तकनीक।
194.example: Gene therapy offers a potential way to cure hereditary genetic disorders.

194.english_meaning: Passed or able to be passed from parent to offspring genetically.
194.hindi_meaning: माता-पिता से बच्चों में आनुवंशिक रूप से स्थानांतरित होने वाला।
194.example: Hemophilia is a well-known hereditary disease passed down through families.

194.english_meaning: An unborn or unhatched offspring in the process of development.
194.hindi_meaning: विकसित होने की प्रक्रिया में मौजूद शुरुआती अवस्था का जीव या भ्रूण।
194.example: Correcting a gene defect in an embryo can provide a permanent cure.

194.english_meaning: To act in place of something deficient or missing to restore normal function.
194.hindi_meaning: किसी कमी या दोष को पूरा करने के लिए उसकी जगह कार्य करना।
194.example: A normal gene is delivered to take over the function and compensate for the non-functional gene.

194.english_meaning: A lack or shortage of something essential, such as an enzyme or vitamin.
194.hindi_meaning: किसी आवश्यक तत्व, जैसे एंजाइम या विटामिन, की कमी।
194.example: Adenosine deaminase deficiency severely harms the human immune system.

194.english_meaning: The transfer of an organ or tissue from one body or site to another.
194.hindi_meaning: किसी अंग या ऊतक को एक शरीर से निकालकर दूसरे शरीर में स्थापित करना।
194.example: Bone marrow transplantation is one method used to treat certain immune disorders.

194.english_meaning: Able to cure or heal a disease completely.
194.hindi_meaning: किसी बीमारी को पूरी तरह से ठीक करने में सक्षम।
194.example: Enzyme replacement therapy is helpful, but it is not completely curative.

194.english_meaning: A type of white blood cell of crucial importance to the immune system.
194.hindi_meaning: श्वेत रक्त कोशिकाओं का एक प्रकार जो प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली के लिए अति महत्वपूर्ण है।
194.example: Lymphocytes from the patient's blood were extracted and grown in culture.

194.english_meaning: A modified virus used as a vehicle to deliver genetic material into cells.
194.hindi_meaning: कोशिकाओं में आनुवंशिक सामग्री पहुंचाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला संशोधित वायरस।
194.example: A functional ADA gene was introduced into lymphocytes using a retroviral vector.

194.english_meaning: Living forever; never dying or decaying.
194.hindi_meaning: जो कभी मरे नहीं या जिसका कभी अंत न हो (यहाँ कोशिका संदर्भ में: जो हमेशा जीवित न रहें)।
194.example: Since these lymphocytes are not immortal, the patient requires periodic infusions.

194.english_meaning: The functional changes associated with or resulting from disease or injury.
194.hindi_meaning: किसी बीमारी के कारण शरीर के अंगों और प्रणालियों में होने वाले कार्यगत परिवर्तन।
194.example: Understanding the pathophysiology of a disease is crucial for effective treatment.

194.english_meaning: Based on what is generally done or established; traditional.
194.hindi_meaning: पारंपरिक या जो आम तौर पर लंबे समय से उपयोग में लाया जाता रहा हो।
194.example: Conventional methods of diagnosis include serum and urine analysis.

195.english_meaning: Formed by combining genetic material from different sources.
195.hindi_meaning: पुनर्संयोजकी (विभिन्न स्रोतों से आनुवंशिक सामग्री को जोड़कर बनाया गया)
195.example: Recombinant DNA technology has revolutionized modern medicine and agriculture.

195.english_meaning: An enzyme that brings about the formation of a particular polymer, especially DNA or RNA.
195.hindi_meaning: पॉलिमरेज़ (एक एंज जो डीएनए या आरएनए के निर्माण को उत्प्रेरित करता है)
195.example: Polymerase Chain Reaction is essential for amplifying DNA samples.

195.english_meaning: The action of increasing the volume or making something stronger; in genetics, making multiple copies of a piece of DNA.
195.hindi_meaning: वर्धन या प्रवर्धन (किसी डीएनए खंड की प्रतियों की संख्या बढ़ाना)
195.example: The amplification of the viral DNA allowed doctors to confirm the infection early.

195.english_meaning: A bacterium, virus, or other microorganism that can cause disease.
195.hindi_meaning: रोगाणु या रोगजनक (बीमारी फैलाने वाले सूक्ष्मजीव जैसे बैक्टीरिया या वायरस)
195.example: Washing hands frequently helps to remove harmful pathogens from your skin.

195.english_meaning: The changing of the structure of a gene, resulting in a variant form that may be transmitted to subsequent generations.
195.hindi_meaning: उत्परिवर्तन (जीन की संरचना में अचानक होने वाला स्थायी परिवर्तन)
195.example: Genetic testing can identify mutations that may lead to inherited disorders.

195.english_meaning: To cross-breed or combine complementary strands of nucleic acids.
195.hindi_meaning: संकरित करना या जोड़ना (पूरक न्यूक्लिक एसिड स्ट्रैंड्स को आपस में मिलाना)
195.example: The radioactive probe will hybridize with its complementary sequence on the DNA strand.

195.english_meaning: An image of a radiographic distribution formed by radiation emitted from a substance.
195.hindi_meaning: ऑटोरैडियोग्रफ़ी (विकिरण उत्सर्जित करने वाले पदार्थों की छवि प्राप्त करने की तकनीक)
195.example: Autoradiography helps locate the radioactive probe on the photographic film.

195.english_meaning: A toxin or other foreign substance which induces an immune response in the body.
195.hindi_meaning: एंटीजन या प्रतिजन (बाहरी पदार्थ जो शरीर में प्रतिरक्षा प्रतिक्रिया को प्रेरित करता है)
195.example: The ELISA test detects specific antigens produced by the infectious pathogen.

195.english_meaning: A blood protein produced in response to and counteracting a specific antigen.
195.hindi_meaning: एंटीबॉडी या प्रतिरक्षी (शरीर द्वारा किसी विदेशी एंटीजन के खिलाफ बनाए गए प्रोटीन)
195.example: Vaccines stimulate the production of antibodies to protect against diseases.

195.english_meaning: Relating to an animal or plant that has had a foreign gene inserted into its genetic code.
195.hindi_meaning: पारजीनी या ट्रांसजेनिक (वह जीव जिसके डीएनए में बाहरी जीन डाला गया हो)
195.example: Transgenic mice are frequently used as models to study human diseases.

195.english_meaning: The branch of biology that deals with the normal functions of living organisms and their parts.
195.hindi_meaning: कार्यिकी या शरीर-क्रिया विज्ञान (जीवों के अंगों और उनके कार्यों का अध्ययन)
195.example: Studying plant physiology helps scientists understand how crops respond to drought.

195.english_meaning: Combining in such a way as to enhance or emphasize each other's qualities; matching base pairs in DNA.
195.hindi_meaning: पूरक (जो एक-दूसरे के अनुकूल या मेल खाने वाले हों, जैसे डीएनए के बेस)
195.example: Adenine always pairs with its complementary base, thymine, in a DNA molecule.

195.english_meaning: The identification of the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms.
195.example: Early diagnosis of the disease significantly improves the chances of successful treatment.

195.english_meaning: Painful inflammation and stiffness of the joints.
195.hindi_meaning: अर्थराइटिस या संधिवात (जोड़ों में सूजन और दर्द की बीमारी)
195.example: Rheumatoid arthritis is a chronic inflammatory disorder affecting many joints.

195.english_meaning: The thickening and scarring of connective tissue, usually as a result of injury.
195.hindi_meaning: फाइब्रोसिस (ऊतकों में घाव या कड़ापन आना)
195.example: Cystic fibrosis is a genetic disorder that severely affects the lungs and digestive system.

196.english_meaning: Medicines or substances derived from biological sources used to treat human diseases.
196.hindi_meaning: जैविक उत्पाद (चिकित्सा में उपयोग होने वाले जैविक स्रोतों से प्राप्त उत्पाद)
196.example: Biological products like human proteins are used to treat certain human diseases.

196.english_meaning: Animals that have had their DNA manipulated to possess and express foreign genes.
196.hindi_meaning: परजीवी या ट्रांसजेनिक जंतु (जिनके जीन में कृत्रिम रूप से बदलाव किया गया हो)
196.example: Transgenic animals can be created to produce useful biological products.

196.english_meaning: A lung condition that causes shortness of breath, which can be treated using specific human proteins.
196.example: Human protein alpha-1-antitrypsin is used to treat emphysema.

196.english_meaning: An inherited disorder that increases the levels of a substance called phenylalanine in the blood.
196.example: Similar attempts are being made for the treatment of phenylketonuria (PKU).

196.english_meaning: A hereditary disorder characterized by lung congestion and infection in the digestive organs.
196.hindi_meaning: सिस्टिक फाइब्रोसिस (एक आनुवंशिक रोग जो फेफड़ों को प्रभावित करता है)
196.example: Researchers are exploring transgenic methods to treat cystic fibrosis.

196.english_meaning: A protein found in the milk of humans and other mammals.
196.hindi_meaning: अल्फा-लैक्टएल्बुमिन (दूध में पाया जाने वाला एक प्रमुख प्रोटीन)
196.example: Rosie's milk contained human alpha-lactalbumin making it nutritionally balanced.

196.english_meaning: The quality of being toxic or poisonous to living organisms.
196.example: Chemical safety testing is also known as toxicity testing.

196.english_meaning: Moral principles and questions that arise regarding what is right or wrong in human conduct.
196.hindi_meaning: नैतिक मुद्दे (उचित या अनुचित से जुड़े नैतिक प्रश्न)
196.example: The manipulation of living organisms raises several ethical issues.

196.english_meaning: The action or process of regulating or controlling something by rule or restriction.
196.example: Human activities involving living organisms cannot go on without proper regulation.

196.english_meaning: Principles concerning the distinction between right and wrong or good and bad behavior.
196.example: Standards are required to evaluate the morality of human activities.

196.english_meaning: A biological community of interacting organisms and their physical environment.
196.example: Genetic modification of organisms can have unpredictable results in the ecosystem.

196.english_meaning: Genetic Engineering Approval Committee, an Indian government organization for GM research safety.
196.example: The Indian Government set up organizations such as GEAC to make decisions regarding GM research.

196.english_meaning: The quality of being logically or legally sound and acceptable.
196.example: GEAC checks the validity of GM research before public approval.

196.english_meaning: Government licenses conferring a right or title for a set period, especially the sole right to exclude others from making, using, or selling an invention.
196.example: The usage of living organisms has created problems with patents granted for the same.

196.english_meaning: Originating or occurring naturally in a particular place; native.
196.example: Biological resources have long been used by farmers and indigenous people of a specific region.

197.english_meaning: The use of living organisms or their products to modify human health and the human environment.
197.hindi_meaning: जैविक प्रदोेगिकी (जीवों या उनके उत्पादों का उपयोग करके मानव उपयोग के लिए उत्पाद विकसित करना)
197.example: Biotechnology plays a major role in modern agriculture and medicine.

197.english_meaning: The state of being diverse; variety.
197.hindi_meaning: विविधता (विभिन्न प्रकार की प्रजातियों या रूपों का अस्तित्व)
197.example: India is known for its incredible cultural and biological diversity.
Basmati rice is famous worldwide for its unique and pleasant aroma.

197.english_meaning: A government authority or licence conferring a right or title for a set period, especially the sole right to exclude others from making, using, or selling an invention.
197.hindi_meaning: एकाधिकार पत्र / पेटेंट (किसी आविष्कार पर कानूनी अधिकार जिससे कोई अन्य व्यक्ति बिना अनुमति उसका उपयोग न कर सके)
197.example: The company filed for a patent to protect its new technological invention.

197.english_meaning: The quality of being new, original, or unusual.
197.example: The patent claim was based on the alleged novelty of the newly crossed rice variety.

197.english_meaning: Items or products that serve the same purpose or function as another.
197.hindi_meaning: कार्यात्मक समतुल्य (वे चीजें जो एक जैसी कार्यप्रणाली या उपयोग रखती हों)
197.example: The patent extended to functional equivalents, restricting others from selling similar products.

197.english_meaning: Keeping careful watch for possible danger or difficulties.
197.example: We must remain vigilant to protect our traditional knowledge and resources from theft.

197.english_meaning: The unauthorized appropriation of biological resources and traditional knowledge by individuals or organizations.
197.hindi_meaning: बायोपायरेसी / जैव-चोरी (जैविक संसाधनों और पारंपरिक ज्ञान का बिना अनुमति और बिना मुआवजा उपयोग)
197.example: Biopiracy deprives indigenous communities of fair benefits from their local resources.
Using bio-resources without proper authorisation is illegal under international guidelines.

197.english_meaning: Intended to recompense someone for loss, suffering, or injury.
197.example: The community demanded compensatory payment for the commercial use of their medicinal plants.

197.english_meaning: The variety of plant and animal life in the world or in a particular habitat.
197.hindi_meaning: जैविक विविधता (किसी क्षेत्र में पाए जाने वाले जीव-जंतुओं और पौधों की विविधता)
197.example: Tropical rainforests are regions of extremely high biodiversity.

197.english_meaning: Make full use of and derive benefit from a resource, sometimes unfairly.
197.hindi_meaning: दोहन किया गया (संसाधनों का उपयोग करना, अक्सर स्वार्थवश)
197.example: Traditional knowledge can be exploited to develop modern pharmaceutical applications.

197.english_meaning: The process of managing or running something principally for financial gain.
197.hindi_meaning: व्यावसायीकरण (लाभ कमाने के उद्देश्य से किसी उत्पाद या ज्ञान को बाजार में लाना)
197.example: The commercialisation of herbal medicines requires careful regulation.
The unequal benefit sharing between developed and developing nations highlights a major global injustice.

197.english_meaning: A minor change or addition designed to improve a text, law, or document.
197.hindi_meaning: संशोधन (कानून या नियम में किया गया बदलाव)
197.example: The Indian Parliament recently passed an important amendment to the Patents Bill.

198.english_meaning: The propagation of plants by growing plantlets in tissue culture.
